jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description_html:
About Second Front Systems

Second Front is a venture-backed company on a mission to strengthen global security by accelerating access to emerging technologies for the U.S. and our allies. Founded by Marines who saw firsthand how outdated government acquisition systems held back frontline personnel, we help commercial software companies get mission-critical technology into the hands of government users faster — backed by FedRAMP High, DoD IL2–IL6/JWICS, GovRAMP, UK MOD, and NATO authorizations. Our team is mission-obsessed, collaborative, and decisive, and we’re proud to be Great Place to Work® certified.

About the Role

Second Front Systems is looking for an infrastructure-focused, compliance-minded, operationally disciplined Platform Engineer to strengthen our Platform Engineering function across European regulated environments.

This role sits at the intersection of systems, tooling, and engineering — translating infrastructure reliability and deployment velocity into warfighter-ready software delivery. You’ll be responsible for deploying, operating, and maintaining Game Warden across EMEA cloud environments while establishing secure, repeatable platform patterns that satisfy sovereignty and assurance requirements.

You’ll build landing zones and reference architectures using infrastructure-as-code and cloud-native tooling, keeping European deployments aligned with our global platform patterns while preserving accreditation inheritance across target environments. We need someone who can operate cloud-native infrastructure at production scale; build and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and observability for regulated and potentially air-gapped environments; and produce the technical evidence and documentation needed to support applicable European security, accreditation, and regulatory requirements. As a key partner to our implementation and delivery teams, you’ll prepare production environments and hand them off with complete runbooks and technical evidence — serving as the operational bridge between platform architecture and customer deployment.

Work authorization & location: Candidates must hold citizenship in an EU member state, along with the right to work in the European Union, and be based in the EU (Remote). Unlike some of our other EU-based roles, this position requires citizenship rather than residency alone, given the security clearance and accreditation requirements tied to the systems this role supports. Candidates from any of the 27 EU member states are eligible, and you may be located anywhere in the EU.

Employment type & schedule: This is a full-time, remote position based in the EU, with compensation stated in EUR.

What You’ll Do

  • Deploy Game Warden and other Second Front products across AWS, Azure, GCP, and sovereign-cloud infrastructure in European regions, to specification.

  • Architect landing zones that satisfy sovereignty, customer-control, and GDPR requirements without single-vendor lock-in.

  • Govern Kubernetes, container runtimes, and infrastructure-as-code tooling to enforce repeatability across deployments.

  • Drive CI/CD, networking, identity, observability, and security controls against target-environment constraints and threat models.

  • Implement the technical controls and documentation required for EAL, FedRAMP, GovRAMP, NATO, UK MOD, or equivalent customer accreditation regimes.

  • Translate engineering tooling requirements into platform specifications, ensuring CI/CD, containerization, and accreditation workflows meet time-sensitive delivery windows.

  • Work with platform and engineering leads to resolve conflicts between automation, hardening, and operational constraints.

  • Sequence platform rollouts and upgrades to minimize disruption to active development while maintaining compliance posture and system hardening.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of hands-on platform engineering, DevSecOps, cloud infrastructure, SRE, or systems engineering experience in production environments.

  • Deep fluency with AWS, Azure, GCP, or equivalent cloud platforms operating at scale.

  • Production-grade Kubernetes and container orchestration experience in live systems.

  • Hands-on experience writing and maintaining infrastructure-as-code with Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi.

  • A track record building, securing, and operating CI/CD pipelines under regulatory or high-assurance compliance requirements.

  • Working knowledge of networking, IAM, SAML/OAuth, APIs, and distributed-systems troubleshooting in production.

  • Fluent English and a proven ability to collaborate asynchronously across distributed global engineering teams.

  • EU citizenship (any of the 27 EU member states) and the right to work in the EU.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Existing government or NATO security clearance, or eligibility to obtain one.

  • Experience operating in air-gapped, classified, or other high-assurance environments.

  • Familiarity with EAL/Common Criteria, FedRAMP, GovRAMP, NATO, or UK MOD accreditation processes; and/or familiarity with other frameworks such as NIS-2, CRA, etc.

  • Proficiency in a systems or scripting language (e.g., Go, Python, or Rust) for building internal tooling.

Compensation & Benefits

The base salary for this position will fall between €120,000 and €140,000. Your ultimate compensation will be determined by professional background, technical proficiency, seniority, and regional cost factors. This role is also eligible for equity awards and discretionary bonuses as part of a broader total rewards package.

Equal Opportunity

Second Front Systems is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, except where a specific nationality or citizenship requirement is a genuine and determining condition of the role, as is the case with the EU citizenship requirement above.

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Architect, Government Missions
jobs.description_html:
Senior Cloud Architect, Government Missions

Second Front Systems is looking for an operationally focused, compliance-hardened, multi-cloud Senior Cloud Architect, Government Missions to strengthen our cloud infrastructure and security practice.

Operating at classified and unclassified DoD and IC networks, you will be responsible for architecting and operating secure multi-tenant cloud foundations across AWS, Azure, and GCP; designing government enclave architectures (TSE-SE, LZA, MLZ, Assured Workloads); and leading compliance and Authority to Operate efforts end to end.

You will design and troubleshoot cloud and hybrid networking topologies (Transit Gateway, Virtual WAN, Network Connectivity Center, Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, Cloud Interconnect); architect and operate production Kubernetes platforms (EKS, AKS, GKE, air-gapped distributions) with multi-tenancy and DISA STIG/CIS hardening; establish Infrastructure as Code standards using Terraform, Pulumi, and Crossplane, ensuring that landing zones, network segmentation, centralized logging, and guardrails enforce zero-trust principles aligned to SCCA and CAP requirements, and systems achieve continuous Authority to Operate across NIST SP 800-53 controls.

We need someone capable of designing networks to DISA Secure Cloud Computing Architecture and Cloud Access Point specifications; leading deployments into NIPRNet, SIPRNet, JWICS, and classified fabrics; operating as mission owner in AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, and classified regions; and owning compliance end to end—control inheritance, System Security Plans, POA&Ms, STIG/SCAP scanning, continuous monitoring, and continuous ATO workflows.

As a key partner to customers, program leadership, and authorized assessors, you will establish technical authority and architectural direction across programs, serving as senior technical mentor to engineering teams.

Note: Candidates must reside in one of our approved hiring hubs:
• DC/Maryland/Virginia
• Denver/Colorado Springs, CO

This is a full-time position.

 

What You'll Do
• Architect and own secure multi-tenant landing zones across AWS, Azure, and GCP with account/subscription/project vending, network segmentation, centralized logging, and policy guardrails.
• Design and deploy government enclave architectures including AWS Trusted Secure Enclaves–Sensitive Edition, Landing Zone Accelerator, Azure Mission Landing Zone, and Google Cloud Assured Workloads foundations.
• Operate as mission owner within AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, and classified regions (Secret/Top Secret) connected to NIPRNet, SIPRNet, JWICS, and classified fabrics.
• Design and troubleshoot hybrid cloud networking end to end: hub-and-spoke and transit topologies, private connectivity (Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, Cloud Interconnect), BGP routing, DNS, private endpoints, load balancing, and firewall/inspection stacks.
• Establish Infrastructure as Code standards using Terraform, Pulumi, and Crossplane with module libraries, state management, and drift detection.
• Architect and operate production Kubernetes platforms (EKS, AKS, GKE, air-gapped distributions) with multi-tenancy, lifecycle management, CNI, network policy, Istio service mesh, secrets management, Helm/Kustomize, Flux/Argo CD, and DISA STIG/CIS hardening.
• Lead Authority to Operate efforts end to end: control inheritance matrices, NIST SP 800-53 implementation, System Security Plans, POA&Ms, STIG/SCAP scanning, continuous monitoring, and continuous ATO.
• Serve as senior technical authority for customers and assessors; mentor engineers and set architectural direction across programs.

 
 

What You Bring
• 8-10 years in infrastructure or cloud engineering, with 5+ years in a senior or lead architect role.
• Active TS/SCI clearance and U.S. citizenship.
• Deep, hands-on expertise in at least two of AWS, Azure, and GCP, including their government offerings.
• Extensive experience deploying into classified networks (SIPRNet and/or JWICS), including air-gapped or disconnected environments.
• Production IaC experience with Terraform/OpenTofu and at least one of Pulumi or Crossplane.
• Hands-on compliance experience with FedRAMP High, the DoD Cloud Computing Security Requirements Guide (CC SRG), NIST SP 800-53, DISA STIGs, and the RMF/ATO process, including authoring or owning ATO artifacts (SSPs, POA&Ms, control implementation statements).
• In-depth Kubernetes expertise running production, multi-tenant clusters, including networking, security hardening, upgrades, and troubleshooting; in-depth hands-on experience with Helm (chart authoring and lifecycle), Kustomize (bases and overlays), and GitOps tooling such as Flux and Argo CD, plus CI/CD pipelines.
• Proven experience designing multi-tenant landing zones and operating as a mission owner in government clouds (AWS GovCloud, Azure Government) at DoD Impact Level 4/5 or higher.
• U.S. citizenship is required for this role.

jobs.title: Strategic Business Development Lead, Continental Europe
jobs.description_html:
About Second Front Systems

Second Front is a venture-backed company on a mission to strengthen global security by accelerating access to emerging technologies for the U.S. and our allies. Founded by Marines who saw firsthand how outdated government acquisition systems held back frontline personnel, we help commercial software companies get mission-critical technology into the hands of government users faster — backed by FedRAMP High, DoD IL2–IL6/JWICS, GovRAMP, UK MOD, and NATO authorizations. Our team is mission-obsessed, collaborative, and decisive, and we’re proud to be Great Place to Work® certified.

About the Role

Second Front Systems is seeking a hunter-oriented, market-signal-driven, highly disciplined Strategic Business Development Lead to anchor our EMEA commercial organization as our inaugural dedicated hire for continental Europe. This is an individual-contributor role reporting directly to the Head of EMEA.

You’ll be operating in a nascent market with no inherited playbook. You will be responsible for creating qualified pipeline, opening target accounts, qualifying buying paths, and closing net-new deals across commercial software vendors, government customers, and regulated enterprises. You’ll pressure-test our target customer profile and buying paths through direct prospecting, named-account work, and live opportunities — identifying the lighthouse customers that establish credible European proof points and unlock a repeatable commercial motion across priority continental markets.

We’re looking for a zero-to-one player who can map mission needs, buyers, budgets, procurement routes, and decision criteria in government and defense pursuits; who can tell the difference between genuine revenue opportunity and mere access or activity; and who brings real discipline to pipeline management, account planning, and forecasting. In short: you’ll be the organization’s primary route to European market entry and scaled commercial revenue.

Work authorization & location: This position requires EU residency with existing, valid work authorization. Second Front cannot sponsor candidates at this time. We’re hiring EU-wide for this role (candidates based in the Netherlands or Denmark are of particular interest, but we welcome applicants anywhere in the EU).

Employment type & schedule: This is a full-time, remote position based in the EU, with compensation designated in EUR. Regular travel across continental Europe should be expected.

What You’ll Do

  • Own opportunities from initial contact through contract signature. The hard part: qualifying budget and procurement authority before investing in discovery.

  • Build a qualified pipeline across commercial software vendors, government entities, and regulated enterprises. The hard part: telling procurement-ready leads apart from exploratory inquiries.

  • Run named-account coverage through direct prospecting, referrals, and partner channels. The hard part: keeping account discipline across overlapping routes to the same buyer.

  • Map government and defense pursuits — mission needs, buyer roles, budget cycles, procurement vehicles, and decision criteria. The hard part: validating those criteria before discovery even begins.

  • Identify the lighthouse customers in Europe that establish accreditable proof points and unlock adjacent accounts. The hard part: qualifying replicability before committing to a pilot.

  • Validate ideal customer profiles, pricing, and buying paths through live opportunities. The hard part: separating real signal from noise in early-stage feedback.

  • Assess routes to revenue via hyperscalers, sovereign cloud providers, primes, and systems integrators. The hard part: mapping technical fit to what a given market actually needs.

  • Coordinate with our nascent continental technical and delivery teams as qualified opportunities move through discovery and evaluation. The hard part: keeping deal timelines realistic against engineering dependencies.

  • Translate quarterly business targets into regional deployment roadmaps. The hard part: accounting for export-control review and customer security-clearance gates.

  • Broker alignment between the sales pipeline and operations capacity. The hard part: surfacing resource constraints early enough that they don’t derail contract fulfillment or accreditation schedules.

  • Keep go-to-market messaging in sync with our compliance posture. The hard part: making sure proposals reflect our actual system hardening and government contract standards, not just the pitch.

What You Bring

  • 7+ years of business development, enterprise sales, or capture experience, including complex B2B and B2G technology sales across European markets.

  • A demonstrated track record of personally opening accounts and creating net-new pipeline in commercial software, cloud, infrastructure, or technology deals spanning commercial and government buyers.

  • A strong hunter profile, with evidence of closing complex deals and distinguishing genuine revenue opportunity from access and activity.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Digital Forensics (Clearance Required)
jobs.description_html:
Vannevar builds AI systems for the Department of War's most consequential missions. We have 125 deployments across every branch and combatant command spanning our core platform and five distinct products. An an example of how we work, when major combat operations started with Iran, we fielded a new product supporting 24/7 operations and 9,000+ users in three months.

How we build is our advantage: we deploy forward with the people who own the mission. Our engineers, product team, and CTO deploy forward to the point of friction, including visiting units in Ukraine. We focus on embedding directly with operational units supporting great power competition with China, combat operations with Iran, and counter-narcotics missions.

ABOUT THE ROLE 

We’re hiring a Product Manager for our Digital Forensics team. 

This team builds AI-driven intelligence capabilities that turn large, messy, real-world datasets into clear answers and actions for operators and investigators. The product has strong traction and is entering a period of rapid growth – many more users and far higher volume, fast. We’re hiring the PM who will own it through that scale-up. 

This is not a traditional roadmap role. You will take in incomplete, conflicting inputs from users, customers, stakeholders, and the product itself, and decide what we should build – and what we shouldn’t – as demand accelerates. 

You will work closely with operators, product engineers, forward deployed engineers, and mission colleagues to find high-leverage problems and drive them through a shipped capability. You’ll often need to set aside loud or conflicting inputs and make calls others disagree with. 

This role reports to the CTO and operates at the intersection of mission, product, and engineering. Success is measured by whether we build the right things and those things create real mission impact at scale. 

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO 

  • Own the product direction end-to-end. Turn ambiguous problems into concrete bets and drive them through to shipped capability. 
  • Navigate rapid growth. Guide the product through a steep rise in users and usage, making the tradeoffs to keep it fast, focused, and reliable at scale. 
  • Turn signal into direction. Take messy, often conflicting input from users, stakeholders, and the product itself, decide what actually matters for growth and mission impact, and translate it into clear product direction – including pushing back when the loudest ask isn’t the right one. 
  • Build alignment across Mission and Engineering. Bring people along when Mission and Engineering see a problem differently – disagree when you need to, then get everyone committed on the path forward. 
  • Partner with engineering. Embed with the team, meet them where they work best, and shape solutions that are both impactful and technically sound. 
  • Work directly with users. Build deep intuition for real-world workflows and needs. 
  • Drive adoption and durability. Move users from first use to daily reliance and keep quality high as volume grows. 

WHAT YOU SHOULD HAVE 

  • Strong product judgment. You consistently identify the right problems and make sound prioritization decisions. 
  • Product experience through a growth phase. You’ve owned a product through rising users and usage, not just early 0-to-1. 
  • Ability to separate signal from noise. You form independent, defensible opinions from incomplete and conflicting inputs, and can act on them under uncertainty.  
  • Experience operating under real constraints. You’ve shipped products where security, infrastructure, or deployment realities shaped decisions. 
  • High ownership and a bias toward action. You take responsibility for outcomes and push work through to completion.  
  • Technical fluency. You can engage with engineers and understand system constraints and tradeoffs. 
  • Clear, direct communication. You can articulate decisions, tradeoffs, and reasoning in a way others can act on. 
  • Active TS/SCI clearance (or ability to obtain one) 
  • Willingness to travel onsite 

Nice to have 

  • Experience working with operational, mission-driven, or investigative users 
  • Experience with LLM-based systems 
  • Experience with product analytics (e.g., SQL) 
  • Experience rapidly prototyping ideas (Figma, AI coding tools, etc.) 
  • Experience with digital forensics or investigations 
  • Exposure to constrained or high-security environments 

What we offer

We’re proud to offer competitive benefits that support our employees. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 100% remote first culture. You can work from anywhere in the US and all full time employees have WeWork access
  • Unlimited PTO including competitive vacation and holiday schedules
  • Lifestyle stipends - Monthly mental health, wellness & fitness stipend, in-home office setup stipend and family planning assistance
  • Salary top-up during military reserve duty
  • Fully paid parental leave
  • Child and pet care reimbursement during travel

jobs.title: Senior Business Operations Manager
jobs.description_html:
Vannevar builds AI systems for the Department of War's most consequential missions. We have 125 deployments across every branch and combatant command spanning our core platform and five distinct products. An an example of how we work, when major combat operations started with Iran, we fielded a new product supporting 24/7 operations and 9,000+ users in three months.

How we build is our advantage: we deploy forward with the people who own the mission. Our engineers, product team, and CTO deploy forward to the point of friction, including visiting units in Ukraine. We focus on embedding directly with operational units supporting great power competition with China, combat operations with Iran, and counter-narcotics missions.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Business Operations Manager to join a small, high-impact team that works on the company’s most important operational and strategic problems. This is a high-ownership position where you’ll drive real outcomes across the company and help us scale effectively from day one.

In your first six months, you’ll focus on two main priorities. First, you’ll partner with leaders in our mission and engineering teams to build our system for managing customer delivery (against 9-figures of deals) and to fill gaps in the capabilities we need to execute against our customer and product priorities. Second, you’ll build the core business and operational systems and lightweight processes that will help us scale. After that, you’ll help us source, attract, and onboard the key specialized and senior talent we need for our growth areas, and work more closely within a select customer/mission area to shape the business and operating model for one of the fastest growing parts of our business.

The role offers extensive opportunity to work with executives and leaders across the company, and growth trajectories to lead Business Operations at Vannevar or move laterally to help lead another function or line of business.

 

What you’ll do

Customer delivery and commercial operations — Vannevar has scaled to win deployments with every US Military Service and Combatant Command and with international customers, other federal agencies, and more. Each deployment carries its own delivery obligations and service objectives, and many customers have distinct practices that impact how we can operate. You’ll work with our mission and engineering teams to build a practical system to ensure seamless and efficient delivery against these obligations. You’ll partner with finance and engineering to help us understand our cost structure and opportunities for improvement, reducing friction to improve our end-users’ experience and our business performance.

Operational systems for the business — We’ve got rapid growth plans for 2027, and need business systems and processes that enable us to scale, collect core business and financial data, and avoid taxing our employees with burdensome tasks. You’ll build and tailor tools, processes, and AI agents to solve a prioritized set of business problems, which may span finance, customer delivery, recruiting, onboarding, HR, vendor/contract management, and other business areas. You’ll build these systems such that other functions can operate them indefinitely or they can run without you, so you can solve the next set of problems.

Strategy for senior and specialized talent— Some of the most important roles for Vannevar’s next phase of growth are ones we haven’t hired before. You’ll help prioritize roles to meet ambitious customer, mission, and product goals, and work closely with senior leadership to develop tailored plans to identify, attract, and hire the right people. You’ll then partner with recruiting to execute those plans, bringing exceptional people to Vannevar and setting them up for success.

Business and operating model for growth areas — Once you understand the company’s priorities, you’ll go deep on a single new and high growth customer/mission area. You’ll work with the teams there to understand the growth opportunity and think creatively about the business and delivery model to unlock the next phase of growth. You’ll need to build a deep understanding of the mission problems we’re solving and how customers can leverage our tools, and combine that with business and operational judgement.

Special projects — Some of the most interesting work you’ll do here won’t fit into a neat category. We’re a fast-growing company with a deliberately lean internal team. Important problems regularly surface and need someone sharp to own them... these problems could look like analyzing a major strategic investment, designing infrastructure for tracking a strategic goal, or identifying why a key process is breaking down and building something better.

 

What we’re looking for

  • ~5-10+ years of relevant work experience. You might come from a national security, management consulting, or high growth startup background — we want to see that you have experience executing and building new things. We’d love to see comfort with recruiting and building strong teams, scaling commercial and business operations, and supporting new business growth.
  • Ownership and Autonomy — You care about whether things actually work, not whether you followed the right process. You take responsibility for outcomes and don’t wait to be told what to do next.
  • Judgment — You figure out what the right problem is to work on, not just the one you were handed. You’re comfortable operating with ambiguity. You can decide when it makes sense to build something lightweight and fast, and when it’s worth investing more.
  • Speed and Efficiency — You know how to move quickly, and to build things (processes, tools, etc.) that allow others to move quickly too. You hate time taxes or unnecessary cost and find ways to squeeze that out of systems.
  • Plus: comfortable with designing AI agents for ongoing business processes; strong cross-functional project execution; know how to quickly build credibility with senior leaders.

 

What we offer

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - Product (TS/SCI Required)
jobs.description_html:
Vannevar builds AI systems for the Department of War's most consequential missions. We have 125 deployments across every branch and combatant command spanning our core platform and five distinct products. An an example of how we work, when major combat operations started with Iran, we fielded a new product supporting 24/7 operations and 9,000+ users in three months.

How we build is our advantage: we deploy forward with the people who own the mission. Our engineers, product team, and CTO deploy forward to the point of friction, including visiting units in Ukraine. We focus on embedding directly with operational units supporting great power competition with China, combat operations with Iran, and counter-narcotics missions.

About the role

Vannevar builds an agentic system that helps operators make sense of high-volume mission data and act with greater speed and confidence in sensitive government environments. The system analyzes millions of mission-relevant records to surface high-fidelity recommendations, near-real-time analysis, and decision-ready outputs while integrating into the systems and workflows customers already use.

Our software is designed to augment, not replace, human judgment. Operators remain in control of consequential decisions, with the system helping them understand evidence, investigate recommendations, and move faster with better information.

In this role, you will help expand the product to new missions, datasets, and operating environments. You will work directly with users and technical stakeholders to understand the mission, decide what should be built, and then build and deploy it. The team moves quickly — the first version of this system was deployed to in nine days — while holding a high bar for reliability, security, and usefulness to the people doing the mission.

This is a senior individual contributor role with broad ownership. You will write code, make architectural and product decisions, navigate complex government technical environments, and own outcomes from an initial mission need through production deployment and continued use.

What you’ll do

  • Own mission problems end-to-end: understand the user and workflow, determine what good looks like, design the technical approach, build it, deploy it, and own the outcome
  • Architect, build, and own the direction for a product deployed directly to customer environments in support of mission-critical use cases

What you should have

  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to own ambiguous problems without waiting for a fully specified set of requirements

jobs.title: Account Executive - Commercial (Mid-Market), Northeast
jobs.description_html:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

As a Commercial Account Executive, you will own a focused territory of strategic target accounts and existing customers with 500-2,500 employees, with an emphasis on Fortune 1000 and high growth organizations. Your mandate is to create new executive relationships, build qualified pipeline, win complex, six-figure, multi-product, platform opportunities, and expand 1Password’s strategic footprint across an existing book of business.

This is not a transactional or single-product sales role. You will lead an enterprise-wide security conversation, starting with a customer’s most urgent problem and building the strategic case for Unified Access across humans, AI agents, and machines. You will engage and multi-thread with CISOs, CIOs, IT and security leaders, IAM teams, DevOps and platform teams, engineering leaders, security architects, finance, procurement, and other executive stakeholders.

This is a remote, field-based opportunity. Candidates must be based in the New York City metro area or New England area and should expect regular in-person customer meetings, industry events, and travel throughout the territory, about 30-40%.

How we’re using AI today
Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.

What we're looking for:

  • 4+ years experience selling to Fortune 1000 organizations and high growth companies spanning 500+ employees, with 1+ year of substantial cybersecurity sales experience.

  • A consistent record of exceeding $1M+ annual quotas, including experience carrying quotas in the $1M-2M range and closing complex, multi-product opportunities.

  • Multiple years of elite sales performance and company recognition, such as President’s Club or equivalent top-performer awards.

  • Demonstrated success selling enterprise platforms and multi-product solutions, and not just transactional or stand-alone point products.

  • Clear methodology for maintaining 2.5x pipeline coverage at all times through territory tiering, account planning, outreach cadence, and cold calling efforts.

  • Experience selling identity, Zero Trust, cloud security, endpoint security, privileged access, developer security, or adjacent cybersecurity platforms.

  • Proven ability to engage IAM, IT security, DevOps, platform engineering, and engineering leaders and connect their technical priorities to an executive business case.

  • A record of winning net-new strategic logos and expanding existing accounts through cross-sell, upsell, and multi-year platform agreements.

  • Strong executive presence and the ability to communicate credibly with C-suite leaders and deeply technical audiences.

  • Rigorous account planning, pipeline creation, opportunity management, forecasting, and negotiation skills.

Bonus points for:

  • You lead with curiosity and strong discovery, uncovering the broader security and business problem rather than stopping at the initial product request.

  • You create a compelling platform narrative while keeping the customer’s priorities, maturity, and path to value at the center.

  • You combine strategic thinking with operating rigor; your account plans, pipeline, forecasts, and close plans are current, specific, and dependable.

  • You are resilient, accountable, collaborative, and motivated by ambitious targets and complex opportunities.

  • You hunt daily for new opportunities and consistently hit pipeline generation targets.

  • You leverage AI daily to expedite your administrative work and identify strategic opportunities across your book.

  • You are coachable, apply feedback quickly, and continuously improve your craft.

  • You thrive in a remote, field-based environment and prioritize meaningful in-person customer engagement.

What you can expect:

Own and grow a strategic commercial territory

  • Develop and execute sophisticated account and territory plans for a focused portfolio of high-value prospects and customers.

  • Create new executive relationships with CISOs, CIOs, identity leaders, security architects, and other senior technology buyers to accelerate access and credibility.

  • Identify whitespace, competitive displacement opportunities, and compelling events across identity security, AI adoption, privileged access, SaaS governance, developer workflows, and device security.

  • Build and maintain the pipeline coverage, account engagement, and deal velocity required to consistently achieve or exceed a significant annual quota.

  • Cultivate relationships in the channel through innovative account mapping techniques and in-person co-selling opportunities.

Sell the full platform story

  • Elevate conversations from an individual point-product need to a strategic Unified Access vision spanning people, AI agents, and machines.

  • Connect 1Password’s capabilities to measurable outcomes, including reducing credential and access risk, eliminating standing privilege, governing SaaS and shadow AI, protecting developer and machine workflows, strengthening device trust, and improving auditability.

  • Land with the customer’s most urgent use case, then build an executive-backed roadmap for adoption and expansion across Enterprise Password Manager, SaaS Manager, Credential Broker, Device Trust, and Privileged Access.

  • Translate complex identity, access, cloud, endpoint, developer, and AI-security concepts into clear business value for executive and deeply technical audiences.

Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles

  • Orchestrate 4-6 month sales cycles involving security, IAM, IT, DevOps, platform engineering, application engineering, finance, legal, procurement, and executive sponsors.

  • Build consensus across large buying groups and establish clear business, technical, economic, and decision criteria.

  • Lead executive presentations, discovery sessions, workshops, business-value assessments, commercial negotiations, and close plans.

  • Create and maintain mutual action plans and apply MEDDPPICC or a comparable enterprise qualification methodology with discipline.

  • Structure and negotiate complex, multi-year, multi-product agreements, org-wide solutions with material ARR and platform expansion potential.

Expand strategic customer relationships

  • Build broad, durable relationships throughout customer organizations rather than relying on a single champion.

  • Uncover business and security priorities beyond the initial use case and turn them into platform expansion opportunities.

  • Partner with Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, product specialists, and services teams to create adoption and expansion plans tied to measurable outcomes.

Operate as one team

  • Collaborate closely with BDR, Solutions Engineering, Channels, Alliances, Customer Success, Onboarding, Product, Marketing, Legal, and Deal Desk.

  • Co-sell with strategic partners, cloud alliances, channel teams, and systems integrators where they can expand reach or accelerate a decision.

  • Represent 1Password at executive briefings, customer meetings, trade shows, and industry events.

  • Maintain accurate opportunity data, next steps, forecasts, and account plans in Salesforce.

  • Use AI and modern selling tools thoughtfully to improve research, preparation, coaching, and execution while creating more time for customer engagement.

How you work:

  • Knowledge of identity and access management, privileged access management, credential security, machine identities, agentic AI security, SaaS governance, device trust, or secrets management.

  • Experience competing and winning against major enterprise identity and cybersecurity platform providers.

  • Proficiency with MEDDPPICC, Salesforce, Slack, Zoom, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Outreach, and AI-enabled sales tools.

  • Demonstrated ownership of full cycle sales from initial cold outbound to close to expansion.

  • Experience developing opportunities through channel partners, cloud alliances, systems integrators, or technology partners.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $82,000 USD and $115,000 USD, and is commission-eligible. This role is also immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.


At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.


Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process.


Our approach to work
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.


What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community
🤝 Paid volunteer days
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.

Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.

Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check that may consist of prior employment verification, reference checks, education confirmation, criminal background, publicly available social media, credit history, or other information, as permitted by local law.

1Password uses artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) technologies, including natural language processing and predictive analytics, to assist in the initial screening of employment applications and improve our recruitment process. See here for the latest third party bias audit information. If you prefer not to have your application assessed using AI/ML features, you may opt out by completing this form. For additional information see our Candidate Privacy Notice.

Our Infrastructure Services organization is responsible for the underlying infrastructure that powers the 1Password application. It includes Compute Services, Network and Edge Services, and Stateful Services.

As a Senior Staff Cloud Platform Engineer, you set the multi-year technical strategy for Infrastructure Services. You decide where the organization invests, define the architecture and standards that every infrastructure team and internal tenant builds on, and make sure our compute, network and edge, and stateful platforms evolve as one coherent system rather than three separate ones. You partner with engineering and product leadership, security, and finance to balance reliability, security, cost, and delivery speed, and you are the senior technical voice for infrastructure across the company.

This is a hands-on role. You write design docs, prototype, review the hardest designs, and step into the most serious incidents. But your main impact comes from making many teams more effective and from the decisions that hold up for years.

How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What we're looking for:

  • You have set technical direction across multiple teams. You have owned an infrastructure strategy or architecture spanning several teams or an entire organization, and you can point to the multi-year outcomes: what others adopted, what shipped, and what measurably improved.

  • You have operated Kubernetes at production scale. This includes multi-cluster, multi-tenant, customer-traffic-bearing environments (EKS or similar managed platforms preferred). You know it deeply, from autoscaling and admission control to GitOps, workload identity, and fleet-wide cluster upgrades.

  • You combine depth with breadth. Beyond Kubernetes, you have working fluency in networking and edge and in stateful data systems, and you understand how a decision in one layer affects the rest.

  • You have made reliability a standard, not a project. You defined SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets, and you got multiple teams to adopt them. You have improved incident response, post-incident learning, and disaster recovery across an organization, not just on your own team.

  • You still build. You are proficient in Go (or a similar language) and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and you have a track record of automating complex, high-toil operational workflows at fleet scale.

  • You influence without relying on authority. You write clear strategy and design documents, present to senior leaders, resolve technical disagreements between teams, and build alignment on difficult tradeoffs.

  • You grow other engineers. You have mentored Senior and Staff engineers, raised the bar on design review, and helped shape how your organization hires and evaluates technical talent.

  • Hands-on experience with service mesh and service-to-service networking, such as Linkerd or Amazon VPC Lattice.

  • Experience operating scalable database technology, such as MySQL, Postgres, or DynamoDB.

  • Designing developer platform abstractions for internal teams, such as paved-road service toolkits and production readiness frameworks, that measurably improved usability and productivity.

  • Helping build AI-assisted operations tools, such as auto-remediation or AI-assisted diagnosis, rather than only using them.

  • Operating highly available, multi-region services in a large SaaS environment, including capacity planning and performance optimization at scale.

  • Experience in a security, identity, or other high-trust product environment.

  • Drive adoption of automation and AI-assisted operations to reduce toil across the organization.

  • Mentor Staff and Senior engineers, raise the bar on design review and engineering practice, and help us hire and develop the next generation of infrastructure leaders.

jobs.title: Customer Solutions Engineer, EMEA
jobs.description_html:
About the Role

Abnormal AI is looking for a Customer Solutions Engineer to join the Technical Account Management team. This role gives Abnormal a flexible, technical resource for situations that fall between standard support and a long-term, dedicated Technical Account Manager. Customer Solutions Engineers are floating technical specialists who partner with CSMs for the duration of a specific need, triggered by things like recurring support cases, asks beyond the typical support experience, or short-term project-based work. The ideal candidate combines deep technical fluency with strong triage judgment and is comfortable moving between engagements without an existing playbook.

What you will do 

  • Serve as a flexible technical resource CSMs can bring into challenging or recurring account situations that a standard support case isn't built to resolve.
  • Take on short-term, project-based technical engagements for customers without a dedicated TAM.
  • Partner with CSMs to assess customer technical needs, join investigative or best-practices calls, and determine the right next step.
  • Lead hands-on platform optimization: configuration reviews, best-practices setup, and proactive tuning that prevents issues from recurring.
  • Document session recaps and next steps in the CRM so recommendations are clear to the customer and visible to the broader team.
  • Advise customers on underused contracted features and flag upsell or professional services/deployment opportunities where relevant.
  • Recognize when a situation exceeds this role's scope and hand it to the Critical Situation Manager or Technical Support with a clear, documented hand-off.
  • Surface patterns across engagements to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to drive systemic improvement.

Must Haves 

  • 3+ years in a customer-facing technical role (email infrastructure, IT security/administration, engineering, or technical support) in enterprise SaaS or cybersecurity
  • Solid grounding in Abnormal's platform and configuration best practices, sufficient to work independently with customers without a senior technical resource in the room
  • Strong triage judgment; able to recognize quickly whether a situation calls for hands-on technical guidance or a more senior technical resource
  • Comfortable stepping into a customer relationship for a defined engagement and stepping back out; this is not a standing account-ownership role
  • Able to manage multiple concurrent, time-bound engagements across a broad book of business rather than a fixed set of named accounts
  • Excellent communication skills across technical and business stakeholders, including comfort presenting to senior customer stakeholders

Nice to Have 

  • Familiarity with email authentication/delivery protocols and cloud email platforms (Microsoft 365, Google Workspace)
  • Prior experience in a floating/pooled technical resource model (e.g., professional services, deployment, or solutions engineering)
  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent hands-on experience

 

#LI-AA1

A note on AI in our process: 
Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. jobs.description_html:
About the Role

Cybercrime doesn't wait for anyone to catch up to it, and neither do we. Abnormal AI is looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to join our New England team, selling behavioral AI security solutions into Enterprise-level accounts within a defined territory.

We didn't bolt AI onto old security tools. We built our platform from AI up, to detect the subtle human-targeted attacks that traditional tools miss. You'll be selling something genuinely different, and you'll need to sell it with the same conviction.

The ideal candidate is local to the New England area and brings:

  • Proven hunter with a disciplined approach to early pipeline development and prospecting into enterprise accounts. Skilled at leveraging all five demand gen pillars: AE prospecting, SDRs, marketing, channel, and customer referrals.
  • Strong qualifier with a knack for uncovering customer pain points and connecting them to compelling, value-driven solutions.
  • Effective presenter able to tailor demos and messaging to resonate with stakeholders based on specific business challenges.
  • Process-oriented with a consistent, repeatable sales methodology and strong time management skills, capable of managing multiple deals without sacrificing quality.
  • Data-disciplined, maintaining accurate and consistent account and opportunity data at all times.
  • Business case builder, experienced in quantifying ROI across multiple dimensions for diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Knowledge sharer, able to extract, organize, and document customer insights and deal lessons to enable broader team learning.
  • Internal guide, adept at navigating and supporting internal buying processes.
  • Resilient and resourceful, with the grit to thrive in early-stage environments and a strong understanding of how to leverage cross-functional teams including SEs, marketing, BDRs, product, and CS.

What You Will Do

  • Own and grow a defined enterprise territory, with a mandate to overachieve new annual recurring revenue quota, not just hit it.
  • Run the full deal cycle on enterprise accounts (>3k mailbox organizations): first conversation, technical evaluation, contract signature, and the upsell conversations that follow once they're a customer.
  • Prospect and build new business opportunities to keep your pipeline ahead of target, drawing on our full go-to-market engine, marketing, channel, and referrals included.
  • Sell a platform that's actively expanding underneath you: what started as email security now covers identity, AI security, and insider threat, giving you more surface area to bring value to every account.
  • Partner with Customer Success to protect renewals and spot expansion opportunities before they're obvious.
  • Keep your data sharp across Salesforce, Highspot, and Close Plan, because accurate pipeline is how the whole team plans and wins.
  • Be the customer's advocate inside Abnormal, working with Sales Engineering, Product, and Marketing to get the right things prioritized so more revenue closes, faster.

Must Haves

  • 3+ years of direct (not overlay) experience hunting in enterprise-sized organizations (3k+ employees), with a track record of prospecting, winning new logos, and expanding accounts in competitive, incumbent-heavy environments.
  • Negotiation skill that holds up against large organizations and complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
  • A track record to back it up: consistent over-quota performance, ideally top 10% of your sales org.
  • Technical fluency across security, email, cloud, and AI, enough to hold your own in a conversation with a CISO.
  • Cybersecurity or security-adjacent SaaS sales experience, selling subscription software to CISOs and security teams at average deal sizes of $100k+.
  • A builder's mindset: you've thrived somewhere early-stage, an underdog, or up against bigger incumbents, and you know how to build territory with limited resources.
  • Comfort selling within a company that's still writing its next chapter. We're growing quickly, protecting more than 5,000 customers including 30% of the Fortune 500, and expanding fast from email into identity, AI security, and insider threat. That means more to sell, more to learn, and more room to make your mark than a mature market leader can offer.

Abnormal AI is seeking an Mid-Market Sales Engineer to join our growing Sales Engineering team. As an Mid-Market Sales Engineer, you will serve as our customer’s primary technical contact, acting as a trusted technical advisor to security, email, and identity teams, crafting strategic, value-based business cases to win complex business opportunities and help organizations conquer their most intractable email and identity-driven security challenges.

In partnership with Mid-Market Account Executives, you will be responsible for conducting in-person and remote product demonstrations, leading architecture-level technical discussions, articulating the technical and business value of Abnormal AI’s platform, and owning and driving successful outcomes for Enterprise-scale Proof of Value (POV) programs.

The ideal candidate for this role will be located in the Ohio Valley region (Detroit, Cincinnati, Louisville, Columbus, Nashville or Memphis ideally) and possess the following skill set:

  • Ability to tie technology to measurable risk reduction and business outcomes at Enterprise scale
  • Ability to influence senior security, IT, and executive stakeholders in both virtual and in-person settings
  • High EQ; ability to read the room, engage stakeholders, demonstrate empathy, listen actively, and respond thoughtfully
  • Ability to create value-driven presentations and tell compelling stories (PowerPoint, Google Slides)

  • Run technical discovery that uncovers risk, not just requirements
  • Conduct technical and competitive landscape research to effectively address customer questions and objections

  • Articulate why legacy secure email gateways fail against social engineering and identity-based attacks

  • Solid technical understanding of SaaS security models including multi-tenant cloud environments

You'll also be the PM who brings structure, accountability, and forward momentum to cross-functional projects across the People function.

This isn't a role for someone who wants to maintain the status quo. It's for someone who wants to build something.

  • Own the People team's program calendar and roadmap, coordinating workstreams across HRBPs, Total Rewards, Talent Acquisition, and L&D; build and maintain lightweight project infrastructure including intake processes, status reporting, frameworks, and milestone tracking
  • Diagnose cross-functional people team pain points and build out a process to address them

  • Build rewards and recognition programming for AI Transformation across the business in partnership with the Transformation team  
  • Help with IPO readiness programs

About the Role

Abnormal AI is seeking a Solutions Architect, that will play a key role in the pre-sales process, serving as a technical expert and trusted advisor to prospects and customers. jobs.location: United States - Remote; CHI Office; SF Office; NYC Office; PGH Office
jobs.description_html:
About Abridge

Founded in 2018, Abridge is the first AI-native clinician intelligence platform organized around the patient, built for clinicians, and designed to help health systems coordinate the clinical, financial, and evidence-based decisions for every moment of care. Powered by purpose-built AI for healthcare, Abridge connects patients, providers, payers, and life sciences companies. This year, the platform will support more than 100 million patient-clinician conversations across more than 300 of the largest and most complex health systems in the U.S. With deep workflow integration, the Abridge clinician intelligence platform has been validated to support encounters in 28+ languages across specialties and care settings.

Abridge is setting the industry standard for the responsible deployment of Al across health systems with continual and transparent Al evaluation. Clinical decision support references and cites gold-standard sources of evidence, and features like Linked Evidence map AI-generated documentation to source data, helping clinicians quickly trust and verify the output.

Abridge was awarded Best in KLAS for Ambient AI in 2025 and 2026, in addition to other accolades, including TIME Best Inventions of 2024 and 2025, CNBC Disruptor 2025, and Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies 2025.

We are a growing team of practicing clinicians, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to transform healthcare. We have offices located in San Francisco, New York, and Pittsburgh.

The Role:

We are looking for a strategic and results-oriented Revenue Operations Manager to join our Revenue Operations team as the operational backbone of our Partner Experience (PX) organization — Partner Success, Clinical Success, Implementation, Support, and PX Ops. In this key role, you will own the systems, workflows, and analytics that power PX — including administration of Planhat and Zendesk — while keeping the post-sale motion tightly aligned with Sales, Marketing, and Finance.

As a trusted partner to leadership, you will provide actionable insights that align operations with company goals, helping to accelerate growth and optimize the partner journey — from implementation through expansion and renewal.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the PX Tech Stack: Serve as administrator and product owner for Planhat and Zendesk — health scoring, playbooks, workflows, triggers, SLAs, routing, Salesforce integrations, and reporting. Assist with administration of our LMS/CMS platforms supporting partner education and enablement. Continuously improve these systems so PX teams maintain optimal performance.

  • Optimize Operational Workflows: Design, refine, QA, and implement workflows and processes that enable PX teams to operate at peak efficiency. Streamline operations to ensure seamless handoffs across the full partner lifecycle — from deal close through implementation, clinical adoption, support, and renewal.

  • Empower Data-Driven Insights and Strategic Decisions: Develop and maintain reports and dashboards that provide leadership with real-time visibility into key metrics, including partner health, adoption and utilization, support volume and SLA attainment, and retention trends. Use data to drive actionable strategies that improve decision making and operational performance.

  • Enhance Revenue & Forecast Clarity: Partner with Finance to support renewal and retention forecasting, analyze commission reports, and generate revenue-related insights that align with business goals and drive clarity across the organization.

  • Business Partner to PX Leadership: Act as the dedicated operations partner to leaders across Partner Success, Clinical Success, Implementation, Support, and PX Ops — translating their priorities into systems, process, and reporting, and representing PX needs in cross-functional RevOps planning with Sales, Marketing, and Finance.

What You'll Bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Customer Success Operations, Sales Operations, or a similar role in a SaaS company (healthcare experience is a plus).

  • Extensive experience with SaaS tools such as Salesforce, Planhat (or Gainsight/similar CS platform), Zendesk, and exposure to LMS/CMS administration. Administration experience with a CS platform or support platform strongly preferred.

  • Strong understanding of go-to-market strategies and key metrics that influence success in Sales, Marketing, and Partner Success.

  • Direct experience business-partnering with post-sale leadership — Customer/Partner Success, Clinical or Implementation teams, or Support — you understand how these functions operate and what they need from operations.

  • Fluency in post-sale metrics: net revenue retention, gross retention, adoption and utilization, NPS, CSAT, and support SLA performance.

  • Exceptional AI and Business Intelligence experience (Claude, OpenAI, Excel/Google Sheets, SQL, Business Intelligence tools, etc.), with the ability to interpret complex data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable operational plans.

  • Proven track record in building and maintaining commercial dashboards and reports that provide clarity and support data-driven decision-making.

  • Demonstrated ability to align cross-functional teams around shared goals, priorities, and revenue-driving strategies.

  • Excellent project management skills, with a history of successfully leading and driving complex initiatives to completion.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate effectively across teams.

  • A proactive, problem-solving mindset, with a focus on continuous improvement and operational scalability.

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. jobs.description_html:
Director of Enterprise Customer Success

 

AcuityMD is the AI platform for MedTech trusted by over 500 MedTech companies – including 16 of the top 20. Commercial leaders use AcuityMD to identify target markets, surface top opportunities, and grow their business. By combining real-world healthcare data with AI-powered insights, AcuityMD enables companies from pre-commercial to enterprise to understand where and how to sell faster to accelerate the adoption of medical technology. AcuityMD ranked No. 316 on the 2026 Inc. 5000 list of the fastest-growing private companies in America and was named to Forbes' 2025 "Next Billion-Dollar Startups" list – an elite group of 25 venture-backed U.S. companies identified as most likely to reach a $1 billion valuation. AcuityMD is backed by Stepstone Group, Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, ICONIQ, and Atreides Management.

The Director of Enterprise Customer Success will lead Customer Success Managers (CSMs) focused on the Enterprise Segment ($5M-1B) accounts. In this role, you will lead a team of 7+ CSMs responsible for owning renewals, generating adoption, and driving customer satisfaction.

 

Team Mission

We are building a best-in-class Commercial Team and establishing a repeatable go-to-market motion. We are hiring a team of high-caliber Enterprise SaaS and Medical Device customer success professionals to thoughtfully engage VPs, General Managers, and other corporate decision makers and end-users across the Medical Device Industry. Our Customer Success team takes a proactive, consultative, and high-touch approach when working with customers, by engaging directly with end-users to generate platform adoption and running Executive Business Reviews to align with strategic initiatives and quantify and communicate ROI. This team builds documented, customer-confirmed value evidence — use cases, workflows, and outcomes — and turns it into ROI-backed expansion, with AI fluency, both the team's and our customers', as a core part of how that value gets built and proven.

 

Responsibilities

  • Drive customer retention and expansion by leading a team of CSMs focused on the Enterprise segment ($100M-$1B in revenue)
  • Directly manage the Enterprise Customer Success team, providing ongoing enablement, coaching, and development, including sharing and shaping Customer Success process, best practices, and strategies as well as hiring and developing CSMs for AI fluency within AcuityAI and internal workflows
  • Grow AcuityAI adoption across the book by enabling CSMs to turn platform usage into meaningful AI usage, which is a core retention and expansion lever.
  • Build team capability in reviewing AI quality signals and feeding them back to Product.
  • Own GRR forecast accuracy and CRM/pipeline hygiene, run renewal pipeline calls, and own renewal reporting to executive leadership.
  • Regularly monitor account health and user adoption across a large portfolio of accounts and report on key performance indicators to Customer Success and broader Commercial team leadership.
  • Engage directly with key customers through EBRs, events, kickoffs, SteerCos, escalations, and other workflows to communicate value, navigate risk, and support in the management of the commercial process as needed.
  • Provide support for CSMs in at-risk accounts.
  • Partner closely with sales, product, and services teams to advance AcuityMD's mission and approach to customer engagement.
  • Engage proactively, creatively, and constructively as a member of the CX leadership team.



Your Profile

  • 8+ years of experience in Customer Success or Account Management Enterprise SaaS
  • 3+ years of experience leading high performing teams as a Senior Manager or Director
  • Is AI-first in daily workflows and champions AI adoption and automation 
  • Proven ability to enable AI fluency and lead by example using AI in their own workflows
  • Comfortable running pipeline and renewal reviews, owning GRR and the renewal forecast, and applies a commercial mindset to renewal management 
  • Comfortable leading through change, stays calm under pressure, and communicates clearly even in ambiguity 
  • Displays strong independent judgment 
  • Operates as a true peer on the CX leadership team by helping shape strategy, challenging constructively, and supporting decisions made across the team 
  • Curious by nature — asks good questions and isn't satisfied with surface-level answers
  • Has led a team through significant change, including an AI-led product evolution 
  • Has stepped into an established team and earned trust while coaching to a clear, high bar 
  • Proven ability to manage large 100+ logo portfolio
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

 

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in venture-backed, growth stage companies
  • Medical Device or Life Sciences experience
  • Experience using CRM, ideally Hubspot

 

AcuityMD is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, market data and may vary from the range provided. Base salary range: $160,000- $200,000

 

You must have an eligible work permit in the USA or Canada to be considered for this position

 

We Offer:

  • Ground floor opportunity: Join a high-growth startup, backed by world-class investors across Enterprise SaaS and Medical Devices (Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, and Ajax Health).
  • Learning Budget: Reimbursements for relevant learning and up-skilling opportunities.
  • Remote work: AcuityMD is committed to supporting full-remote flexibility for employees in the US. We provide a work-from-home stipend for all employees.
  • Flexible PTO: Generous time off and flexible hours give you the freedom to do your best work.
  • Paid Health, Dental, and Vision Plans: We offer 100% paid health, dental, and vision plans for all employees and 75% paid for our employees' dependents.
  • Home Office Stipend: $1,000 to invest in remote office equipment and WiFi reimbursement.
  • Optional Team Retreats: We meet in-person multiple times per year for co-working and social gatherings.
  • Parental Leave: 8-16 weeks of fully-paid, flexible parental leave.

 

Who We Are:

The Company: We are builders, who are inspired by our mission to expand patient access to cutting-edge medical technologies. We value working collaboratively to solve hard problems for our customers with simple, innovative solutions. We push ourselves to learn with empathy. We foster an active culture of mentorship and inclusion, and we welcome new team members that share our values. We're backed by Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, Ajax Health, ICONIQ Growth and several other leading software and medical device investors. Since Acuity launched in 2020, we've brought on customers ranging from publicly traded Fortune 500 companies to innovative growth-stage companies and regional medical device distributors.

The Product: AcuityMD uses data and software to help teams collaborate around the complex relationships they have with the users of medical technologies: doctors. Our platform empowers medical technology companies to see how their products are used, understand why outcomes vary, and identify opportunities where physicians or sites of care can better serve their patients.

 

How We Work:

AcuityMD is a remote-first company. We believe the best talent isn't confined to one zip code, so our team works from wherever they do their best work, across the U.S.

We also believe some of our best work happens face-to-face. Critical projects move faster, our products get better, and our community gets stronger when we're in the same room, so we bring the team together throughout the year for company-wide and team on-sites built around that work.

In practice: expect 4-5 in-person opportunities a year through company/team on-sites and in-person collaboration for critical projects. If you're based near our Boston hub, there's no set requirement for how often you come into the office, that's your call, based on what works best for you and your team.

AcuityMD is seeking to create a diverse work environment because all teams are stronger with different perspectives and life experiences. We strongly encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. The Role

We’re looking for a Channel Account Manager (CAM) to accelerate growth across the western and central North American region. In this high-impact role, you will own the development and success of channel relationships, both new and existing, while working closely with Sales and Marketing to drive pipeline generation and partner enablement.

You will focus on the top 10-12 partners in your territory and drive partner-sourced pipeline and revenue across all partners in the region. Reporting directly to the VP of Channel Sales, you will act as a strategic business partner to help ensure high growth and continued success for our partners and for Adaptive.

This is a remote role, with preference for candidates located near our main office hubs (LA or SF).

Territories: WA, OR, CA, NV, ID, MT, WY, UT, CO, AZ, NM, AK, HI, ND, SD, NE, KS, OK, TX, MN,

IA, MO, AR, LA, WI, IL, MI, IN, OH

Responsibilities

  • Build and grow relationships with the top 10-12 focus partners in the West and Central

    US, mapping their sellers to Adaptive's AEs.

  • Drive partner-sourced pipeline and closed-won ARR against a quarterly target, with

    deal registrations, joint account planning and co-selling.

  • Work alongside Adaptive's AEs in the region so partners and AEs sell together.

  • Run partner enablement: train partner sellers and engineers on Security Awareness

    Training, Email Security and AI Governance.

  • Plan and attend partner events, lunch-and-learns and joint campaigns.

  • Manage the deal registration process for your partners and keep Salesforce and the

    partner portal current.

  • Work with our iCAM(s) on new-partner recruitment and long-tail support in the region.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in channel or partner sales in cybersecurity or enterprise software.

  • Established relationships with resellers and their sellers in the West and Central US. This matters most.

  • A track record of hitting partner-sourced revenue targets.

  • Comfort working with enterprise accounts and long, multi-stakeholder deals.

  • Strong Salesforce habits and comfort with a partner portal (Impartner experience a

    plus).

  • Willingness to travel within the region for partner meetings and events (up to 50%).

What We Bring

  • Competitive cash compensation & OTE.

  • Several medical plans to choose from, most covered at 100% by Adaptive.

  • 401k through Vestwell

  • Unlimited PTO, including winter break from Dec 24 - Jan 1.

  • Exposure to leadership and getting in early at a growing Channel function
