Working closely with leaders across health systems, you'll deepen adoption of Ambience from initial enterprise rollout into new care settings and new products. Your goal is to ensure Ambience delivers measurable clinical and financial outcomes as we grow our partnerships. As a trusted advisor, you'll align executive priorities with frontline needs to ensure Ambience enables better care at scale.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the commercial trajectory of every assigned account. You'll protect and grow revenue through renewals and expansions, build renewal readiness well ahead of contract expiration, qualify expansion opportunities as they emerge, and run the commercial boundary with Sales cleanly.

  • Take the handoff and run. You'll accept ownership of accounts at enterprise signature — stakeholder map, relationship history, deal context — and drive adoption, utilization, and executive engagement across the deployed footprint from day one.

  • Build high-trust partnerships with clinical, operational, financial, and IT leaders across your accounts. You'll be the face of Ambience to our health system customers, earning the confidence of stakeholders from the C-suite to the front line and turning alignment into momentum.

  • Open new ground inside your accounts. You'll generate demand for new products and care settings — building clinical champions, running new-SKU pilots, and producing the proof points that convert into expansion.

  • Shape and deliver clear ROI narratives that speak to what health systems care about. You'll align stakeholders on value methodology early, own QBRs and executive readouts, and build the economic evidence behind every expansion and renewal.

  • Set the account strategy and keep an honest view of account health. For each account you'll put the strategy on paper — customer context, partnership assessment, path forward, quarterly goals — and maintain a scorecard that rates partnership strength on evidence, not sentiment.

  • Make us better, together. You'll capture repeatable playbooks and account frameworks to help the entire Care Transformation team level up.

As a vertically integrated U.S. drone technology company, BRINC designs and manufactures unmanned aircraft systems, autonomous drone stations, command-and-control software, and advanced autonomy for public safety. Today, BRINC deploys Drone as First Responder (DFR) networks that dispatch drones directly to 911 calls, providing real-time aerial intelligence before ground units arrive and helping first responders make faster, safer decisions. Join the team turning internet intelligence into real-world security outcomes. Built on the world’s most comprehensive and accurate map of the Internet, the Censys Platform delivers real-time visibility and actionable intelligence needed to accelerate triage, investigate threats, hunt adversaries, and manage Internet exposure. We're trusted by half of the Fortune 500 and government agencies all around the world, and looking for people as passionate about the problems we're solving as we are. 

Censys’ mission is to be the one place to understand everything on the internet. Frustrated by the lack of trustworthy Internet intelligence, we set out to create the industry’s most comprehensive, accurate, and up-to-date map of the Internet. Today, Censys delivers real-time Internet intelligence and actionable threat insights to global governments, over 50% of the Fortune 500, and leading threat intelligence providers worldwide. With our Series D round and growth this year, it’s an exciting time to join a team that’s solving critical security problems. We’re looking for people who want to leave their mark on our culture, voice, and emerging industry.

The Role

As the Channel Account Manager, East US Enterprise, you’ll be responsible for activating, enabling, and expanding relationships with channel partners across the Eastern US enterprise market. Reporting to the VP of Strategic Alliances & Channel, your primary objective will be to accelerate revenue growth through Censys’ channel ecosystem.

You’ll own a portfolio of VARs and strategic channel partners, serving as a trusted partner and internal advocate. You’ll work closely with Censys’ Enterprise sales teams to identify opportunities, build partner-sourced pipeline, execute co-selling motions, and help partners confidently position Censys with enterprise customers.

This is a revenue-focused channel role. We have a strong partner ecosystem in place; your success will be measured by your ability to activate partners, create pipeline, and turn those relationships into productive, repeatable revenue channels.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own and grow a portfolio of East US enterprise channel partners, building relationships across sales, technical, and leadership teams.
  • Drive partner-sourced pipeline and revenue, partnering closely with Censys AEs on joint sales motions and strategic accounts.
  • Activate partners through account mapping, enablement, joint prospecting, opportunity development, and pipeline reviews.
  • Develop and execute joint GTM plans, including campaigns, events, webinars, and targeted enterprise sales plays.
  • Identify and develop enterprise opportunities, helping partners position Censys early in the sales cycle and expand within existing accounts.
  • Support partners through deal registration, procurement, and other channel processes to accelerate transactions.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise sales, marketing, solutions engineering, product, legal, and operations to accelerate partner-led opportunities.
  • Represent Censys at cybersecurity, enterprise, and channel events throughout the Eastern US, strengthening relationships across the technology ecosystem.
  • Provide regular visibility into partner performance, pipeline, market opportunities, and regional channel strategy.

What You Bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in channel sales or partner management role, with a proven track record of driving revenue through indirect sales motions.
  • Cybersecurity industry experience required, with experience selling through VARs, distributors, or other channel partners.
  • Experience working with enterprise customers and channel partners in the Eastern US market.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, negotiation, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels.
  • Highly organized and self-directed, with the ability to manage multiple partners, opportunities, countries, and priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Comfortable working across different cultures, markets, and time zones.
  • Willingness to travel within for partner and company events.

Censys is building the most credible, robust map of the Internet through IP scanning, DNS lookups, web crawling, and the ingestion of millions of certificates. Censys was founded by security researchers who are passionate about developing technology that provides anyone the power to fully understand their digital risk and exposure. Individuals and enterprises–and anyone in between–can harness this power to discover new information and insight as the Internet, IoT and Cloud evolve.  We are a true security startup with midwestern roots and we believe that a map of the Internet, or a map of your organization’s assets can quickly help guide organizations to the answers they need to protect themselves from vulnerability and risk.

Location: This position is remote within the United States. 

Role Summary: 

We’re looking to hire a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to build models and data-driven systems that help classify, label, and enrich vast amounts of Internet data, providing direct value to customers and other parts of our organization. Censys operates distributed infrastructure for Internet-wide scanning and you will help us continue our mission to transform raw Internet telemetry into high-quality datasets, classifications, and insights about the Internet at large.

At Censys, we believe in working iteratively, while keeping the big picture in mind. We’re expanding our data platform to enable future products and features that make the Internet more explainable by adding richer context and showing complex relationships. We’re looking for someone who is curious, collaborative, and excited to grow while contributing to our mission.

  • Build and improve machine learning models and data-driven systems that classify, cluster, label, and enrich Internet-observed assets and services.
  • Own the design and development of applied ML workflows that turn raw Internet telemetry into usable context for internal systems and customer-facing products.
  • Partner with engineering, research, security, and product teams to ensure we’re building the right models, datasets, and feedback loops to improve coverage and quality.
  • Leverage your experience in machine learning, data science, and software engineering to build various parts of the system, including components like: feature pipelines, training datasets, model evaluation frameworks, confidence scoring systems, and services that run in the cloud or on-prem.

  • 5+ years of experience in data science, machine learning engineering, or software engineering with applied ML responsibilities.
  • Experience building and deploying machine learning or statistical models in production environments.
  • Experience programming in Go/Python, and familiarity with software engineering practices for building maintainable systems.
  • Experience working with large datasets and building data pipelines for feature generation, training, or inference.
  • Proficiency with supervised and unsupervised learning techniques, such as classification, clustering, similarity scoring, or anomaly detection.
  • Ability to evaluate models using sound statistics and understand tradeoffs related to precision, recall, accuracy, and confidence.

  • Possess strong communication skills and can explain technical concepts, model behavior, and tradeoffs to engineers, researchers, and product managers.

  • Experience deploying models in containerized environments, like Kubernetes.

Role Summary

Censys is seeking a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join our Infrastructure and Operations Platform team. Our engineers ship Go services from a single monorepo onto Kubernetes in Google Cloud, and the speed and safety of the path from commit to production sets the pace for the whole company. We're looking for an engineer who can support that path end to end, treat our development teams as internal customers, and build the self-service platform that lets them create, deploy, and run their services with confidence.

What You'll Do

  • Own the developer path to production, from monorepo build tooling and CI in GitHub Actions through GitOps deployments with ArgoCD, Helm, and Crossplane, and drive it toward true continuous deployment
  • Design and build self-service platform capabilities, including service templates, a service catalog, repository tooling, and documentation, so development teams can stand up and operate new services without filing a ticket
  • Make observability a default rather than an afterthought, standardizing how our services capture the four golden signals (latency, traffic, errors, and saturation) with Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry
  • Build, secure, and maintain the container images and tooling that run our applications on Kubernetes and GCP managed services such as Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub, and Memorystore
  • Shift security left by building dependency scanning, static analysis, and image scanning into CI, working with our Security Operations team to keep it fast and actionable for developers
  • Lead troubleshooting of complex production issues alongside development teams, and participate in our shared on-call rotation, where SRE owns infrastructure and primary site uptime and development teams own their services end to end
  • Mentor engineers on the SRE team and across development teams on Kubernetes, CI/CD, and reliability practices, and contribute to the golden-path standards and shared libraries they build on

What You'll Bring

  • A positive attitude biased towards action and iterative problem solving, learning as we grow every step of the way
  • 5+ years of experience in site reliability, platform, or infrastructure engineering
  • Hands-on experience deploying, operating, and debugging applications on Kubernetes, including Helm-based deployments and building and securing container images
  • Experience running workloads on public cloud managed services (GCP preferred), such as managed databases, messaging, and caching
  • Fluency with infrastructure-as-code and GitOps workflows (Terraform, Crossplane, ArgoCD, or similar)
  • Experience with CI/CD in a monorepo, trunk-based development model (GitHub Actions or similar), and a strong desire to get to continuous deployment
  • Practical experience instrumenting and monitoring services with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar
  • Experience building automation and internal tooling in a language like Go or Python, not just writing configuration
  • Strong communication and empathy for developers. You seek out feedback from the teams you support, and explaining a BCDR tradeoff to product management should be as comfortable as walking an engineer through a failed deploy

What Sets You Apart

  • Experience supporting a gRPC microservice architecture, including a service mesh such as Istio for observability, multi-cluster routing, and traffic management
  • Comfort working in application code to introduce golden paths, shared libraries, and better test and integration environments. Most of our services are written in Go, with some Python and Scala. 
  • Working knowledge of infrastructure networking (load balancers, ingress, DNS, and VPC design). We operate globally distributed data centers alongside our cloud infrastructure
  • A history of automating away toil that others accept as permanent, such as manual release steps, environment setup, or flaky pipelines
  • Strong interest in harnessing AI and LLM tools as a force multiplier for platform work, from incident analysis to developer tooling and documentation

Trusted by organizations worldwide, Censys cuts through the noise to surface the most critical risks, enabling teams to respond faster, and stay ahead of attackers. Location: This position is remote within the United States.

Role Summary

Censys is seeking a Staff Networking Engineer-SRE to own networking across our hybrid infrastructure. Our platform scans the entire reachable internet from globally distributed data centers and serves that intelligence to customers in real time, which means the network is not a supporting layer for us, it is the product. We’re looking for an engineer who can set the technical direction for networking across data center, cloud, and edge environments, treat network infrastructure as software, and raise the reliability bar for every team that depends on it.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the technical direction for networking across our hybrid environment, spanning data center fabrics, GCP VPC design, Kubernetes networking, and the edge that protects our public-facing platform
  • Design and automate our core networking primitives (load balancing, ingress, routing, DNS, BGP peering, TLS termination) so that network changes ship through the same GitOps pipelines as application code
  • Lead our cross-datacenter resiliency program for the on-premises scanning platform, including failover architecture and scan platform workloads across globally distributed data centers
  • Own edge protection for a platform that both scans the internet and is highly visible on it, including DDoS mitigation, WAF strategy, and the traffic engineering that keeps scan and API infrastructure healthy
  • Set networking and reliability standards for the teams that depend on the network, identify the architectural opportunities and technical debt worth addressing before they become liabilities, and get cross-team buy-in for multi-quarter infrastructure initiatives
  • Act as a force multiplier for the SRE team, growing its networking depth through mentorship and durable engineering standards rather than becoming its single point of failure
  • Stay hands-on, serving as a senior escalation point for complex cross-layer incidents spanning application, Kubernetes, and physical network layers

What You’ll Bring

  • A positive attitude biased towards action and iterative problem solving, and a sense of ownership for the outcome of your work rather than the tasks assigned to you
  • Deep networking fundamentals. TCP/IP, BGP, anycast, DNS, TLS, and load balancing at scale should be second nature, not reference material
  • 10+ years of experience in network engineering, SRE, or infrastructure engineering, with a track record of owning networking in production and leading technical work across team boundaries
  • Experience building software to run networks: automation services, health checking, certificate lifecycle management, and traffic management tooling written in a language like Go or Python, not just device configuration
  • Experience operating hybrid environments that span physical data centers and public cloud (GCP preferred), including Kubernetes networking (CNI, ingress, service mesh)
  • Fluency with infrastructure-as-code and GitOps workflows (Terraform, Crossplane, ArgoCD, or similar) applied to network infrastructure
  • Demonstrated ability to drive architectural decisions across teams without formal authority, backed by clear written proposals and data
  • Strong communication skills. Explaining a routing incident to leadership and a BCDR tradeoff to product management should both be comfortable territory

What Sets You Apart

  • Experience running traffic management and delivery at large consumer scale (streaming, CDN, or global anycast footprints)
  • A history of automating away toil that others accept as permanent, such as TLS certificate rotation, failover testing, or capacity forecasting
  • Familiarity with internet measurement, scanning infrastructure, or the security domain, including how scan traffic interacts with peering relationships and abuse reporting
  • Strong interest in harnessing AI and LLM tools as a force multiplier for infrastructure work, from incident analysis to configuration generation
  • External knowledge sharing through conference talks, open-source contributions, or technical writing

For all other US locations, the expected salary range for this position is $172,000 USD – $216,000 USD, plus bonus eligibility and equity.

This is a fully remote position within the United States.

Chainguard’s product portfolio includes Chainguard Images and Professional Services. Customers range from Fortune 500 companies in banking, fintech, government and infrastructure to startups and SMBs. Join us as we help organizations secure their software supply chain from source to production. 

The role, in a nutshell:

As a Customer Success Manager at Chainguard, you will be the post-sales primary point of contact for our Commercial customers. You will be responsible for taking lead on customer engagements across onboarding, implementation, and adoption. In this role, you will work closely with Solutions Architects, Technical Support, Product Management, Engineering and Sales to ensure the successful onboarding and support of your customers. You are their day-to-day contact, building relationships with customers and driving outcomes, adoption, and delivering time-to-value.

What you’ll do:

  • Customer Onboarding: Lead the technical onboarding process for new customers. Partner with customers, pre-sales, and post-sales teams to understand requirements, goals, and challenges to formulate an onboarding plan.
  • Account Management: Develop relationships with multiple levels of customer stakeholders from technicians to CISOs. Work closely with sales teams to identify the best path to renew and expand customers while minimizing churn risks.
  • Training & Education: Collaborate with customers and our Edu team to ensure customers are educated on product features, best practices, and security principles.
  • Product Expertise: Develop hands-on technical knowledge of Chainguard and stay up-to-date with industry trends, new features, and best practices so you can help customers optimize their use of Chainguard.
  • Customer Advocacy: Act as the voice of the customer within the organization, advocating for customer needs and requirements to internal teams.  This means being a team player and having strong collaboration skills - this role must align with many different internal teams, influencing them to act toward customer needs.
  • Issue Management: Collaborate with Technical Support and Customer Engineering teams to ensure timely resolution to customer issues.

What we're looking for:

  • 2+ years experience in customer facing roles collaborating with both technical and business teams - Customer Success, Professional Services, Technical Account Management or a combination of those plus Sales, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Support.
  • Relevant domain knowledge of one or more of the following: Supply Chain Security, DevSecOps, AppSec, security infrastructure, containers, regulatory compliance requirements, vulnerability management, software development lifecycle.
  • This is a strategic and proactive role, our expectation is that this person will take full ownership of their customer portfolio and act with a high level of autonomy. This includes making key decisions to drive effective customer outcomes; deciding when to include our executive team or C-suite in customer escalations, how to de-risk or de-escalate customer issues and conflict, and advocating to internal teams including sales, product, engineering, etc.
  • An entrepreneurial mindset - you will be required to both deviate from established procedure and often build entirely new processes or practices to ensure we best serve customers.
  • Demonstrates a strong commitment to continuous personal and professional development, actively seeking opportunities to enhance skills, expand knowledge, and advance within their career and field.
  • Driven, high emotional intelligence, and strong priority management skills

jobs.title: GSI Partner Sales Engineer - AMER
jobs.description_html:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk. 

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The Global Systems Integrator (GSI) Partner Solutions Engineer is a partner-facing technical role focused on Chainguard's relationships with GSIs. GSIs sell and deliver large cloud, security, and platform modernization programs, so this role works within partners' practices, delivery teams, and pursuit teams to make Chainguard part of how those programs are designed, scoped, and delivered. The GSI PSE builds technical champions across practices and regions, turns Chainguard into repeatable GSI offerings and accelerators, and supports joint pursuits that drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue.

Key responsibilities

Partner technical strategy and enablement

  • Build and maintain technical champions across each GSI's practices (cloud, security, platform engineering, application modernization) and regions, so Chainguard becomes the default recommendation for secure software supply chain work.
  • Design enablement for delivery scale: train-the-trainer programs, role-based learning paths, and certification tracks for architects, engineers, and pre-sales staff, supported by hands-on labs, Capture The Flags, and hackathons.
  • Create and maintain reusable assets that delivery teams can use directly in engagements: reference architectures, migration runbooks, demo environments, solution briefs, and pursuit-ready content.

Offerings, accelerators, and solution design

  • Work with GSI practice leads to turn Chainguard into packaged offerings, such as vulnerability reduction assessments, container and library migration factories, secure platform build accelerators, and managed-service add-ons.
  • Identify and validate integration use cases with the GSI's DevOps, security, and platform teams, and with the hyperscaler practices they sell alongside; work with Chainguard product and engineering to bring them to life.
  • Help each GSI embed Chainguard in its delivery methodology, tooling, and reference architectures so it is used by default on new engagements.
  • Contribute to scoping, effort estimates, and statement-of-work language for Chainguard-related services.

Pursuit support and go-to-market acceleration

  • Support GSI pre-sales and capture teams on active pursuits, including RFI and RFP responses, solution design, technical orals, and proof-of-value plans.
  • Run technical workshops and assessments that the GSI can deliver to its own customers, to shorten sales cycles, strengthen the value proposition, and increase win rates.
  • Collaborate closely with Partner Managers and Sales to attach Chainguard to GSI-led opportunities, drive co-sell motions, and grow partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue across each GSI's key accounts and geographies.
  • Co-author blogs, webinars, talks, and solution briefs with GSI practices to amplify the joint value proposition.

Account planning, alignment, and roadmap

  • Own the technical plan for assigned GSIs: map practices, regions, and key delivery accounts, identify executive sponsors (global alliance leads, practice heads, CTO office), and set quarterly joint goals aligned to the BEPIC framework.
  • Shape each GSI's progression from introduction to deep-dive, certification, and service build-out, and track delivery readiness: certified practitioners, active engagements, and offerings live.
  • Keep regional teams and global alliance teams aligned on one message and one plan across a matrixed GSI organization.

This role requires someone who can think strategically, influence cross-functional decisions, and drive complex initiatives from strategy through execution. You'll help shape how we operate as we scale, with a focus on automation, data-driven decision-making, and delivering a consistent, customer-centric experience.

What you'll do:

Customer Success Operations Strategy & Execution

  • Own and execute the Customer Success Operations roadmap, prioritizing initiatives that improve customer experience, operational efficiency, and scalability.
  • Partner with CS leadership to translate organizational priorities into measurable operating plans, processes, and performance expectations.
  • Support capacity planning, resource allocation, and productivity modeling across Customer Success, Professional Services, and Support.
  • Identify operational gaps and lead cross-functional initiatives that improve how our post-sales teams operate.

Systems Strategy & Operational Infrastructure

  • Own the strategy, implementation, and optimization of our Customer Success technology ecosystem, ensuring systems support business needs as we scale.
  • Partner with Business Systems and IT to drive integrations, automation, and data integrity across Salesforce, CS platforms, support systems, and product analytics tools.
  • Establish scalable processes and workflows that reduce manual effort and improve visibility across the customer lifecycle.
  • Evaluate and recommend tools and technology investments that improve operational efficiency and the customer experience.

Renewals Strategy & Operations

  • Lead the operational implementation of our Renewals function, including forecasting processes, quota tracking, performance measurement, and renewal workflows.
  • Establish reporting and analytics around renewal attainment, gross revenue retention (GRR), net revenue retention (NRR), churn, and contraction.
  • Partner with CS, Sales, and Finance to improve renewal predictability, identify retention risks, and establish clear accountability for revenue outcomes.
  • Develop scalable processes for renewal engagement, risk identification, escalation, and cross-functional coordination.

Performance Measurement & Business Insights

  • Establish KPIs, reporting frameworks, and executive dashboards that measure customer outcomes, retention, and operational productivity.
  • Analyze performance trends and translate insights into actionable recommendations for leadership.
  • Drive consistent business reviews and operating cadences to evaluate performance, identify risks, and prioritize improvements.
  • Support annual planning through data analysis, productivity benchmarks, and operational recommendations.

Process Optimization & Customer Experience

  • Design and implement scalable processes across onboarding, adoption, customer engagement, renewals, and support.
  • Establish operational playbooks, service-level expectations, and accountability frameworks that improve consistency and execution.
  • Partner cross-functionally to identify friction points in the customer journey and implement improvements that drive customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Lead change management, enablement, and adoption for new processes, systems, and initiatives.

What we're looking for:

  • 7+ years of experience in Customer Success Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Operations, or a related function within B2B SaaS.
  • Proven experience owning operational strategy and leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in a high-growth environment.
  • Strong understanding of Customer Success operating models, SaaS retention metrics, renewal forecasting, and customer lifecycle management.
  • Experience building and scaling operational processes, systems, and performance measurement frameworks.
  • Deep Salesforce expertise and experience working with CS platforms, support systems such as Zendesk, and product analytics tools.
  • Strong analytical capabilities, including forecasting, financial modeling, performance reporting, and translating data into business recommendations.
  • Experience partnering with senior leadership across Customer Success, Finance, Sales, and Business Systems.
  • Ability to independently identify business challenges, develop solutions, and influence decisions across functions.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and change management skills.

The role, in a nutshell:

Chainguard secures the software supply chain, and we're standing up a new team to build a new product inside it.

Agents now write a large and growing share of the world's code, and they inherited a CI system designed for humans who push a few times a day. Write, push, wait in a queue, reinstall the same toolchain, scrape the logs, try again. Agents iterate far more often than people do, so they feel every minute of that, and the workarounds they've grown are worse than the thing they're working around. We don't think the fix is a faster version of the CI you already have. We think CI gets rebuilt for agents, and that's what we're doing.

The product isn't launched, so a job post is the wrong place for the details. What we can tell you now: the team is small, the hard technical pieces already run in production inside Chainguard, and you'd be driving the product direction. 

What you'll own:

  • Strategy and roadmap. Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the product. Decide what we build first, what comes next, and what we're not going to do.
  • 0→1 product work. Take this from a system that works for us to a product customers buy and use. Bring structure to problems that don't have any yet, make the tradeoff calls, and get things in front of users before they feel finished.
  • How agents actually build software. Go deep on how developers and their agents write, test, review, and ship code today, including the parts nobody blogs about. Most of what's written about agentic development is aspirational. You'll work from what people really do.
  • Design partners. Find the teams whose agent fleets are big enough to hurt, get the product into their hands early, and turn what they tell you into priorities.
  • Developer experience. Adoption is the whole game here. Own how the product gets tried, configured, and lived with, so a team can move onto it without running a migration project.
  • Launch. Positioning, naming, docs, the pricing model, and the story, with Product Marketing and the rest of Product. You're also the person who says when it's ready.
  • Cross-functional leadership. Partner with Engineering, Experience, Product Marketing, and other Product leaders, and keep a small team pointed at the same thing while the space shifts underneath it.

jobs.title: Director, Finance Strategy & Operations
jobs.description_html:
At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI-native platform integrated with 60+ EHRs.

Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”

Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.

The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.

About the Role

We're hiring a Director, Finance Strategy & Operations to be the connective tissue of the finance organization and the DRI for the cross-functional programs that make finance work with the rest of the business. This is not a forecasting seat and not an accounting seat. It is a process, technology, and alignment seat: when we need to stand up quote-to-cash, build a customer data cube, redesign the planning calendar, or integrate an acquisition's finance stack, this is the person who owns the outcome, wrangles every team involved, and drives it to done. You’ll work directly with the most senior leaders of the company and drive the change that will enable this company to grow past $1B, helping a pre-IPO healthcare technology finance team that is building its infrastructure for scale. Critically, you'll also be a force multiplier for how finance adopts AI and LLM tooling in its own processes.

What You'll Do

  • Own Cross-Functional Finance Programs End-to-End: Serve as the directly responsible individual for multi-team initiatives spanning finance, revenue operations, engineering, legal, people, and product (e.g., quote-to-cash, customer and contract data cube, planning-to-close handoffs, M&A finance integration). Set scope, define success, sequence the work, and own the result.

  • Delegate Without Losing Accountability: Break programs into workstreams, assign them to the right owners across the org, run the cadence that keeps them moving, and personally unblock what stalls. You keep the whole picture even when you aren't doing every piece.

  • Build Strategic Alignment with the Business: Translate between finance and operators. Get sales, product, engineering, and corporate leaders to agree on definitions, owners, and timelines, and make sure finance processes reflect how the business actually runs rather than how finance wishes it ran.

  • Operate in a High-Visibility Seat: Your core stakeholders are the Head of FP&A, the Head of Finance, the Chief Legal & Corporate Officer, and the CEO. Expect to brief executives directly, frame the decisions they need to make, and be the face of finance on the programs you own.

  • Design Processes and the Systems Behind Them: Map current-state processes, design future state, and partner with Business Systems, Engineering, and vendors to implement. Own the finance-side requirements and acceptance for tools across the stack (NetSuite, Salesforce, planning platforms, data warehouse, internal tooling).

  • Take Any Project and Run With It: Act as the jack-of-all-trades the finance leadership team can hand an ambiguous, high-priority problem to with confidence that it will get structured, staffed, and finished.

  • Drive AI & Automation Into Finance Processes: Identify where LLM and automation tooling removes manual steps in the processes you own, pilot them, and institutionalize what works. Partner with the AI & Technology Finance lead on standards and governance.

  • Prepare the Finance Org for Scale: Document processes, controls, and ownership so that finance can grow toward IPO-readiness without linear headcount growth.

How You'll Spend Your Time

  • Day-to-day: Run program standups and workstream check-ins; unblock owners; draft requirements, decision memos, and process maps; field cross-functional questions that don't have an obvious home in finance.

  • Week-to-week: Steering meetings with program stakeholders; status and risk updates to finance leadership; alignment sessions with RevOps, Business Systems, Engineering, Legal, and People; review of in-flight system changes and their finance impact.

  • Month-to-month: Program milestone reviews; retrospectives on the close and forecast cycles with recommendations for process fixes; operating rhythm updates (calendar, OKR progress, decision log); AI/automation pilot reporting.

  • Quarterly & annual: Launch and land major programs; refresh the finance process and systems roadmap; coordinate the annual planning calendar across finance and the business; prepare finance-org readiness assessments (controls, documentation, audit, IPO).

Your Impact

  • Programs Actually Finish: Cross-functional finance initiatives that historically stalled between teams get a single owner and ship.

  • Finance and the Business Speak One Language: Shared definitions, owners, and timelines for the data and processes that connect the P&L to the operating reality (customers, contracts, sites, usage, headcount).

  • Leverage for Finance Leadership: The Head of Finance and Head of FP&A get back the hours they currently spend coordinating, and gain a trusted operator who can represent finance in any room.

  • Scalable Infrastructure: Process, systems, and governance that hold up through audit, diligence, and public-company readiness.

  • A More Automated Finance Org: Measurable reduction in manual steps across the processes you own, with AI and automation embedded where it earns its place.

What You'll Have

  • 8+ years across FP&A, strategic finance, business operations, finance transformation, consulting, and/or chief-of-staff roles, with a tour of duty in a high-growth, unstructured environment

  • A track record as the DRI on large cross-functional programs (e.g., quote-to-cash, ERP or planning-platform implementations, data warehouse or reporting builds, M&A integration) that you drove to completion through people who did not report to you

  • Strong process orientation: you instinctively map current state, define future state, assign owners, and set a cadence

  • Fluency across the finance stack and the business systems that feed it (NetSuite, Salesforce, planning platforms such as Pigment/Anaplan/Adaptive, data warehouses, internal tooling); comfort writing requirements and acceptance criteria for engineers and vendors

  • Enough finance and accounting literacy to understand what the close, the forecast, revenue recognition, and the board deck need from a process, without needing to own the numbers yourself

  • Hands-on LLM literacy (e.g., Claude Cowork & Code) and a point of view on applying AI to finance operations

  • Excellent written and verbal communication; able to run a steering meeting with VPs, write a one-page decision memo, and brief the CFO in two minutes

  • Low ego, high ownership; comfortable being accountable for outcomes you don't fully control

  • Familiarity with SQL and low/no-code dashboarding tools (e.g., Retool, Looker) is a plus

  • Experience in healthcare SaaS, pre-IPO environments, M&A integration, and/or program management certification (PMP, Lean/Six Sigma) is a plus

Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in @commure.com. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization.

Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI-native platform integrated with 60+ EHRs.

Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”

Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.

The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.

About the Role

Commure Ambient is our Ambient AI platform. A clinician records the visit, and a finished note lands in their EHR, along with ICD codes, orders, a Patient 360 summary, and carried-forward history on supported systems. For a physician, that means charting is done when the visit is done.

Practices decide on Ambient by trying it: their own providers, their own patients, inside their own EHR. As a Sales Engineer on the Ambient team, you'll own those pilots from the first scoping call through a signed contract and hand-off to implementation.

This is a presales role. You'll partner with Account Executives on Commure Ambient pilots and on advanced AI pilots with healthcare practices: coding, orders, Patient 360, carry forward, and pre-visit summaries, running live inside ten EHRs (athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, AdvancedMD, ModMed, NextGen, Practice Fusion, WebPT, Prompt, iKnowMed, and Meditech Expanse). You'll typically have several pilots in flight at once, and you'll work closely with Engineering, our template team, and our implementation and operations teams to make each one succeed.

What You'll Do

  • Scope pilots. Lead the technical scoping call for each pilot, working directly with the providers who'll use Ambient and the decision makers evaluating it. Capture specialty, note types, EHR, and workflow, and turn it into a technical scope the deal can move forward on.

  • Build EHR integrations. Stand up the integration for each pilot across browser automation, DOM injection, and API paths. Our target from approved requests to a live integration the customer can use. When a note doesn't land in the chart, you'll find out why and fix it.

  • Bring advanced AI into the pilot. Confirm which beyond-the-note features the customer's EHR supports, configure them, and help providers put them to work: ICD coding, orders, Patient 360, carry forward, and pre-visit summaries.

  • Get templates right. Translate gold-standard notes and specialty requirements into template requests for our template engineering team, and triage template updates during the pilot on a 24-hour SLA.

  • Keep pilots healthy. Own the pilot Slack channel as the thread of record, triage in-pilot requests (template, integration, app feature) within 24 hours, and keep status and usage current in Salesforce so the AE always knows how the pilot is going.

  • Enable the sales team. Field integration and feature questions from AEs, help run the weekly integrations sales desk where engineering commitments to deals are made and tracked, and own the technical sections of RFPs and security questionnaires.

  • Hand off well. Deliver each new customer to implementation with the integration, templates, provider list, and known issues documented, so go-live picks up right where the pilot left off.

  • Make the team better. Escalate integration and product findings to Engineering with clear reproduction steps, and help build the tooling and playbook (debugging queries, checklists, wiki) that lets the next SE ramp faster than you did.

What Success Looks Like

  • Pilots start on the date we committed to the customer.

  • In-pilot issues are triaged within speed and urgency

  • Providers in your pilots are using Ambient, and where the EHR supports it, coding, carry forward, and Patient 360.

  • Your pilots convert, and implementation can pick up your hand-offs without rework.

What You Have

  • 3–7 years in sales engineering, solutions engineering, implementation, or healthcare IT. Engineers who want to spend more time with customers are welcome.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one ambulatory EHR (athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, AdvancedMD, NextGen, ModMed, Practice Fusion, WebPT). Epic, Cerner, or Meditech Expanse is a plus.

  • Comfort reading and debugging an integration: browser automation, DOM, REST APIs, JSON schemas, HL7/FHIR. You can use SQL and internal tooling to figure out why a note didn't land.

  • The ability to explain to a physician or technical teams how ambient AI builds a note, where it can miss, and what to do about it, in plain language.

  • Strong organization. You can juggle several pilots across multiple EHRs, keep Salesforce current, use Slack as your thread of record, and write updates that are short and specific.

  • Healthcare fluency: clinical documentation, specialty workflows, HIPAA, and the security questionnaires (SOC 2, HITRUST) that come with selling into practices.

  • A strong sense of ownership. Pilots launch on an SE's approval, and you take that responsibility seriously.

What We Offer

  • Live pilots from your first weeks, with providers using what you built.

  • Work at the frontier: LLM-generated notes, codes, and orders landing in production EHRs at real practices, every week.

  • A close working relationship with Product and Engineering. What you learn from customers shapes what we build next.

  • Documented SLAs, a written playbook, and a team that helps you ramp.

  • A clear path into Forward Deployed Engineering, enterprise Sales Engineering, or Product.

  • Competitive compensation and benefits.

Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in @commure.com. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization.


Employees will act in accordance with the organization’s information security policies, to include but not limited to protecting assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction or interference nor execute particular security processes or activities. Employees will report to the information security office any confirmed or potential events or other risks to the organization. Employees will be required to attest to these requirements upon hire and on an annual basis.

Value Engineering is a consultative team that supports the Cribl sales and GTM organization and engages customers to explore the business value of Cribl. In this highly cross-functional role, you'll collaborate with teams from sales, solutions engineering, product marketing, and customer success. Approximately 80% of your time will be focused on customer engagements and ~20% of your time will be working on broad GTM and value selling scale projects.   1. Boosting win rates,
  2. Speeding up sales cycles,
  3. Reviving dormant opportunities,
  4. Increasing deal sizes, and
  5. Enhancing deal margins.


As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will...

Your Impact

  • Engage, Consult and Influence: Partner with sales teams and customers, employing a value-based selling approach to create compelling narratives and business cases. You'll help the customer answer the 3 key questions: "Why change?", "Why Cribl?", and "Why now?"
  • Lead Discovery Sessions: Conduct technical value discovery sessions with senior executives and technical staff, asking questions and providing insights that help shape their business case for Cribl.
  • Craft Business Cases: Develop comprehensive business cases for new business, expansions, and cross-sell opportunities, as well as value realization analyses to propel renewals.
  • Innovate and Build: Create value discovery questions, financial models, and frameworks for new use cases and products. Develop and maintain a value metrics database for internal and customer use.
  • Empower Sales Teams: Enable our sales teams to become proficient with self-serve value content and tools, ensuring they can independently explore and communicate value to customers. 
  • Travel Opportunities: Enjoy a dynamic role that includes occasional travel (10% to 20%) throughout the year. There is the usual customer travel, but what you should really look forward to is Cribl Kickoff, which occurs over a week each year. It’s an incredible time to engage, learn and most importantly, have fun with other Criblians.

If You’ve Got It - We Want It

  • Driven and Collaborative: You have a strong work ethic, a "get things done" attitude, and thrive in a team environment. Looking for someone who has grit.
  • Detail-Oriented and Analytical: Your structured thinking and keen eye for value enable you to create detailed and accurate business cases. You excel in financial analysis and modeling, particularly around TCO and ROI concepts.
  • Proactive and Adaptable: You're a self-starter who thrives in unstructured, fast-paced environments and enjoys taking ownership of projects.
  • Trusted Advisor: You build and maintain strong relationships with customers and sales teams, providing valuable insights and guidance.
  • Polished Communicator: You can present complex analyses clearly and persuasively, both verbally and in writing.
  • Selling Expertise: Familiarity with Force Management, Challenger Selling, MEDDPPICC and 3 Why methodologies.
  • Technical Expertise: You have expert-level skills in Google Sheets and Slides. Being familiar with tools like Omni, SFDC, Clari, Decision Link, Ecosystems, Mediafly, and Spotlight is a plus.Educational Background: A Bachelor's degree is required, with a preference for business management, finance, accounting, economics, information systems, or computer science. A MBA from a top-tier institution is highly preferred.
  • Experienced Professional: For the Senior VE role looking for 5 to 10+ years in enterprise software strategy / business operations, technology / management consulting, investment banking or value engineering. 
  • Technical Knowledge: Familiarity with networking, cloud infrastructure, IT operations, observability, and/or security is a plus.
  • You live in the West Coast
  • As a Value Engineering team we breathe, eat and drink the four key values below …
    • Demonstrate Accountability & Extreme Ownership: Proactively identify challenges and drive solutions. Do not call out a problem without proposing a solution or framework to find a solution. We are all equity holders - act like an owner. 
    • Manage Ambiguity & Complexity: Like pioneers crossing the great plains, we must thrive in a VUCA (Volatile, Uncertain, Complex, and Ambiguous) world. We utilize frameworks and curiosity to break down complex business problems into clear, actionable insights.
    • Embracing a Continuous Improvement Mindset: Continuously push the envelope. "What is 'done'?" It is the enemy. We are OBSESSED with pushing the envelope. Status Quo? Don’t know her. Our competitors always get a say so even when we are operating at the top of our game, there is a need to continue to push the envelope and improve on the margins to stay on top.

jobs.title: Solutions Architect - East
jobs.description_html:
About Us

AI coding is the largest use case of enterprise AI adoption today, as is evident from the success of Anthropic on Claude Code, Cursor’s $60B exit to SpaceX, and Cognition’s $48B valuation.

The bottleneck now has moved from code generation to security and safety - AI agents write code faster than any team can review it, and over 65% of the lines of code produced by them are insecure. Vulnerabilities are piling up 16x faster than companies can fix them, and adversaries are able to exploit these new vulnerabilities within hours.

AURI by Endor Labs closes that gap. It runs inside the harness where coding agents work, through hooks, skills and MCP, so the controls sit outside the model and every agent action is visible. Underneath is our patented code context graph, which maps code, open source, containers and infrastructure. It shows which vulnerabilities can actually be reached and exploited, then delivers fixes that won’t break the application. Security teams get evidence instead of noise, and developers get fixes instead of tickets.

The companies building AI trust us to secure it - our customers include OpenAI, SpaceX, DoorDash, Dropbox, Atlassian, MongoDB, Snowflake, Robinhood and Peloton to name a few.

Endor Labs is the third company from Founder & CEO Varun Badhwar, who built Prisma Cloud, the platform that helped define cloud security, from $0 to $300M ARR at Palo Alto Networks. We’ve raised $163M from Lightspeed, Coatue, DFJ Growth, Salesforce Ventures and Dell Technologies Capital.

Software runs everything around our lives today - banking, hospitals, airports and power grids. AI now writes more of it every day, and our mission is to make sure the world can trust that software. Come build that future with us.

How You’ll Make an Impact

As a Solutions Architect at Endor Labs, you're at the heart of connecting our innovative team with our diverse and dynamic customers. Every day presents a new set of exciting challenges and opportunities to make a significant impact:

  • Educate with Enthusiasm: Elevate awareness about Application Security and Software Supply Chain Security. It's about making security engaging and accessible to developers everywhere.
  • Master Our Tech: Deep dive into our supply chain security product suite and emerge as the go-to expert and evangelist.
  • Deliver Tailored Demos: Showcase our solutions in a way that speaks directly to the needs and challenges of our customers. Be the architect of captivating, solution-oriented presentations.
  • Shape Customer Outcomes: Collaborate with our engineering and product teams to design solutions that genuinely address customer challenges. Your insights from the field will directly influence our product development, ensuring we always meet our customers' evolving needs.
  • Facilitate Customer Success: Guide customers through onboarding, ensuring a smooth transition and adoption of the Endor Labs solution. Your goal is to empower customers to leverage our technology fully and ensure they achieve their security and development objectives.

What You Bring to the Table

We're on the hunt for someone who is not just looking for a job but likes a bit of adventure, too! You'll fit right in if you have:

  • Rich Experience: You have experience in pre-sales or a similar customer-facing, technical role. You're no stranger to technical deep dives, product demonstrations, and leading evaluations.
  • Strong Technical Foundation: A solid understanding of modern software development practices, including backend or full-stack development experience, CI/CD pipelines, Git-based development workflows, and DevOps tooling. You’re comfortable engaging deeply with engineering teams and understanding how modern applications are built and deployed.
  • Application Security Awareness: Familiarity with application security concepts, software supply chain security, and/or identity & access management principles. You understand the importance of securing developer workflows and modern cloud-native environments.
  • Tech Savvy: A robust understanding of the Developer, DevOps, Application Security, and open-source ecosystems. Hopefully, you can meet developers where they are and flex some programming skills.
  • Customer & Sales Skills: You've successfully engaged with technical customers at an Enterprise level and know how to articulate complex solutions and operate in a sales cycle.
  • Curious and Eager to Learn: Always on the lookout for new technologies and understanding the intricacies of how things work.
  • Collaborative Spirit: You thrive in a team setting and value diversity and inclusion in every interaction.
  • Action-oriented: You prefer actively solving customer problems and asking for help as needed.

What Makes Us... Us

  • Go to extraordinary lengths to distinguish ourselves through world-class work.
  • Prioritize quality over speed, and speed over scope.
  • Desire to work with deeply kind, mission-driven people.
  • Strive to make the complex simple.
  • Use first principles to debate ideas, test assumptions, and make decisions.
  • Seek the truth by putting data above opinions.
  • Assume good intent and give tactical feedback to help each other get better.
  • Hold no ego—when our customers win, we all win.

What We Offer You

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package including Health, Dental, Vision and Mental Health plans. 
  • 401(k) plan to support your longterm financial goals.
  • Flexible PTO to maintain a healthy work-life balance (we want you here for the long-haul!)
  • Opportunities for co-working and team meetups to foster collaboration.
  • A dog-friendly office environment for those who love to bring their fur babies along.

Endor Labs is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Even if you don't fit every requirement above, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and experiences, so we encourage all talented individuals to apply—there's no one-size-fits-all here.

Compensation: For candidates who receive an offer for this position, the compensation range is expected to be between $190,000 - $250,000. This may include additional incentives such as commission targets, restricted stock units, and/or bonuses, depending on the role.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description_html:
Form Health is a virtual obesity medicine clinic delivering multi-disciplinary evidence-based obesity treatment through telemedicine. Obesity impacts more than 40% of the US adult population, and although historically only about 1% of patients received medical treatment for their disease, the field of Obesity Medicine is entering a period of rapid growth. Form Health provides high-quality expert care and leverages technology to enhance the patient experience. All Form Health patients work closely with their care team, which includes board certified physicians, advanced practice professionals and Registered Dietitians. Through our proprietary mobile app patients engage in regular video visits, as well as text messaging, photo journaling, digital data transmission, and customized educational materials. We hold ourselves to the highest standards of clinical care, and to treating every individual with empathy and respect. 

Founded in 2019, Form Health is a venture-backed innovative startup with an experienced clinical and leadership team. Our mission is to empower patients and be leaders in Obesity Medicine driving impact at a national scale. We are deeply invested in our core value to put patients first, and also deeply committed to creating a culture where every employee is valued and we learn and improve together.

 

About the Role:

The Care Delivery team builds the tools that let our clinical team run a high-performing virtual practice — from prescribing and prior authorizations to the day-to-day workflows clinicians rely on to do their best work with patients. This role is highly visible within Form Health: the tools you ship directly shape how our clinical team practices and, downstream, how our patients experience care. We're looking for someone who's genuinely energized by hard, regulated, multi-stakeholder problems — with clinical, patient, payer, and operational constraints — as well as someone who uses AI as a real part of supercharging their work, rather than a buzzword on a resume.

This role will report to our Lead Product Manager for Care Delivery, with significant ownership from day one and plenty of room to help shape how the practice scales as the team grows. This role is fully remote and can be located anywhere in the U.S. (Note: while not required, it is beneficial to be in or close to the Eastern Time zone given frequent collaboration with our Boston-based clinical and operations leaders)

What You Will Do:

  • Deeply understand Form Health's clinical and business needs: identify and prioritize jobs-to-be-done using research and user feedback
  • Own key care delivery capabilities end-to-end — e.g., prescribing, prior authorizations, virtual visit workflows 
  • Partner with clinical leadership to triage and prioritize incoming product requests, balancing clinical needs against broader roadmap priorities
  • Translate business and user needs into clear product requirements, including user stories, use cases, and functional specs
  • Partner with engineering, design, operations, and clinical teams to ship best-in-class tools for our clinical practice
  • Track key program and product metrics for your area, and report on progress and health to Form Health's leadership team
  • Facilitate sprint planning, standups, backlog grooming, and  retrospectives to keep the team aligned and shipping
  • Partner with clinical education and enablement to roll out new features  smoothly — change management, communications, and training
  • Identify where AI and automation can responsibly reduce clinical or administrative burden (e.g., documentation, prior-auth workflows, care coordination), and partner with engineering to evaluate and ship those capabilities thoughtfully

About You:

  • 5+ years building enterprise experiences with complex workflows
  • Comfortable diving into technical problems — APIs, workflows spanning homegrown and third-party systems
  • Clear communicator cross-functionally in a remote-first environment
  • A track record that includes:
    • Evaluating third-party vendors and driving coordination across multiple systems
    • Defining where a product should go, rallying a team behind it, and delivering results iteratively
    • Owning a product area end-to-end — strategy and prioritization through rollout and adoption
  • Fluent in using AI as part of your own PM craft — drafting specs, synthesizing research, prototyping — and curious about where AI can responsibly augment clinical operations
  • Proactive ownership over your area of responsibility, with a strong sense of accountability and an execution-oriented mindset — comfortable applying structure to ambiguous situations in a fast-growing startup
  • Genuinely excited to make compassionate, evidence-based healthcare accessible — and energized, not deterred, by the complexity of a regulated, high-stakes domain

Preferred:

  • Understanding of healthcare, virtual care delivery, or health insurance 
  • Experience shipping AI-powered features, ideally within a tech-enabled services organization
  • Prior experience in a startup and/or high growth environment

More about Form Health’s benefits:

  • Competitive salary and equity in a high growth start-up
  • Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision) 
  • 401k program
  • Flexible work schedules and paid time off
  • Paid parental leave

 

Base Annual Salary
$150,000—$180,000 USD

Form Health’s commitment to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive work environment:

Form Health is committed to creating a culture and environment that celebrates diversity and inclusion, while fostering safety and belonging. This extends from our remote patient care to our corporate offices and everywhere in between. We are looking for team members who want to help us further our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) efforts and who share our attitudes for creating an inclusive, safe, and positive work environment. 

Work Authorization: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States by their start date. Form Health does not provide employment-based immigration sponsorship for this position.

jobs.title: Account Executive - Mid-Central
jobs.description_html:
What you’ll be part of

Garner is on a mission to transform the U.S. healthcare system — and we’re the only proven player doing exactly that. We partner with employers to redesign how healthcare works: applying 550+ proprietary clinical metrics across 80+ specialties to a dataset of 320M+ patients to identify the best-performing doctors, then using compelling incentives to steer members to the care that helps them get healthier, faster.

The result is a rare “win win” — better care and lower costs for both members and employers. In just five years, our work has helped over 2.5 million people access higher-quality care and saved $1B in healthcare costs. We recently raised our Series E and have doubled five years running. If you've ever wanted your work to solve a problem that touches every person in this country, this is the opportunity to do exactly that. You'd be joining a team fundamentally reimagining healthcare in the U.S. — and using AI to scale that impact further and faster than anyone else can.

Who we want

This is a role for someone who wants to work on a hard problem, deliver real impact and be pushed to be the best version of themselves. As an Account Executive in the Mid-Central Region, you will report directly to the VP, Employer Sales - Mid-Central. Candidates for this role will be required to be based in the territory they are handling

The Account Executive will deliver strong sales results within the Mid-Central market in the 50-249 life segment. This role’s focus is relationship management within our partnership ecosystem of benefits brokers, consultants, general agents and employers. You will carry your own quota, activating new brokers, deepening the partners already producing for Garner, and opening the next wave of top-producing advisors. It is a build-and-close role: you fill your own pipeline, run deals end to end, and put in place the tracking that keeps your territory predictable. Every partner you activate puts higher-quality, lower-cost care in reach for more members.

What you will do

  • Own revenue responsibilities for your specific territory within the Mid-Central region, which includes: MI, IN, OH, KY, MD, DC, VA, WV
  • Continue and expand on Garner’s existing broker relationships
  • Develop foundational infrastructure and processes for tracking our sales and partnership pipeline

What we're looking for

  • Experience in a quota-carrying channel or partner sales role
  • A desire to work in a rapidly evolving startup environment with notable upside
  • A desire to be a part of our mission to improve the healthcare system
  • Experience selling benefits-adjacent products or in healthcare is a plus, but not required
  • Candidates for this role will be required to be based in the territory they are handling
  • Strong ability to present and communicate a value proposition to external stakeholders
  • A desire to do work that matters: and to be held to a high standard while doing it. You're energized by a mission with measurable outcomes, not just good intentions. You engage with AI tools as part of how you do your best work, and hold yourself accountable to outcomes that matter beyond your team’s metrics.

What you’ll get here

You’ll work on problems that matter, at a company working to change healthcare at scale. You’ll work at the intersection of AI and systemic healthcare reform, where the problems we solve are as interesting and compelling as the mission.

At Garner, you’ll take on real, ambitious problems with real ownership and autonomy, alongside exceptional, principles-based people who genuinely want you to win. It’s demanding by design. You’ll be challenged to stretch beyond what you thought possible and receive consistent coaching to help you grow and do the best work of your career. This isn't the right fit for everyone, and that's intentional. The people here are driven by what's at stake for real people, and that's what gives our intensity its purpose. 

Please note: we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Compensation

The target total comp (inclusive of base + bonus) range for this role is $160,000 – $175,000. Individual compensation will depend on qualifications, skills, and applicable laws.

In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible to participate in our equity incentive plan and benefits package, including: flexible PTO, Medical/Dental/Vision plan options, 401(k) with company match, flexible spending accounts, Teladoc Health, and more.

Few roles offer this combination: work that is genuinely hard, a mission that is genuinely important, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. If that’s what you’re looking for, we’d love to meet you.

You will own a critical component of Garner's provider segment as a quota-carrying seller, selling our solutions into hospitals, health systems, ACOs and clinically integrated networks, physician groups, and digital health companies. Garner is headquartered in NYC, but this position is available for individuals who are comfortable with remote work and occasional travel to HQ.

  • Own and advance a provider-segment pipeline end to end, from segmentation and prospecting through close, carrying an individual quota against your assigned budget.

  • Partner with Product, Sales leadership, and Account Management, feeding market signal back into the roadmap and handing off closed accounts cleanly.
  • Contribute to a repeatable playbook for the segment: messaging, target-account strategy, and objection handling grounded in healthcare economics and provider risk.
  • Build working fluency across Garner's full product suite and match the right product angle to each buyer.

  • 5 or more years in fast paced selling environment carrying and consistently exceeding individual quote
  • Experience as a builder, helping design the selling motion as you go

  • Demonstrated quota attainment you can name: percentage attainment, President's Club, or marquee logos closed.
