jobs.title: Director of Technology Alliances
jobs.description_html:
About Gray Swan

Gray Swan is on a mission to empower the world to use AI safely and securely. We evaluate AI models for the leading frontier labs along with building real-time threat detection and adaptive adversarial red teaming agents for teams deploying AI.

We're a team of approximately 70 people, well-funded, growing quickly. Our work directly influences how the world deploys AI agents and systems at scale..

Learn more about how we work.

The Role

We’re looking to hire a Director of Technology Alliances to join our growing GTM team and build the partnerships that put our AI security technology inside other companies' products and platforms. This is a builder role with a clear focus: OEM and embedded deals, and co-sell and co-build relationships with the hyperscalers (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud) and leading AI platform providers.

You will own the strategy, pipeline, and executive relationships for this motion end-to-end — from identifying the right OEM targets, to structuring and negotiating licensing and revenue-share agreements, to driving the joint go-to-market that turns signed deals into recurring revenue. You’ll work across the business, partnering closely with our founders, Product, Engineering, Research, Legal, and Marketing teams

What you will do

  • Build the OEM motion: Define Gray Swan's OEM strategy: which platforms, model providers, security vendors, and SaaS companies should embed our red teaming and runtime protection, and why. Build the target list, the business case for each, and the pipeline to land them.

  • Source, structure, and close OEM deals: Lead complex, multi-stakeholder negotiations covering licensing models, white-label and embedded terms, revenue share, minimum commitments, SLAs, and support obligations. Partner with Legal and Finance on deal structure and with Product and Engineering on integration scope.

  • Own hyperscaler relationships: Build executive and field-level relationships across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform. Lead marketplace listings, co-sell programs (e.g., AWS ISV Accelerate, Microsoft co-sell, Google Cloud Partner Advantage), private offers, and committed-spend alignment so that buying Gray Swan is easy for hyperscaler customers.

  • Drive joint go-to-market: Turn signed agreements into revenue: joint solution briefs, partner enablement, field alignment, co-marketing, and shared account planning. Make sure partners' sellers know when and how to bring Gray Swan in.

  • Be the voice of the partner inside Gray Swan: Feed partner and integration requirements into the product roadmap. Work with Engineering to scope APIs, SDKs, and deployment models that make Gray Swan easy to embed.

  • Define the metrics that matter: Set and report on partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, OEM ARR, marketplace transacted revenue, time-to-first-deal, and partner productivity.

  • Lay the foundation for scale: Help us build the broader partner program — resellers, MSSPs, and technology alliances.

Who You Are

  • 8+ years in partnerships, alliances, or business development in cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, or enterprise software, including direct ownership of partner-driven revenue.

  • A track record of sourcing, negotiating, and closing successful OEM, embedded, or white-label agreements, with deals you can describe in terms of structure, size, and revenue impact.

  • Hands-on experience working with at least one hyperscaler (AWS, Microsoft, or Google Cloud), including marketplace listings, co-sell programs, or private offers.

  • An existing network at the hyperscalers and at security or platform vendors.

  • Comfort with technical products: you can explain APIs, integrations, and deployment models to engineers and business leaders alike.

  • Experience operating in an early-stage or high-growth company, where you built the playbook rather than inherited it.

Nice to Have

  • OEM deals with security vendors (SIEM, XDR, cloud security, API security, DLP) or with AI and model-platform providers.

  • Familiarity with the AI security and safety landscape: LLM red teaming, prompt injection, agent security, AI governance, and emerging regulation.

  • Experience building a partner function from zero, including the first hires, programs, and compensation plans.

  • Experience at a company that scaled through major growth stages.

You’ll Thrive Here If You:

  • Want to help define how enterprise AI safety and security software is sold.

  • Enjoy learning complex products and explaining them clearly to customers.

  • Are motivated by ownership, accountability, and upside rather than rigid structure.

  • Are excited by Gray Swan’s mission to help organizations deploy AI safely and securely.

What We Offer:

A competitive compensation package designed to reward impact and incentivize growth. Our compensation philosophy is informed by our current valuation and recent industry data.

  • Base salary is targeted to $180k-200k plus meaningful performance-based compensation

  • Meaningful equity participation

  • Work from our office in Pittsburgh, or remotely

  • Opportunity for outsized earnings driven by high inbound interest and large deal sizes

Benefits:

  • 401k with up to 4% matching

  • 28 days annual leave (vacation + holidays)

  • Health, dental, and vision coverage

  • Catered lunches (Pittsburgh office)

  • Flexible work arrangements

Typical Interview Process

🔎 Application review. We read everything.

🗣 Recruiter Screen. We learn about you; you learn about us.

🧑‍💻 Hiring Manager Interview.

💻 Role related assessment

🗣 Experience & culture interview

😇 Reference checks. We’ll reach out to 3-5 references that you provide.

📃 Offer. If it’s mutual, we move fast.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description_html:
About Gray Swan

Gray Swan is on a mission to empower the world to use AI safely and securely. We evaluate AI models for the leading frontier labs along with building real-time threat detection and adaptive adversarial red teaming agents for teams deploying AI.

We're a team of approximately 50 people, well-funded, growing quickly. Our work directly influences how the world deploys AI agents and systems at scale.

Learn more about how we work.

The Role

As a Machine Learning Engineer at Gray Swan AI, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of AI safety solutions.

Research at Gray Swan AI is tightly tied to real-world impact. AI security is not a solved problem, and this role is a mix of applied research and system building: developing new approaches to adversarial testing, model evaluation, and robust inference that directly inform how secure AI systems are deployed in practice. You will work at the boundary between research and production, translating novel ideas into scalable AI systems that withstand adversarial pressure.

Your expertise in state-of-the-art deep learning architectures, distributed systems, and parallel computing will enable you to tackle complex challenges associated with resource-intensive models. You will be responsible for advancing our methodologies for controlling, monitoring, and analyzing these models, ensuring they meet the rigorous demands of production environments.

Join Gray Swan AI to work alongside leading minds in AI safety and apply your technical depth to problems that genuinely matter!

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the design, development, and deployment of advanced machine learning models to enhance system performance and scalability.

  • Tackle complex challenges associated with resource-intensive models using distributed systems and parallel computing.

  • Advance methodologies for controlling, monitoring, and analyzing machine learning models in production environments.

  • Develop new approaches to adversarial testing, model evaluation, and robust inference.

  • Translate research ideas into scalable AI systems deployed in real-world, adversarial settings.

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure research outcomes inform production systems.

Who You Are

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Engineering, or a related technical field is required.

Experience

  • Experience in building and deploying machine learning models and systems.

  • Demonstrated expertise in designing, training, and deploying deep learning models with frameworks like PyTorch.

  • Strong programming experience in Python and C++ (preferred)

  • Practical experience developing scalable machine learning pipelines and integrating them with cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).

  • Experience conducting ML research, including building research prototype systems, experiment design, empirical analysis of results, and communicating results via publications.

  • Good to have: experience with modern ML methods such as LLMs (training, finetuning, and/or analyzing), synthetic data generation pipelines, and AI safety or security work.

Core Technical Skills

  • In-depth knowledge of neural network architectures, including sequence models, transformers, and other state-of-the-art approaches.

  • Strong algorithmic problem-solving skills and comprehensive knowledge of ML theory and optimization techniques.

  • Proficiency in data preprocessing, transformation, and handling large-scale, multi-modal datasets.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Experience with AI safety practices such as model validation, robustness testing, and continuous monitoring for safety and security incidents throughout deployment.

  • Experience with AI safety and security assessments and adversarial testing.

You’ll Thrive Here If

  • You are genuinely excited by the intersection of research and engineering, and want to both develop new AI safety ideas and see them running in real systems.

  • You are motivated by real-world impact and want your work to directly influence how major AI companies deploy models right now (we work with many of the leading AI labs).

  • You are eager to deepen your AI safety expertise by working alongside a team that includes some of the most respected and influential thinkers in the field.

  • You thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment where ambiguity is expected.

  • You bring strong collaboration and problem-solving skills, with a focus on driving meaningful, lasting impact.

We offer a competitive compensation package designed to reward impact and incentivize growth. Our compensation philosophy is informed by our current valuation and recent industry data.

Benefits:

  • 28 days annual leave (vacation + holidays)

💻 Role related assesment

This is a high-impact technical role, reporting to the VP, AI Engineering, where you will architect the systems and frameworks that power the next generation of AI-driven vulnerability discovery.

At HackerOne, we embrace a Flexible Work approach that gives us the freedom to do our best work while also fostering the connections and community that make us stronger. Reflecting this philosophy, this is a role targeted for candidates within ~50 miles of Seattle, WA. We believe this balance of proximity and flexibility gives Hackeronies the chance to occasionally come together – fostering collaboration, connection, and in-person moments that enrich our culture – while still preserving the benefits of remote work. Must be able and willing to come to the office once per week (typically Thursdays).

 
 

Primary Responsibilities

Success in the Staff AI Engineer role will be accomplished by delivering on the responsibilities below in alignment with the Talent Principles that define how we work at HackerOne.

  • Architect and enhance our autonomous security agent “Hai,” building intelligent systems capable of natural-language reasoning, vulnerability detection, and actionable recommendations, all grounded in an AI-First mindset.

  • Build components and services that integrate agentic AI design patterns—such as orchestration, memory systems, RAG, long-horizon tasks, and LLM-based models—into the HackerOne platform, applying an AI-First approach to improve vulnerability detection and security automation.

  • Partner across Product, Security Research, and Engineering to introduce AI capabilities into the broader HackerOne ecosystem. As the company evolves rapidly, bring clarity and stability to shifting requirements by demonstrating strong Change Agility.

  • Design and implement AI red-teaming agents and frameworks that proactively surface weaknesses in LLMs, generative-AI systems, and applied AI deployments, using First Principles Problem Solving to break problems down and build durable, foundational solutions.

  • Establish meaningful metrics, observability, evaluation frameworks, and continuous feedback loops to improve model performance, safety, and user impact—ensuring decisions are grounded in Data-Driven Decision Making.

  • Stay current with emerging AI safety research, adversarial-testing techniques, and agentic-system patterns, and integrate those learnings into HackerOne’s responsible-AI strategy with adaptability and a growth-oriented Change Agility mindset.

  • Build APIs and integrations that enable seamless interaction between AI models, security tools, and the broader HackerOne platform, ensuring security, scalability, and interoperability across systems.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience as a software engineer, including deep experience building and maintaining production-grade AI platforms and infrastructure.

  • Must be able and willing to come to the office once per week (typically Thursdays).

  • Proven expertise in large language models (LLMs), generative AI, and machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Transformers in production environments.

  • Strong hands-on experience in AI platform engineering, including model deployment, MLOps pipelines, model serving infrastructure, and shared AI services architecture.

  • Experience building systems that support multiple AI product teams and applications, enabling scalable experimentation and deployment.

  • Solid understanding of AI safety and alignment principles, including responsible AI development, bias mitigation, and ethical AI practices.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building AI development platforms, model registries, experimentation frameworks, and tools that accelerate AI innovation across organizations.

  • Familiarity with ReAct, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel for agentic orchestration and multi-agent collaboration.

HackerOne is a global leader in Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) and the only solution provider that pairs the simultaneous trust of the Fortune 500 and the world's largest community of security researchers to secure the AI-native enterprise. The H1 Platform unites agentic AI solutions with security researchers ingenuity to continuously discover, validate, prioritize, and remediate exposures across code, cloud, and AI systems. Through solutions such as agentic and human offensive security testing, AI red teaming, code security, validation, and remediation, HackerOne delivers measurable, continuous reduction of cyber risk for enterprises. Industry leaders, including Anthropic, Crypto.com, General Motors, Goldman Sachs, Lufthansa, Uber, UK Ministry of Defence, and the U.S. Department of Defense, trust HackerOne to safeguard their digital ecosystems. HackerOne was recognized in Gartner’s Emerging Tech Impact Radar: AI Cybersecurity Ecosystem report for its leadership in AI Security Testing.

HackerOne Values

Employees, researchers, customers, and partners Win Together by fostering empowerment, inclusion, respect, and accountability.

Remote Location: Austin, TX; Boston, MA or Washington, DC

As a Strategic Enterprise Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted strategic advisor to some of our most complex enterprise customers, helping them maximize the value of HackerOne's platform, advance their security programs, and achieve meaningful business outcomes.

jobs.title: Principal Frontend Engineer
jobs.description_html:
About Us:

Havoc is a leader in all-domain collaborative autonomy. Its software-defined hardware approach powers military and commercial-grade autonomous systems across sea, air, and land to sense, decide, and act together in complex and contested environments. Havoc connects assets, enabling them to share information, adapt in real time, and continue operating even when communications are disrupted or denied. Havoc optimizes mission performance and minimizes human risk.

Havoc was founded in 2024 and headquartered in Providence, Rhode Island. Learn more at Havoc: All-Domain Collaborative Autonomy .

About the Role

HavocAI is seeking a Principal Frontend Engineer to help architect, build, and scale the real-time interfaces operators use to command autonomous systems across air, surface, and subsurface domains.

Our operators command autonomous vehicles across air, surface, and subsurface domains through a single real-time geospatial interface. Live position and state data streams continuously onto a map, and the decisions made on that screen affect vehicles operating in the real world.

We are looking for a Principal Frontend Engineer with deep, hands-on experience building and scaling real-time geospatial applications. You have taken systems like this through significant growth in data volume and entity count, and you know from experience which problems arrive at each stage and how to get ahead of them. You will work directly with the Head of Frontend and a strong senior team, bringing that experience to the technical decisions that shape how the platform grows.

This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports.

What You’ll Do

Frontend Architecture & Real-Time Systems

Geospatial Engineering

  • Bring proven, production-tested patterns for high-frequency real-time data in React applications: transport-to-render design, update throttling, and keeping telemetry off the render path

  • Guide the design and evolution of the map layer system: layer lifecycle, interaction state, feature identity, and rendering performance on large feature sets

  • Work with the Head of Frontend and senior engineers on scaling decisions, contributing the perspective of someone who has made them before

  • Build alongside the team: implement the hard parts, set the example in code, and review with an eye toward what will hold up at scale

  • Identify performance and architectural risks early, before they become incidents

  • Communicate technical decisions clearly through design reviews, technical proposals, and code, building alignment without creating unnecessary process

  • Mentor senior engineers in real-time and geospatial engineering

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years of frontend engineering experience, including significant experience operating at Staff, Principal, or equivalent technical scope.

  • Deep production experience building and scaling high-volume, real-time applications.

  • Expert-level experience with React and TypeScript, including a first-principles understanding of React’s rendering model and frontend performance.

  • Deep experience building map-based geospatial applications using MapLibre, Mapbox GL, Deck.gl, or equivalent technologies.

  • Demonstrated experience optimizing large and dynamic geospatial feature sets.

  • Hands-on experience scaling a real-time application through significant growth in tracked entities, update frequency, or data volume.

  • Experience with multiple real-time communication technologies such as WebSockets, MQTT, gRPC-web, SSE, or similar protocols.

  • Deep browser performance expertise across rendering, memory, CPU, networking, and GPU bottlenecks.

  • Experience designing client-side data architectures using workers, batching, caching, state boundaries, and other techniques for isolating high-frequency workloads.

  • Experience designing applications for degraded or intermittent connectivity, including reconnection and state reconciliation.

  • Strong software architecture and systems-design fundamentals.

  • Demonstrated ability to make sound technical tradeoffs and sequence architectural changes within a production system.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence technical direction without relying on formal authority.

  • High ownership and comfort operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous engineering environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience taking an internal operational tool to a multi-tenant product

  • Data visualization depth (D3, custom charting, large-dataset rendering)

  • 3D and WebGL: three.js, custom shaders, terrain, or vertically distributed asset rendering

  • Experience with defense, aerospace, robotics, or other operationally critical systems

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 12 months, you will have:

  • Helped establish a frontend architecture capable of supporting significantly greater numbers of autonomous assets, telemetry streams, and real-time updates.

  • Improved the performance, responsiveness, and reliability of HavocAI’s geospatial interfaces.

  • Established scalable patterns for real-time data ingestion, state management, geospatial rendering, and degraded-connectivity scenarios.

  • Identified and addressed architectural risks before they became constraints on product or platform growth.

  • Raised the technical bar across the frontend organization through hands-on engineering, design reviews, architecture, and mentorship.

Benefits:

  • 100% Employer paid Health Insurance

  • Dental and Vision Insurance for you and your families

  • Life Insurance (Employer Paid)

  • Ability to participate in the companies 401k program (Matching)

  • Unlimited PTO policy with an enforced 2 week minimum

  • Equity Package

  • Work / Home Office Stipend

  • Global Entry

  • 16 Week Paid Parental Leave

  • Monthly Health and Wellness Stipend


Our Values:

  • Innovation: We are driven to break new ground. Every day presents an opportunity to challenge the status quo, think boldly, and deliver advanced solutions that transform the future of defense technology.

  • Integrity: We hold ourselves to the highest ethical standards, ensuring transparency, accountability, and trust in all our actions and partnerships.

  • Mission-Driven: We are focused on achieving impactful outcomes that align with our core mission—protecting lives through innovation.

  • Forward-Leaning: We continuously seek out new opportunities and remain at the forefront of technological advancements. We embrace change and anticipate the challenges of tomorrow with confidence and creativity.

  • Ownership of All Tasks: At HavocAI, no problem is too complex or too trivial. We believe that greatness comes from tackling the hardest challenges, but also in handling the smallest, sometimes thankless, tasks with the same level of commitment and care.

  • Servant Leadership: We lead by serving others, whether it’s supporting our employees, partners, or the broader community. Empowering those around us is key to achieving long-term success and making a lasting impact.

HavocAI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Customer Success Director
jobs.description_html:
About Healthleap

Every day, millions of hospitalized patients who need intervention are missed because clinicians simply can't see everything. Healthleap is building the AI operating system that helps care teams identify these missed patients, enabling them to improve health outcomes and generate millions of dollars. Healthleap is changing what is possible: closing gaps that traditional workflows and clinician capacity could never.

Over the past year, we've grown contracted revenue more than 13x, expanded rapidly across leading health systems, and now help care teams identify patients across millions of inpatient encounters.

We've raised $38M, backed by Sequoia, First Round and Hummingbird. SF-based and in person. And we're delivering results that are changing lives.

Why this role

The most critical part of building healthcare technology is building partnerships that last: earning the trust of executives, proving value in the language of finance and quality, and turning a successful first deployment into a long-term relationship that keeps growing.

As a Customer Success Director, you own the health and growth of a portfolio of HealthLeap's health system relationships. You'll define how HealthLeap retains, expands, and scales your portfolio of health system partnerships as we expand into a multi-condition platform. You'll work directly with founders, product leadership, and data science, bringing the customer's voice into every critical decision.

What you'll do

  • Serve as the primary strategic partner to executives and key decision-makers across a portfolio of health system partners

  • Build broad, trusted relationships early, from the C-suite to operational leaders, and deepen them throughout the partnership, not just at renewal

  • Own retention and renewal, and partner with our sales team on expansion into new service lines and facilities

  • Define success with each partner in clinical, operational, and financial terms, and lead executive business reviews that show progress and set the next step

  • Work closely with our clinical and implementation colleagues so they have the sponsorship and organizational alignment they need to drive adoption

  • Spot risk early and get ahead of it

  • Bring the customer's voice into product, data science, and company decisions

  • Help build the playbooks for how customer success at Healthleap scales as we grow

What we're looking for

  • Substantial experience (typically 7+ years) in customer success, strategic account management, consulting, or a related role, and a track record of growing complex, senior-level relationships

  • Experience working with health systems or other large, complex organizations. Deep healthcare experience is a plus; so is experience bringing new technology into established environments

  • Comfort with data: you can read a dashboard, build a business case, and tell the story behind the numbers to CFOs, CIOs, and CMOs

  • Strong commercial judgment about retention, expansion, and value

  • Thrive with ownership and ambiguity in a fast-moving, early-stage company

  • Work well across clinical, technical, and product teams, knowing when to lead and when to enable

  • Willing to travel regularly for site visits, business reviews, and key partner milestones

A note on fit

If you're excited by the mission and bring most of what's above, we'd like to hear from you, even if your background doesn't match every line.

If you're passionate about applying frontier AI to real-world impact, join us in building healthcare's future.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager
jobs.description_html:
About The Role

Hello Patient is hiring a Strategic Account Manager to own the health, retention, and growth of our customer accounts from signature through post-go-live. You will be the primary relationship holder for your accounts, responsible for ensuring customers consistently realize value from Mia, identifying risks early, and helping customers expand how they use HelloPatient over time.

This is a proactive, ownership-driven role. You’ll maintain a clear, up-to-date understanding of how each account is performing, monitor key signals to catch issues before they escalate, and partner closely with internal teams to drive resolution.

Customers should view you as a trusted partner, essentially an extension of their team who understands their business, not just a point of contact for a software vendor.

While you’ll stay involved during the initial implementation to establish the relationship and ensure smooth handoffs and communication, your core responsibility ramps up after go-live to own the customer experience, manage communication and expectations, and be accountable for long-term customer success.

What You'll Do

Own Account Health

  • Track how the agents are performing across your accounts, including containment, transfers, and reschedule, cancel and confirm rates. Dig into anything unusual before the customer notices it.

  • Review call logs and transfers to find where the agent falls short, and suggest fixes to the call flow.

  • Turn issues into clear tickets for Product and Engineering, follow them through to resolution, and keep customers updated along the way.

Manage Customer Relationships

  • Be the day-to-day point of contact for your accounts. Build a trusted advisor relationship so customers see you as part of their team, not just a vendor contact.

  • Run regular check-ins and program reviews, and send a clear status recap after each one.

  • Support customers through soft launch, go-live and ongoing agent updates, like new locations, providers, voice and script changes.

  • Work with Product, Engineering, QA, Sales and Solutions to get customers what they need, and wear whatever hat the day calls for.

  • Join onsite visits, whiteboarding sessions and industry events.

Drive Performance & Growth

  • Build recurring performance reports and use them to help customers understand the value they're getting from Mia.

  • Help build ROI models from customer data and turn them into clear stories for customer leadership.

  • Spot expansion opportunities, such as new agents, chatbot, billing, referrals and new locations, and help Sales and Solution Engineers scope them.

  • Support order forms, renewals and invoicing follow-up.


What We're Looking For

Must have:

  • 3+ years in account management, customer success or a similar client-facing role.

  • Strong written and verbal communication. You can read between the lines, build excitement and handle pushback with confidence.

  • A strong storyteller who can turn data into a clear story about value.

  • Collaborative and works well with cross-functional teams. You're happy to wear multiple hats.

  • Strong attention to detail, so nothing falls through the cracks between customers and internal teams.

  • Comfortable with data. You can work in spreadsheets, read dashboards and explain what the numbers mean.

  • Proactive and comfortable with ambiguity. You know when to solve a problem yourself and when to escalate.

  • You love building from the ground up. You're open to change, can pivot quickly and do well in a fast-paced startup.

Preferred:

  • Experience in healthcare, health tech or working with medical practices.

  • You use AI or automation tools every day to work faster.

  • Background in practice operations, revenue cycle or patient scheduling.

  • Some exposure to SQL, BI tools or call center metrics.

Compensation

Base salary: $90,000 – $135,000

Equity: Meaningful ownership in a fast-growing healthtech startup

About Hello Patient

Hello Patient is transforming healthcare communication through advanced conversational AI. Our founding team spent 3.5 years scaling Carbon Health's technology during hypergrowth, where we saw firsthand how much clinical time gets wasted on basic communication—great clinicians buried in admin work, patients stuck in phone tag.

Our AI platform proactively engages patients through perfectly timed calls and texts, resolving complex interactions end-to-end—from scheduling to billing to retention. Built with security and compliance at its core, our technology integrates with existing healthcare infrastructure to deliver 24/7 patient engagement.

Backed by Scale and 8VC, we're building the future of healthcare communication, one conversation at a time.

jobs.title: Field Engineer
jobs.description_html:
Field Engineer

Who we are

Helsing develops artificial intelligence-enabled capabilities to protect and defend democracies. We are growing our US operations, cultivating an ambitious and committed team of mission-driven professionals to apply their skills to solve challenging problems.

The role

As a Field Engineer, you will be responsible for deploying, integrating, testing and troubleshooting Helsing's hardware and software products in real world environments. Working across our engineering, product and field teams, you will help ensure our systems perform reliably under operational conditions.

This is a hands on role for someone who enjoys working with complex technology, solving practical problems and getting products out of the lab and into the field. You will support test campaigns, work directly with equipment and end users, and provide feedback to our engineering teams to help improve product performance, reliability and usability.

You will play an important part in connecting product development with real world application, helping Helsing deliver robust capabilities to the people who depend on them.

The day-to-day

  • Assemble, configure, deploy and test combined hardware and software products, both in the lab and in the field, capturing data and providing structured feedback to Helsing's mechanical, electrical, software and AI engineering teams.
  • Prepare, transport, mobilise and demobilise equipment at test locations, including ports, offshore military test ranges and remote environments, supporting testing in real world conditions at sea.
  • Install and configure AI software on edge computing devices using Helsing's in-house deployment tools, ensuring systems are correctly set up for field conditions.
  • Execute test plans and procedures, documenting results, identifying issues and supporting the investigation and resolution of technical problems.
  • Troubleshoot hardware, electrical and software issues in the field, implementing practical fixes where appropriate and escalating more complex problems to the relevant engineering teams.
  • Support the development and improvement of test procedures, safety documentation and standard operating procedures, helping ensure field activities are conducted safely and consistently.
  • Maintain field equipment, test hardware, tools and inventory, ensuring everything is prepared and available ahead of deployments and test events.
  • Work alongside end users during demonstrations, trials and operational testing, providing technical support and helping them understand how to use Helsing's products.
  • Capture feedback from field activities and communicate findings clearly to internal engineering and product teams, helping inform future product improvements.
  • Support the preparation and delivery of training activities and provide ongoing technical assistance to end users.
  • Travel to testing locations across the US. 
  • Work closely with Helsing's UK and European Field Engineering teams, sharing knowledge and adopting consistent practices across the wider organisation.

You should apply if you

  • Have strong technical aptitude and enjoy understanding how complex hardware and software systems work, particularly when diagnosing why something isn't working as expected.
  • Have experience assembling, deploying, testing or troubleshooting robots, aircraft, watercraft or other autonomous or electromechanical systems.
  • Are comfortable with software deployment and debugging tools, including command line interfaces, and can work across hardware and software environments.
  • Have practical experience diagnosing and resolving hardware and electrical issues, carrying out field repairs or implementing temporary fixes to keep systems operational.
  • Can follow technical documentation, test procedures and safety requirements, while also recognising when something needs further investigation or escalation.
  • Communicate clearly in writing and speech, producing concise technical documentation and explaining issues effectively to both engineering and non engineering audiences.
  • Are comfortable working independently, taking responsibility for assigned tasks and adapting when priorities or conditions change.
  • Are happy working in practical, hands on environments, including remote test locations and outdoor conditions.
  • Are comfortable travelling to test sites and spending periods of up to two weeks away when required.
  • Work well as part of a multidisciplinary team and enjoy collaborating with engineers, technicians, product teams and end users.

Note: We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

Nice to Have

  • Experience testing hardware and/or software products at different stages of maturity, from early prototypes through to production systems.
  • Experience working with autonomous platforms, unmanned aerial systems (UAS), unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs), robotics or other complex electromechanical products.
  • Experience working at remote field sites, military ranges or in operational environments.
  • Familiarity with edge computing devices, embedded systems, networking, sensors and system integration.
  • Experience using command-line tools to install, configure, deploy and troubleshoot software.
  • Experience supporting or training end users on complex hardware and software products.
  • Familiarity with test equipment, diagnostic tools, electrical systems and practical hardware repair.
  • Prior military experience, particularly involving weapons systems, operational testing, CONOPS or tactics.
  • Experience working across different technical functions, including Field Engineering, AI/Software, Hardware and Product.

Join Helsing and work with world leading experts in their fields

  • Helsing's work is important. You'll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns.
  • The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world.
  • Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward.
  • In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts.
  • We actively encourage healthy, proactive and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn't work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about.

What we offer

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Detection and Tracking
jobs.description_html:
Who we are 

Helsing develops artificial intelligence-enabled capabilities to protect and defend democracies. We build Altra, an AI-powered drone software platform, and HX-2, our autonomous drone. We are growing our US operations, cultivating an ambitious and committed team of mission-driven professionals to apply their skills to solve challenging problems. 

The role 

You will own the detection and tracking models that power Helsing's products — training, tuning, and deploying models against US-specific datasets. This is an applied ML role: you won't be writing research papers, but you will be expected to have strong intuition for model performance, data quality, and the practical trade-offs involved in getting detection and tracking systems to work reliably in production. You will manage the full model lifecycle — from assessing and curating training data through annotation, training, evaluation, and deployment to edge platforms. 

The day-to-day 

  • Training and fine-tuning detection models (YOLO, DETR, Faster R-CNN, and similar architectures) on mission-specific datasets 
  • Implementing and improving multi-object tracking pipelines (SORT, DeepSORT, ByteTrack, or similar) 
  • Evaluating model performance: analyzing metrics, diagnosing failure modes, and iterating on data and model improvements 
  • Managing the data pipeline end-to-end: assessing raw data, coordinating annotation, curating datasets, and implementing augmentation strategies 
  • Optimizing models for deployment on SWaP-constrained and embedded platforms (quantization, pruning, TensorRT, ONNX export) 
  • Collaborating with systems engineers to integrate models into the broader Altra platform 
  • Working across sensor modalities as needed, including electro-optical, infrared, and other imaging sources 

You should apply if you 

  • Have 5+ years of experience in applied machine learning or computer vision 
  • Have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field; Master's or PhD strongly preferred 
  • Have production experience training and deploying object detection models — not just research or academic projects 
  • Are proficient in Python and PyTorch or a comparable deep learning framework 
  • Have strong intuition for data quality; you can look at annotated datasets, training curves, and evaluation metrics and know what's wrong 
  • Have experience with the full model training lifecycle: data curation, annotation management, training, evaluation, and deployment 
  • Have experience optimizing models for deployment on SWaP-constrained and edge platforms (TensorRT, ONNX, quantization) 
  • Understand multi-object tracking and have implemented or worked with tracking algorithms in practice 
  • Can read and contextualize scientific papers in computer vision and apply findings to production systems 
  • U.S. citizenship required 

Nice to have 

  • Strong proficiency in Rust or C++ for production model deployment and optimization 
  • Experience with multiple sensor modalities — particularly infrared or thermal imaging 
  • Familiarity with MLOps tooling: experiment tracking (MLflow, Weights & Biases), dataset versioning, model registries 
  • Experience with annotation tools and workflows (CVAT, Label Studio, or similar) 
  • Background in computer vision beyond detection — segmentation, pose estimation, activity recognition 
  • Experience with simulators, emulators, or synthetic data generation for training and evaluation 
  • Experience deploying models on GPU-accelerated embedded platforms (NVIDIA Jetson, similar) 
  • Background in defense, intelligence, or other mission-critical environments

jobs.title: Junior Chief of Staff
jobs.description_html:
At Jukebox Health, our mission is to empower everyone to live safer, healthier, more independent lives at home. We partner with health plans to make homes safer and more accessible for older adults and high-needs populations. We achieve this by combining technology with networks of clinicians, suppliers, and installers to deliver personalized home modifications and environmental supports nationwide. Founded by experienced entrepreneurs, Jukebox Health is a fast growing healthcare services company backed by top venture capital firms like Valtruis and The Home Depot.

We're looking for a sharp, ambitious Junior Chief of Staff to sit at the center of how Jukebox operates day-to-day. Reporting to the VP of People, you'll work across leadership, Growth, and People to keep things moving — owning meeting operations, executive logistics, hiring support, and culture programming while building a firsthand understanding of how a high-growth healthtech company runs. This is a real launchpad for someone who wants to grow into a Chief of Staff, People Operations, or broader business operations role. If you're early in your career, thrive on variety, and want to be close to the action at a mission-driven company, this is your role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage calendaring and logistics for the co-founders, including proactive calendar management, scheduling, travel coordination, and maintaining clear communication on their behalf
  • Own end-to-end meeting operations for key recurring meetings across teams — scheduling, agenda building, pre-read distribution, and following up on action items post-meeting
  • Drive accountability across stakeholders to ensure meetings happen on time, with the right people in the room and materials prepared in advance
  • Coordinate domestic and occasional international T&E for the Growth team — flights, hotels, ground transportation, expenses, and itineraries
  • Support the People team with interview scheduling, candidate communications, event logistics, offsites, team gatherings, happy hours, and culture programming — from concept through execution
  • Own ad hoc projects and operational tasks across the company — research, vendor coordination, gift purchases, process documentation, and whatever else needs to get done
  • Identify gaps in how we operate and propose or implement solutions without being asked

Qualifications

Required

  • 1–3 years of experience in an operational, administrative, or generalist business role — startup experience strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and work independently without close supervision
  • A high sense of urgency, especially when it comes to priority tasks and communication with candidates, investors, and other key contacts
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; high degree of discretion and integrity around confidential information
  • Fully remote-ready with reliable availability during Eastern business hours
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace, Notion, and Slack
  • Active user of AI tools to work faster and smarter

Preferred

  • Familiarity with travel booking and expense platforms (e.g., Ramp)
  • Experience supporting founders and/or People teams
  • Interest in growing into a Chief of Staff, People Operations, or business operations role

How We Invest In You

  • Generous company-funding of our health, vision, and dental plans
  • HSA plan with company seeding
  • FSA plan
  • Short and Long-Term Disability
  • Life and Personal Accident Insurance
  • Hospital Insurance
  • 401k immediately upon hire
  • Generous candidate referral program
  • Yearly wellness stipend 

Time Away

  • Unlimited PTO + 10 paid holidays 

Remote First Team

  • $1000 stipend towards work from home costs
  • Frequent team off-sites and get-togethers around the country
  • Collaborative team environment
  • Monthly Townhalls
  • High trust environment
  • A laptop and company swag upon hire

Compensation Range: $65,000 - 75,000/year + company equity

Keeper is hiring a driven Account Manager to join a high producing team within our B2B sales division. This is a 100% remote position with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates who live near our global headquarters in Chicago.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations, globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and gain valuable skills while expanding and developing client relationships in this pivotal role!

Keeper Security is transforming cybersecurity for people and organizations globally. Keeper’s intuitive solutions are built with end-to-end encryption to protect every user, on every device, in every location. Our zero-trust privileged access management platform deploys in minutes and seamlessly integrates with any tech stack to prevent breaches, reduce help desk costs and ensure compliance. Trusted by millions of individuals and thousands of organizations, Keeper is the leader for password, passkey and secrets management, privileged access, secure remote access and encrypted messaging. Our team is full of seasoned technologists, with experience selling into SME and Enterprise level accounts. Keeper is hiring driven Customer Success Managers to join a high producing team within our B2B sales division. This can be a 100% remote position from select locations with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the Chicago, IL metro area!

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations, globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and gain valuable skills while expanding and developing client relationships in this pivotal role!

About Keeper Security

Keeper Security is transforming cybersecurity for people and organizations globally. Keeper’s intuitive solutions are built with end-to-end encryption to protect every user, on every device, in every location. Our zero-trust privileged access management platform deploys in minutes and seamlessly integrates with any tech stack to prevent breaches, reduce help desk costs and ensure compliance. Trusted by millions of individuals and thousands of organizations, Keeper is the leader for password, passkey and secrets management, privileged access, secure remote access and encrypted messaging. Learn how our zero-trust and zero-knowledge solutions defend against cyber threats at KeeperSecurity.com.

About the Job

Join an elite group of proven performers and highly successful Customer Success professionals. Our team is full of seasoned technologists, with experience selling into SME and Enterprise level accounts. They have a passion for helping companies get the most out of their technology investments and are skilled at identifying new business opportunities and expansion opportunities within named accounts. As a Customer Success Manager, you will work with an established client base and be responsible for growing revenue through these accounts using our industry-leading solutions.

  • Thrive in a supportive but independent workplace with the opportunity to grow as our organization grows
  • Carry a revenue quota to meet or exceed sales targets within assigned accounts
  • Provide strong interactions with customers at the Senior Management level with support on forming relationships with C level contacts
  • Work with clients to negotiate contract renewals, cross-sells and upsells
  • Work with clients to establish business and technical goals & potential via technical and Quarterly Business Reviews
  • Maintain a structured cadence with named customer accounts, build relationships, present Keeper solutions, troubleshoot challenges, manage issues with the broader Keeper team and close deals
  • Advise customers on best practices for securing and protecting their business against password related breaches
  • Proactively manage the success of a portfolio of assigned Keeper Security customers to deliver consistent value across the entire lifecycle
  • Consistently demonstrate knowledge of Customer Success best practices, stay up to date on trends in the industry, and operate as a Customer Success and Cyber Security advisor to your customers
  • Understand and navigate account procurement practices to negotiate licensing contracts
  • Resolve customer issues, alone and through collaboration with other Keeper Security teams; approach all situations with curiosity and creativity. Resolving customer issues can involve troubleshooting and require deep technical knowledge of our solutions and the Password management space
  • Build strong customer relationships by maintaining high levels of engagement, adoption, and communication; conduct quarterly business reviews to ensure our clients are up to speed on their areas of vulnerability, new product features etc.
  • Become a Keeper Security product expert for your customers; occasionally assist on Sales or Marketing calls/webinars as a CSM & Keeper expert
  • Drive customer advocacy in the form of references, referrals, and case studies
  • Perform data-driven reviews and analysis on customer portfolio to prioritize opportunity and risk; reliably renew and expand customer contracts, meet and exceed personal and team quotas
  • Participate in the evolution of Keeper Security’s own Customer Success programs and processes; insist on excellence in our own Customer Success initiatives
  • Contribute towards the development of a strong team environment by upholding high work standards
  • Jump at opportunities to go the extra mile to ensure our customers are supported and successful!

Requirements 

  • 1+ years of experience in Account Management or SaaS Customer Success roles/Sales roles
  • Strong technical knowledge as it pertains to software integrations (SSO, Directory etc), implementation, onboarding & support
  • Motivated by solving problems for customers; demonstrated ability to anticipate challenges before they arise
  • Experience working with and selling to Enterprise organizations, C-level Executives, IT and Cyber Security Executives
  • Unrivaled sense of autonomy, ownership, and dedication to helping customers realize their intended value
  • Energetic and self-motivated; a team player who is also a proactive and creative problem solver
  • Aptitude for learning software; strong with business applications
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining strict attention to details. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, both written and verbal; consistent diplomacy, tact, and poise when working through customer issues and escalations
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce.com
  • Undergraduate degree preferred (BA/BS)
  • Experience working in IAM industry is a plus

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental & Vision (Inclusive of domestic partnerships)
  • Employer Paid Life Insurance & Employee/Spouse/Child Supplemental life
  • Voluntary Short/Long Term Disability Insurance
  • 401k (Roth/Traditional)
  • A generous PTO plan that celebrates your commitment and seniority (including paid Bereavement/Jury Duty, etc)
  • Above market annual bonuses

E-Verify program. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

This role will optimize revenue processes, systems, forecasting, reporting, and performance management to support scalable growth and cross-functional alignment. This is a 100% remote position from select locations, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates who live near our global headquarters in Chicago.

Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.

About the Role

The Director, RevOps Strategy & Operations will report to the VP, Revenue Operations and serve as a strategic partner to revenue leadership. This role will oversee the operating cadence of the revenue organization, translating company objectives into actionable plans, scalable processes, and measurable outcomes. The ideal candidate combines strong business judgment, analytical expertise, operational discipline, and the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders in a fast-paced environment. 

Responsibilities 

  • Run the GTM planning cycle end to end with Finance, Sales leadership, and HR, owning the bottom-up capacity and pipeline model and reconciling it with Finance’s top-down targets
  • Design segmentation, coverage, and headcount models across New Business, Growth, Renewals, MSP, Channel, and Public Sector, while pressure-testing supporting capacity across Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Deal Desk
  • Establish an equitable quota methodology, allocate quotas across every channel and motion, and design territories based on opportunity, including book-of-business cuts for expansion and renewal teams
  • Manage in-year territory and quota changes for new hires and transfers
  • Lead compensation plan design with Finance and HR, including modeling payout and attainment scenarios and arbitrating plan policy questions
  • Use TAM, whitespace, and install-base data to size new segments and routes to market, including partners, MSP, distribution, and self-service
  • Represent planning on pricing decisions and model their revenue and attainment impact in partnership with the Pricing Manager
  • Run the weekly pipeline council, forecast cadence for every sales team, and Monday KPI email, while preparing QBR and executive materials with Field Operations leads
  • Own key business KPIs, including bookings versus plan, bookings per ramped representative, retention, win rate, and large-deal volume, while ensuring reports remain accurate, well used, and relevant
  • Inspect and improve sales process quality across routing, account assignment, stage management, and handoffs between New Business, CSMs, and Renewals, while holding the sales organization to CRM standards established by GTM Governance
  • Turn install-base data into Strategic account plans, expansion plays, upsell and cross-sell opportunities, and higher PAM attach
  • Build deal strategy frameworks and playbooks in partnership with Enablement
  • Hire, develop, and lead the Planning and Field Operations teams, setting clear objectives, managing performance, and building career paths for analysts
  • Partner with Rev Systems & Tools to maximize the value of GTM tools and scope AI automation that removes manual work
  • Determine where AI agents can perform work that would otherwise require an additional hire
  • Lead cross-functional projects from problem definition through measured impact and partner with Business Transformation to ensure company initiatives are implemented consistently across every region

Requirements 

  • 10+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Business Operations, Strategy, or a related field
  • 4+ years of experience leading revenue operations or sales operations teams in a SaaS or technology organization
  • Proven experience developing and executing revenue strategies that support growth, scalability, and operational efficiency
  • Strong experience with revenue planning, forecasting, pipeline management, territory design, quota setting, and performance management
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze complex business data, build executive dashboards, and translate insights into clear recommendations and measurable action plans
  • Deep understanding of the B2B SaaS revenue lifecycle, including marketing, sales, customer success, renewals, and expansion
  • Experience managing and optimizing CRM and revenue technology ecosystems; Salesforce experience preferred
  • Strong financial acumen and experience partnering with Finance on modeling, planning, compensation, and forecasting
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and collaborate effectively across departments
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple strategic initiatives simultaneously
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment with a continuous improvement mindset
  • Experience in cybersecurity or identity and access management, or selling to Public Sector (SLED and Federal) preferred
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Marketing, or a related field; MBA preferred

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental & Vision (inclusive of domestic partnerships)
  • Employer Paid Life Insurance & Employee/Spouse/Child Supplemental life
  • Voluntary Short/Long Term Disability Insurance
  • 401K (Roth/Traditional)
  • A generous PTO plan that celebrates your commitment and seniority (including paid Bereavement/Jury Duty, etc)

  • Experience managing sandboxes, change sets or deployment tools, as well as building and maintaining integrations through APIs
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, data models, automation and system governance

  • Strong project management and release management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver on schedule

jobs.description_html:
Description

Keeper Security is hiring an experienced Sales Engineer, DevOps to join our B2B sales team. This is a 100% remote position from select locations, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the Chicago, IL metro area.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and be responsible for navigating our customers through the technical landscape of our products while serving as a DevOps subject matter expert.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.

The Problem We Solve for DevOps Teams

Modern engineering organizations face a growing crisis of secrets sprawl: hardcoded credentials in source code, unmanaged service accounts, secrets embedded in CI/CD pipelines, and machine identities that proliferate across containers and cloud environments with no governance. KeeperPAM with Keeper Secrets Manager (KSM) eliminate these risks by giving DevOps and platform engineering teams a zero-knowledge platform that integrates natively into the tools and workflows they already use like Jenkins, Kubernetes, Ansible, GitHub Actions, Terraform, and more.

As a Sales Engineer, DevOps, you will be the technical voice that helps engineering leaders and security teams understand and solve these problems with Keeper.

About the Role

As a Sales Engineer, DevOps, you will work alongside the Keeper Security sales force by supporting the pre-sales and post-sales cycle from a technical perspective. You will be responsible for identifying the technical requirements within an opportunity, matching them to Keeper Security solutions, and supporting the sale by positioning and demonstrating differences. You will provide product trials and evaluations to Keeper Security partners, assist with implementation and integration, and provide level-2 technical assistance to existing customers.

In addition, you will serve as a DevOps subject matter expert and work with customers to understand and secure their development environments, CI/CD pipelines, cloud-native infrastructure and automated workflows.

Responsibilities 

  • Provide and manage pre-sales technical support for the technical sales process of Keeper products
  • Work closely with the sales team to identify customer opportunities and understand their business needs
  • Conduct product demonstrations and technical presentations remotely, at customer locations, or on-site at a Keeper facility
  • Serve as a DevOps subject matter expert for customers, prospects and internal sales teams

  • Address technical questions, concerns and objections during the sales process to ensure customer confidence and satisfaction
  • Act as a technical advisor to customers, helping them understand how our solutions can solve their business challenges and achieve their goals
  • Stay informed about industry trends, the competitive landscape and emerging technologies relevant to the business
  • Analyze complex multivariate problems and use a systematic approach to gain quick resolution, often under pressure

  • Establish relationships and engage with technical personnel to identify opportunities and sell Keeper Security products and services
  • Ensure accurate and timely activity and issue updates in Salesforce and report to management
  • Create and deliver technical product presentations and/or training sessions to channel partners and customers
  • Participate as part of a sales team to achieve or exceed revenue targets
  • Contribute to the execution of company objectives to achieve goals in creative and effective ways
  • Ability to travel to and from customer meetings locally and nationally and rent and/or operate a vehicle on behalf of the company

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in a pre-sales technical role such as Sales Engineer, Systems Engineer, Solutions Engineer or a similar position with a focus on Machine Identity Security and/or DevOps.
  • Hands-on experience with Jenkins, Kubernetes, Ansible, Red Hat OpenShift, GitLab and other DevOps or CI/CD technologies

  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, CI/CD pipelines, containerized environments and DevOps best practices

As a Senior Compliance Program Manager, you will manage complex compliance and governance initiatives across Keeper’s enterprise and regulated environments, including FedRAMP High and DoD IL5.

You will work closely with control owners and security leadership to translate regulatory requirements into clear plans, operational processes and accountable workstreams. This role requires strong compliance expertise combined with disciplined program management.   • Coordinate evidence collection, remediation tracking and control-owner activities for compliance and audit initiatives
  • Maintain working knowledge of frameworks including NIST 800-53, FedRAMP High, DoD IL5, SOC 2, ISO 27001 and PCI DSS
  • Partner with GRC and ISSO stakeholders on audit readiness, control documentation, remediation and continuous monitoring activities
  • Monitor evolving regulatory and security requirements and assess potential business and operational impact
  • Support compliance responses for customers, contracts, security reviews and RFPs
  • Support and help mature Keeper’s third-party risk management program, including risk-tiered assessments of vendors and business partners
  • Review vendor security documentation, attestations and supply chain risk factors and provide risk-based recommendations
  • Partner with Procurement, Legal and business owners on security requirements, contract terms and remediation expectations
  • Maintain the third-party risk register and track remediation, risk acceptance and program metrics
  • Author, maintain and govern information security policies, standards, procedures and control narratives
  • Support System Security Plan documentation and other compliance-related technical documentation
  • Develop and maintain information security training for employees and role-specific audiences including developers, administrators, privileged users and incident responders
  • Manage training lifecycle activities including scheduling, learning management system administration, completion tracking, phishing simulation and audit evidence
  • Develop training materials, job aids, scenarios and assessments in partnership with subject matter experts
  • Measure and report training effectiveness using completion, assessment and behavioral metrics
  • Collaborate with Engineering and Product teams to validate technical information and maintain accurate, audit-ready documentation
  • Translate complex technical and regulatory information into clear documentation for auditors, leadership and internal stakeholders
  • Mentor team members and cross-functional partners on compliance processes and documentation practices
  • Use AI-assisted tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or similar platforms to improve regulatory research, documentation, analysis, training development and workflow efficiency

Requirements

  • 6+ years of progressive experience in information security compliance, governance, risk, audit, program management or a related field
  • 3+ years of experience leading audits, assessments or compliance initiatives involving NIST 800-53, FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001 or similar frameworks
  • Strong working knowledge of NIST 800-53 Rev. 5, NIST RMF, FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001 and related compliance requirements
  • Experience managing complex cross-functional compliance programs from planning through completion
  • Experience supporting regulated or federal cloud environments, ideally including FedRAMP High, DoD IL4/IL5 or similar requirements
  • Experience with authorization documentation such as System Security Plans, POA&Ms, continuous monitoring artifacts or related evidence
  • Experience supporting or managing third-party risk management programs
  • Experience developing and governing information security policies, standards and procedures
  • Experience developing or delivering information security training for technical and non-technical audiences
  • Strong program management skills including planning, scheduling, risk and issue management, dependency tracking and stakeholder communication
  • Strong documentation governance skills, including managing reviews, approvals, versioning and controlled release
  • Strong ability to interpret technical and regulatory requirements and translate them into actionable operational guidance
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with experience communicating with executives, auditors and technical stakeholders
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple concurrent initiatives and influence cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority
  • Ability and willingness to use AI-assisted tools effectively to support compliance research, documentation, analysis and program execution
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, Technical Communication or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • At least one relevant professional certification such as PMP, CISSP, CISA, CISM, CRISC, CGRC or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience supporting FedRAMP High or DoD IL5 authorization and continuous monitoring activities
  • Experience with NIST 800-53 AT controls and security awareness or role-based training programs
  • Experience with supply chain risk management and vendor security assessments
  • Familiarity with security contract requirements, data protection addenda and federal flow-down requirements
  • Experience with phishing simulation platforms, learning management systems or compliance automation platforms
  • Experience preparing customer-facing compliance or security responses
  • Familiarity with NIST SP 800-50, NIST SP 800-16 or related security training guidance
  • Additional security, audit, risk or project management certifications

jobs.description_html:
Keeper is hiring a driven Senior Federal Sales Executive to join our high-producing sales team. This is a 100% remote position. Qualified candidates must reside in Northern Virginia or Maryland. Regular travel is required. 

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations, globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and play a key role in our continued federal growth!

 

About Keeper

Keeper Security is a leading cybersecurity software company that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in more than 150 countries. Keeper delivers a powerful zero-trust and zero-knowledge solution built to meet the stringent requirements of federal IT environments. Its flagship offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects users, devices, and critical infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized in the Gartner® Magic QuadrantTM for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper combines robust compliance with unmatched visibility and control. With industry-leading certifications, including FedRAMP High and GovRAMP Moderate Authorization, Keeper provides the security assurance public sector organizations require. Learn why federal agencies, including NASA and the DOJ, trust Keeper to defend against today’s sophisticated adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.

 

About the Role

The Senior Federal Sales Executive will drive new business and sales growth across assigned federal accounts, supporting customers within the Department of Defense (DoD), Federal Civilian agencies, and the Department of Homeland Security (DHS). This role focuses on managing complex sales cycles and navigating the unique procurement, compliance, and mission requirements of federal customers.

This role requires a strategic thinker with 5+ years of experience in federal SaaS sales, exceptional communication skills, and the ability to build relationships with key decision-makers across multiple federal sectors. Salesforce & GTM Systems Ownership: The Director will own Salesforce as the system of record for the GTM org, ensuring the platform is configured, automated, and maintained to support the sales process end to end

  • Owns the roadmap and end-to-end CRM strategy for Salesforce and adjacent systems
  • Develops deep fluency in how Sales, Finance, and Analytics use our GTM systems — the decisions they drive, the reports and fields they depend on, and the obstacles they face
  • Translates strategic and operational workflows into clear business and functional requirements, partnering with Salesforce engineering to deliver solutions that meet the needs of the business
  • Owns a clean, well-documented sales funnel model — pipeline stages, opportunity fields, account hierarchies — and maps data across systems
  • Leads AI strategy within the Salesforce ecosystem, identifying and building automation that reduces manual work
  • Troubleshoots system issues quickly and is the first point of escalation for sales tooling problems

Data Quality & Process Governance: The Director is the steward of data quality and process discipline across our GTM systems

  • Runs regular data hygiene audits — duplicate records, stale opportunities, missing fields — and drives resolution with sales teams
  • Owns QA through the deal lifecycle, from S1 opportunities to go-live — validating products, pricing, and contract terms against Salesforce before a deal is handed off to implementation
  • Defines, governs, and maintains the business rules for Maven's customer account hierarchy, including new accounts, restructures, and ongoing hygiene, to support accurate reporting and client operations
  • Documents and enforces sales process standards (stage definitions, required fields, deal desk workflows) so the pipeline reflects reality

Cross-Functional Operations Support: The Director is a hands-on operator across the broader GTM and Finance functions

  • Partners with Sales, Finance, Customer Success, and Engineering to identify bottlenecks and convert them into system-level solutions
  • Drives business analysis and program management for Salesforce-related initiatives, including scoping new requests, running discovery, and managing multi-phase implementation roadmaps
  • Supports Deal Desk with opportunity structuring, approval workflows, new pricing, and contract data accuracy in Salesforce

What You’ll Bring: 

  • 8+ years across Salesforce architecture, revenue operations, or GTM systems, including time at a B2B SaaS or healthcare company
  • Deep hands-on Salesforce skill: Understands best-practice system architecture and can design clear business and system requirements to achieve that build. Has designed account hierarchies and object models for complex B2B organizations, ideally where revenue moves through more than one channel or contract structure
  • Has built their own automation and AI-enabled tooling to replace manual GTM and revenue operations work; continually identifies inefficient processes and eliminates them
  • Has integrated Salesforce with the systems around it — data warehouse, BI, billing, and GTM tooling. At Maven this means Looker, BigQuery, NetSuite, Gong, ZoomInfo, and Clay
  • Proficient in Looker or equivalent BI, with a track record of owning recurring reporting and QA that other teams depend on
  • Can take an ambiguous request, run discovery, and come back with a scoped, multi-phase plan — and can hold a room of senior stakeholders to a decision once it’s made

  • Build platform primitives, reusable capabilities that serve many programs, rather than one-off features.
  • Bring a point of view on how AI can improve care delivery workflows, and put it to work in how you build.
