This is not a reactive support role — it’s a commercial leadership position that requires equal parts relationship depth, analytical rigor, and business acumen.

As Senior Client Success Manager at Maven, you will:

  • Own the net revenue retention outcome for your portfolio of large employer clients with direct accountability for renewal rates, expansion pipeline, and risk mitigation Build and maintain strategic account plans, including expansion opportunities, competitive threats (e.g., vendor consolidation, competitor displacement), and renewal milestones
  • Forecast renewal health on a defined cadence, proactively monitor client risk on an ongoing basis and establish documented risk mitigation plans as needed, flagging risk  and develop Client Success Qualified Leads (CSQLs) by surfacing expansion signals — new populations, benefit line additions, geographic growth — and building the internal business case before handing to Sales
  • Partner with Renewals and Sales as the account quarterback: own the quality and completeness of every commercial handoff, ensuring these teams inherit a fully developed narrative with quantified ROI, stakeholder alignment, and a clear path to close
  • Own member enrollment and engagement campaigns that deliver measurable client business outcomes, developed in coordination with health plan partners and executed in adherence to channel-specific communication protocols and payer approval requirements.
  • Deliver Quarterly Business Reviews and data-driven business cases that translate Maven's clinical outcomes and member engagement into quantifiable ROI, tailoring messaging by stakeholder persona — cost containment and claims data for CFOs, utilization and engagement for Benefits leaders, retention and attraction narratives for CHROs
  • Proactively consult clients on program optimization and strategies to better support family building and their working parents, leveraging Maven’s industry expertise, benchmark data, and clinical outcomes to continuously demonstrate measurable business impact
  • Maintain high level of client engagement, satisfaction and loyalty, as measured by high client satisfaction scores and revenue retention
  • Partner with health plan Account Executives to align on strategy, enrollment goals, and renewal timing while maintaining Maven’s distinct presence and value proposition within the partnership.
  • Collaborate with client leadership, broker and consultant partners, and other internal and external stakeholders to unlock additional business opportunities within your portfolio
  • Serve as the primary cross-functional point of contact — leading initiatives with Product, Engineering, Data, and Marketing to deliver exceptional client outcomes, and managing escalations in partnership with Member Support, Operations, Analytics, and Sales — with ownership of project timelines and accountability for deliverables
  • Convert clients into Maven advocates, leveraging their successes for references, case studies, blogs, etc.
  • Provide strategic analysis of member engagement performance and program metrics
  • Own communications to meet mutually agreed upon goals including but not limited to quarterly business reviews, external client meetings/events and other project plans
  • Serve as the voice of the client internally by bringing insights to enhance product development and program marketing efforts
  • Identify and address root causes of challenges, recommending scalable improvements to processes and systems to enhance client outcomes.
  • Act as a trusted decision-maker, balancing multiple perspectives and ensuring alignment with company priorities to drive key decisions forward.

We’re looking for you to bring:

  • 7+ years of experience in account management, customer success, or client services role in digital health, healthcare company, benefits or SaaS companies, with demonstrated ownership of commercial outcomes (client retention, expansion, NRR), and a deep understanding of the employee benefits and healthcare landscape.
  • Demonstrate a proactive approach to adopting AI tools and technology, applying them to streamline workflows, generate insights, and elevate the client experience — with a mindset of continuous learning as the landscape evolves.
  • Experience working with large employer clients (10,000+ employees) is required
  • Experience working within or alongside channel partner or payer-distributed model is preferred. 
  • Proven track record of positioning and executing marketing strategies that drive enrollment to drive to measurable client business outcomes
  • Passion for healthcare and influencing organizational change
  • Serve as a strategic partner to internal stakeholders, collaborating to deliver a seamless experience for Maven clients and partners, translating insights into product, process, and market improvements.  Demonstrated history of contributing directly to net revenue retention through proactive renewal management, risk mitigation, and expansion pipeline development 
  • Proven ability to broaden and deepen multi-threaded executive relationships (VP, CHRO, CFO, Benefits leaders, consultants), within client relationship, specific experience managing the relationships across both the individual employer group and health plan/channel partner stakeholder simultaneously. 
  • Track record of partnering with Sales and/or Renewals teams to progress commercial opportunities, including developing CSQLs and building business cases for expansion
  • Strong interpersonal and verbal, written, and presentation skills, ability to communicate clearly and persuade, and influence internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks while holding yourself and others accountable for deadlines and deliverables
  • Possess analytical skills and strategic thinking- you’re strong on both IQ and EQ, with the ability to translate data, client performance into market insights and action planning in partnership with clients.
  • Experience in working with the full lifecycle of customer success post sales (implementation, adoption, product training, renewals, and account management)
  • Willingness to travel 25-30% of the time for key client meetings and participate occasionally in our NYC office for relationship building and key meetings (quarterly basis)

About The Role:

We are seeking a Senior Staff Product Designer to completely own our virtual care and provider-facing experiences while driving the evolution of AI-native design at Maven. This role is focused on designing our provider tooling that our virtual care network of clinicians and other providers use during appointments. It's about identifying the right problems, setting and fully owning the design vision for multiple complex areas, making strategic calls under ambiguity, and leading high-impact initiatives that raise the bar for the team around you.

You'll bring deep AI fluency and use it to move faster, explore more broadly, and build more intelligently, while also mentoring others on how to work that way.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the end-to-end experience across complex, cross-functional initiatives for our provider tooling and virtual clinic experience, from early concept through delivery, demonstrating exceptional decision-making and strategic thinking about scope, sequencing, and tradeoffs to drive results across projects.
  • Define how AI should behave in high-stakes contexts: how it communicates uncertainty, when it defers to human care, and how it builds trust with members navigating emotionally charged decisions.
  • Build functional, high-fidelity prototypes using AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar), and push others to move beyond static mockups.
  • Develop scalable AI-powered patterns in a healthcare context — confidence indicators, human-AI handoffs, progressive disclosure — that become the standard across Maven's design system.
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, Clinical, and Data at a strategic level: shaping model outputs into intuitive interfaces, influencing how problems are framed, and driving alignment across teams.
  • Develop leaders within the design team and non-design partners, fostering independence, delegating effectively, and promoting leadership among peers.
  • Identify and resolve cross-functional tensions, bridging gaps between design, clinical, and product perspectives.
  • Strengthen community within and outside the design team by championing company-wide cultural initiatives.

What You'll Bring:

  • AI fluency: You use AI tools daily (Claude, Figma AI, Cursor, or similar) with strong prompting and synthesis skills. You're also helping others develop that muscle.
  • Vibe coding: You can turn ideas into working prototypes using AI-assisted coding tools, and you're comfortable pushing the boundaries of what that looks like in a healthcare context.
  • Technical depth: You've shipped code to production and can have an informed conversation about backend architecture, model behavior, and system constraints.
  • Strategic craft: A portfolio that shows not just design quality but also evidence of strategic ownership: defining success metrics, navigating ambiguity, and influencing direction.
  • Cross-functional leadership: You've driven complex projects across multiple teams and know how to create momentum without direct authority.
  • Mobile and web: Experience designing for mobile applications and responsive web.
  • Systems thinking: Ability to think beyond a flow and communicate a holistic system that can scale for any program
  • Appetite for complexity: Energized by ambiguity and solving complex problems, and comfortable making calls when the path isn't clear.

Mindset:

  • Deeply empathetic toward members and the providers who help them navigate their family building experience, a space that's emotionally intense, medically complex, and often uncertain.
  • AI-native: you think in terms of what AI makes newly possible, and you bring others along in that thinking.
  • Invested in the people around you. You want the team to be better because you're on it, and to make the team better by mentoring.

Nice To Have:

Learn more at mavenclinic.com

An award-winning culture working towards an important mission –  Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including: 

  • TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026)
  • Fortune Change the World (2024)
  • CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024)
  • Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)

About the Role

Maven is looking for a VP of Business Operations to own the operating engine behind our core business — beginning with one of the most important numbers in the company: enrollments. This role is accountable for driving member enrollment into Maven’s programs across our core business and, by extension, the revenue those enrollments generate. It also owns three central functions that determine how well the rest of the company executes: AI enablement, central operations, and strategy & operations.

Enrollment is not a single-team problem. It sits at the intersection of nearly every function at Maven, and this role is built for someone who thrives there. You’ll partner daily with Client Success (who own the client relationships that unlock eligible populations), Marketing (member acquisition and lifecycle), Product (enrollment experience and funnel), Finance (targets, forecasting, and unit economics), Data (measurement, segmentation, and attribution), and Clinical and Operations teams. Because so many teams touch enrollment, a core part of the job is holding those cross-functional partners accountable to their piece of the machine — the engine only works when every team delivers its part.

This is a senior leadership role with a broad and growing remit. You will build, lead, and develop a multi-function organization — including leaders who own member growth, central operations, strategy & ops, and AI enablement — and you will be measured on what those teams collectively deliver. You set the strategy, define the operating cadence, and raise the bar for analytical rigor across a wide cross-functional surface.

We’re also looking for someone who can expand the definition of the job. A great deal of enrollment optimization work is already underway, but there is not enough strategic thinking about fundamentally new ways to drive enrollments — approaches that don’t simply depend on securing permission to communicate with a client’s employees. You are accountable for ensuring your team finds and opens those new avenues, and for creating the conditions and analytical foundation that let them do it.

What You’ll Do

  • Own member growth for the Core Business: Be directly accountable for enrollment targets across Maven’s core business and for the revenue those enrollments drive. Set the strategy, build the plan, and act as a control tower across all cross-functional teams driving revenue to deliver the results quarter over quarter.
  • Build and run a scalable enrollment engine: Own the full journey from eligible population to enrolled, activated member — spanning client launches, member acquisition and messaging, the enrollment product experience, and re-engagement of eligible-but-not-enrolled members.
  • Deliver AI enablement across the organization: Own the function that introduces new ways of working with AI at Maven — and, just as importantly, measures them. Build the adoption playbook, instrument usage and impact team by team, and continuously optimize the value the company gets from how Mavens use AI in their day-to-day work.
  • Lead the central operations team: Own the function that enables our member operations and client operations teams to deliver more operationally excellent service. Ensure the systems, tooling, and processes both teams rely on are effective and scalable — built to absorb growth rather than constrain it.
  • Lead the strategy and operations team: Own a central strategy & ops function that brings analytical rigor and operating discipline to teams across the org, with specific focus on partnering with Sales, Client Success, and Payer Growth.
  • Optimize relentlessly around data: Build and consistently iterate on the funnel, and create systems that enable quick diagnoses of opportunities. Build operational metrics that act as leading KPIs for each team contributing to enrollments and bring quantitative rigor into how teams execute against targets.
  • Hold the cross-functional machine accountable: Partner daily with Client Success, Marketing, Product, Finance, Data, Clinical, Payer, Sales, and Operations — and hold each team accountable to its operational KPIs in the enrollment process. Serve as the connective tissue that keeps every part of the engine delivering.
  • Instrument and forecast: Partner with Data and Finance to build the measurement, segmentation, attribution, and forecasting needed to know exactly what is and isn’t working, and to forecast enrollment and revenue with confidence.

What You’ll Bring

  • 12+ years of experience driving growth, enrollment, acquisition, revenue, or business operations outcomes, with a track record of personally owning and hitting a number — ideally in healthcare, benefits, marketplaces, consumer subscription, or another environment with a complex funnel and multiple stakeholders.
  • Proven people and organizational leadership. You have built and led multi-team or multi-function organizations, hired and developed leaders beneath you, and delivered results through a team rather than solely through your own execution.
  • Elite quantitative ability as a core competency. You can build and interrogate a funnel model yourself, size opportunities, design experiments, and instinctively optimize around data rather than intuition. Strong quant is non-negotiable.
  • Strategic range across functions. You can set direction for several distinct teams at once — growth, operations, strategy, and enablement — sequence their priorities, and push each toward fundamentally new approaches rather than incremental improvement.
  • Operational systems and scaling experience. You have owned the tooling, processes, and systems that service or operations teams depend on, and know how to make them effective and scalable ahead of demand.
  • AI fluency and conviction. You have a point of view on where AI creates real leverage in a business, and the discipline to measure it rather than assume it.
  • Cross-functional leadership and accountability. Proven ability to align and mobilize many teams — Client Success, Marketing, Product, Finance, Data, Clinical, Operations — around a shared goal without direct authority over most of them, and to hold each accountable to its operational commitments.
  • Commercial instincts. You understand how enrollment translates into revenue and unit economics, and you can partner with Finance on targets and forecasting.
  • Comfort in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment with high visibility and direct accountability for a top-line company metric.

The base salary range for this role is $275,000 - $320,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive bonus, equity, and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on qualifications, experience, and skillset.

jobs.location: New York City Office; Washington DC Office
jobs.description_html:
About Method Security

Method Security is dedicated to reshaping cybersecurity in an era where AI-driven threats are growing rapidly. Our mission is to defend critical institutions - such as government, defense, and key commercial sectors - against these sophisticated threats by building cutting-edge, autonomous defense solutions.

We bring together expertise in AI, cybersecurity, and software to create products that seek to finally shift the advantage in security from offense to defense.

Our Team and Values

Joining Method means becoming part of an elite, mission-driven team that values innovation, transparency, and high standards. We work with purpose, embracing diverse perspectives and experiences while maintaining a high bar for quality.

Our team is built around trust, efficiency, and respect. We believe in small, focused teams capable of tackling complex challenges and achieving outsized results. At Method, you will have the autonomy to drive initiatives forward, the support to navigate challenges, and the opportunity to shape the future of cybersecurity.


Role Overview

As a Commercial Growth Lead, you will be responsible for building and running Method’s Go To Market engagements across critical commercial enterprises.

Your principal responsibility will be accelerating Method's adoption across commercial enterprises, particularly large U.S. based institutions. Method is uniquely positioned to help the security enterprise transform its security program with operationalized intelligence it can trust, control, and scale. This is based on proof with existing customers across commercial and USG markets.

You will own a mix of helping channel top of funnel interest from a variety of sources, sourcing customers, qualifying prospects, running sales engagements, and managing executive stakeholders once in production.

This is not a typical sales role.

This is a full-stack role spanning market strategy, account strategy, customer engagement, business development, sales operations, capture, proposal development, and internal coordination. It is designed for a dynamic, well-rounded leader who understands AI transformation possibilities as well as the cyber mission, and is passionate about changing the game in cybersecurity.

You will work directly with Method’s founders, growth leadership, engineers, cyber operators, and deployment teams to accelerate adoption and delivery for customers.

The right candidate will engage deeply with Method’s product, be a first principled when it comes to the opportunity in front of Method, be in the weeds of the entire sales process, and remain accountable for moving opportunities through production.


Key Responsibilities

  • Run deal processes end to end, from first contact to contract closed.

  • Qualify potential customers based on Method's product offerings, their security challenges, and realistic budget.

  • Organize and channel Method's top of funnel sources to maximally take advantage of opportunities.

  • Improve the repeatability and scalability of Method's commercial sales process.

  • Source new customers leveraging Method's network and product proof.

  • Position Method to win in competitive bakeoff situations where Method is technically advantaged in solving customer problems.

  • Identify marketing and brand opportunities for Method and represent the company.

  • Collaborate with Engineering, Product, Mission Operations, and Design teams on customer requirements, capability improvements, and new product opportunities.

Qualifications

  • At least 5 years of relevant experience in security sales, enterprise software sales, or AI transformation sales.

  • Significant experience working with large commercial enterprise customers.

  • Deep understanding of the security capability market, the competition, and purchasing patterns.

  • Demonstrated ability to shape and capture commercial opportunities and establish funding pathways for emerging technologies.

  • Experience translating operational requirements into sales strategies and persuasive proposals.

  • Excellent communication skills for both internal and external stakeholders, from operators and engineers to senior executives.

  • A highly autonomous operating style with a proactive eye for customer, product, and business opportunities.

  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, highly entrepreneurial environment with limited structure.

  • Willingness to travel up to 40%.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience at a high-growth security software company.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager (Pacific/Mountain Time Zone)
jobs.description_html:
About Nava

Nava is a consultancy and public benefit corporation working to make government services simple and effective. Since 2015, federal, state, and local agencies have trusted Nava to help solve highly scrutinized technology modernization challenges.
 
As a client services company, we guide agencies constrained by legacy systems to a future with sharp user experiences built on secure, reliable, fault-tolerant cloud infrastructure. We bill for our time, offering our expertise and problem-solving approach to help our government partners enhance their digital products and services. People are at the heart of our work, from members of the public who rely on benefit programs to government agency staff. Through human-centered design and modern engineering best practices, we help our government partners understand user needs and deliver on their missions more effectively. This focus gives everyone at Nava the opportunity to do work that is meaningful, impactful, and deeply connected to public good.
 

Please note: the level of the role will be determined by Nava leadership based on experience and skillset.

Position summary 

The Principal Product Manager’s purpose is to work collaboratively with client stakeholders and cross-functional team members to define and execute on the vision and strategy for software products and services. A Principal Product Manager leads teams to iteratively deliver working software that meets user needs and business goals, working collaboratively with designers, engineers, project managers, and stakeholders. Responsibilities include translating user needs and  business goals into product requirements, defining user flows and other aspects of system behavior, documenting product specifications, and analyzing product metrics. 

What you'll do 

  • Determine user needs and business requirements through stakeholder interviews and user research, often in collaboration with designer/researchers
  • Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap showing how increments of working software will be delivered to achieve business goals
  • Define user flows, system behavior, and other product specifications that enable team members to design and build working software
  • Define quarterly or program increment goals to establish near- and mid-term milestones for delivering working software
  • Iterate on the product vision, strategy, and roadmap as the team learns from feedback
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand their goals and constraints, and use this information to determine product priorities  
  • Build and maintain trust with stakeholders by continuously aligning on a shared vision and set of priorities, and demonstrating how the team is delivering on this vision
  • Coordinate across teams to implement software according to the roadmap and adapt based on learnings
  • Break software features down into user stories or tasks that can be worked on in a sprint 
  • Collaborate prioritizing and refining the backlog of user stories and tasks to reflect product priorities
  • Define sprint goals; lead and contribute to sprint planning discussions that enable designers and engineers to design and build software features
  • Ensure that user stories have clear descriptions and acceptance criteria so that design and engineering tasks can be evaluated for completeness
  • Review product designs and working software to reflect the desired behavior and performance
  • Engage with stakeholders for approval of key decisions about how software products and services will function
  • Coordinate and communicate decisions with the team and with stakeholders, using evidence gained from research and analysis  
  • Ensure stakeholders are kept up to date on software implementation progress, blockers, and risks
  • Ensure teams with dependencies on each other’s work are coordinating and communicating to deliver features that function as expected
  • Resolve or escalate blockers that impede successful delivery, involving the team as needed
  • Define metrics to be used to track the success of a software product or feature
  • Collaborate with other teams to obtain data needed for metrics
  • Monitor metrics to ensure software features are performing as expected
  • Use data to inform future decisions about what software features to build or improve upon
  • Report metrics to stakeholders and team members verbally and in writing
  • Run data queries to obtain the most up to date information about how the product or service is performing
  • Test behavior of software that is developed in order to validate that features are implemented as expected
  • Document errors or any other pertinent observations about software functionality and appearance
  • Perform checks to ensure that software is ready to be launched
  • Communicate with users about new product features
  • Update user-facing documentation about the product 
  • Respond to user questions about the software product or service
  • Coordinate team response to production incidents that affect the operation of the software product or service
  • Set direction across the portfolio and practice
  • Share successes and challenges with Nava colleagues so that product managers can learn from each other’s experience
  • Conduct interviews and evaluate potential new hires to build Nava teams
  • Help to onboard new team members to Nava’s product practice
  • Coach and mentor other product managers
  • Improve and sustain Nava’s product management operations
  • Operate as a Product Management subject matter expert fluidly and with influence across all core practice skills, with deep experience in a key portfolio specialty
  • Act as business development lead for their program and portfolio
  • Act as a Product Management subject matter expert on proposals for new software development contracts, including participating in market research sessions, proposal writing, and oral interviews
  • Actively mentor and coach cross-functional teammates across their program and portfolio, help them grow their skill sets, and contribute that knowledge back to Nava at large

Required Skills

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • At least 8-10 years of experience, at least 3 years as a product manager 
  • Experience working with cross-disciplinary product teams to build software
  • Experience working with scrum or other agile methodologies
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skill
  • Strong bias towards action; ability to step up into team gaps and ambiguous situations to create an action plan
  • An adaptive, empathetic, collaborative, and positive mindset

 

 

Compensation
$154,400—$173,700 USD

Other requirements

All roles at Nava require the following:
Legal authorization to work in the United States
Ability to meet any other requirements for government contracts for which candidates are hired
Work authorization that doesn’t require visa sponsorship, now or in the future
May be subject to a government background check or security clearance, depending on the contract
 

Perks working with Nava

Health coverage — comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans to support your overall health needs
Insurance coverage — Nava provides disability, life, and accidental death insurance at no cost
Time off — vacation, holidays (including Juneteenth), and floating holidays to rest and recharge
Company holidays — enjoy 12 paid federal holidays each year on top of your regular PTO
Annual bonus — when Nava meets its goals, eligible employees receive a performance-based annual bonus
Parental leave — paid time off for new parents, plus weekly meals delivered to your home
Wellness program — full platform offering physical, mental, & emotional health resources & support tools
Virtual care — see doctors online with no copay through a virtual visit program (depending on available providers)
Sabbatical leave — earn extended unpaid leave after continuous service for personal growth or rest
401(k) match — Nava matches 4% of your salary to support your retirement savings plan
Flexible work — remote-first environment with flexibility built around your schedule and responsibilities
Home office setup — company laptop & setup assistance provided via Staples for remote work needs
Utility support — monthly reimbursement to help offset eligible home office utility expenses
Learning opportunities — internal training programs and resources to help grow your professional skills
Development opportunities — LinkedIn Learning access & an annual allowance for courses, tuition, & certs 
Referral bonus — get rewarded when you refer great people who join the Nava team
Commuter benefits — pre-tax commuter programs to support in-office travel when applicable
Supportive culture — A collaborative and remote-friendly team environment where people genuinely care
 

Location

We have fully remote options if you reside in one of the following states: 
 
Alabama, Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, DC, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nevada, North Carolina, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Texas, Tennessee, Utah, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin
 
*If you are not living in one of the states listed above, unfortunately, you will not be considered for a position at this time. 
 

Stay in touch

Sign up for our newsletter to find out about career opportunities, new partnerships, and news from the broader civic tech community.
 
Please contact the recruiting team at recruiting@navapbc.com if you would like to request any form of reasonable accommodation during the application or interviewing process.  
 
We participate in E-Verify. Upon hire, we will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. This role requires you to work from the contiguous United States.

jobs.title: Product Manager (Accounting SME)
jobs.description_html:
About Nava

Nava is a consultancy and public benefit corporation working to make government services simple and effective. Since 2015, federal, state, and local agencies have trusted Nava to help solve highly scrutinized technology modernization challenges.
 
As a client services company, we guide agencies constrained by legacy systems to a future with sharp user experiences built on secure, reliable, fault-tolerant cloud infrastructure. We bill for our time, offering our expertise and problem-solving approach to help our government partners enhance their digital products and services. People are at the heart of our work, from members of the public who rely on benefit programs to government agency staff. Through human-centered design and modern engineering best practices, we help our government partners understand user needs and deliver on their missions more effectively. This focus gives everyone at Nava the opportunity to do work that is meaningful, impactful, and deeply connected to public good.
 

Please note: the level of the role will be determined by Nava leadership based on experience and skillset.

Position summary 

The Product Manager (Accounting SME and Tech Solutions Advisor) role’s purpose is to rapidly validate product strategies and user needs in alignment with contract requirements with the ability to bridge the gap between state government accounting practices and technology solutions, ensuring seamless integration and improved efficiency. The incumbent works closely with stakeholders, design, and engineering teams to plan and scope work. 

What you'll do

  • Provide expert knowledge and insights in accounting practices
  • Utilize proficiency in accounting software and technology solutions, including experience with system conversions and integrations
  • Demonstrate organizational and leadership skills, with the ability to guide stakeholders through complex public policy implementation and business processes
  • Wield exceptional communication skills, with the ability to explain complex financial concepts to non-financial stakeholders
  • Assist in the development and review of program documentation, training content, and manuals
  • Collaborate with various teams from legal, public policy, business, and operations to ensure accuracy and relevance of accounting processes and systems
  • Identify potential areas for process improvement and suggest changes to enhance efficiency
  • Conduct thorough research to stay updated on changes in accounting standards and regulations
  • Review and approve content developed by others for accuracy and completeness
  • Answer specific queries and provide guidance based on expert accounting and software development knowledge
  • Lead and manage the integration of accounting software solutions to improve process efficiency and data accuracy
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to software implementation and integration
  • Collaborate with IT teams to ensure smooth and effective audit logging, system integrations and system monitoring
  • Provide training and support to team members on new software applications and tools
  • Define the vision, goals, and measures of success for the products and services you manage
  • Work with designers, business analysts, and technical leads to discover and synthesize market research, user needs, business requirements, and technical approaches
  • Define the direction, scope, and priority of projects, from high-level initiatives to specific features, user stories, and business metrics
  • Proactively socialize, iterate on, and build buy-in for product initiatives with the team, government partners, and other contractors
  • Collaborate with the project management team to prioritize roadmaps and inbound units of work
  • Represent Nava's outcome-centric and user-centric approach in discovery meetings with agencies and contractors
  • Understand and communicate the needs of end users and population segments we serve and government partners we work with
  • Measure product progress toward business goals or user needs and translate data insights into action
  • Make tactical decisions to improve the design, define requirements, and generate stakeholder buy-in for our desired path forward

Required skills

  • At least three (3) years of experience as a Product Manager of a cross-functional team
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in accounting
  • Strong understanding of financial measurement tools and accounting principles
  • Experience with budgeting, financial reporting, and compliance with state government regulations
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • Experience running and/or shipping consumer web applications
  • Ability to generate very strong product plans and build buy-in across the team, our government partners, and other contractors
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical, user experience, and project management trade-offs; enthusiastic communicator
  • Strong bias towards action; ability to step up into team gaps and ambiguous situations to structure the team’s action plan
  • Ability to execute with incomplete information; great product instincts and an ability to create order from divergent needs
  • Ability to define a product objective and logically reverse engineer the path and communications to achieve the objective
  • Ability to identify market trends and shifts that will affect product direction and update plans based on future expectations
  • An adaptive, empathetic, collaborative, and positive mindset

 

Compensation
$98,000—$153,000 USD

Other requirements

All roles at Nava require the following:
Legal authorization to work in the United States
Ability to meet any other requirements for government contracts for which candidates are hired
Work authorization that doesn’t require visa sponsorship, now or in the future
May be subject to a government background check or security clearance, depending on the contract
 

Perks working with Nava

Health coverage — comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans to support your overall health needs
Insurance coverage — Nava provides disability, life, and accidental death insurance at no cost
Time off — vacation, holidays (including Juneteenth), and floating holidays to rest and recharge
Company holidays — enjoy 12 paid federal holidays each year on top of your regular PTO
Annual bonus — when Nava meets its goals, eligible employees receive a performance-based annual bonus
Parental leave — paid time off for new parents, plus weekly meals delivered to your home
Wellness program — full platform offering physical, mental, & emotional health resources & support tools
Virtual care — see doctors online with no copay through a virtual visit program (depending on available providers)
Sabbatical leave — earn extended unpaid leave after continuous service for personal growth or rest
401(k) match — Nava matches 4% of your salary to support your retirement savings plan
Flexible work — remote-first environment with flexibility built around your schedule and responsibilities
Home office setup — company laptop & setup assistance provided via Staples for remote work needs
Utility support — monthly reimbursement to help offset eligible home office utility expenses
Learning opportunities — internal training programs and resources to help grow your professional skills
Development opportunities — LinkedIn Learning access & an annual allowance for courses, tuition, & certs

Supportive culture — A collaborative and remote-friendly team environment where people genuinely care
 

Location

We have fully remote options if you reside in one of the following states: 
 
Alabama, Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, DC, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nevada, North Carolina, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Texas, Tennessee, Utah, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin

  • Experience using agile frameworks like scrum, kanban, or SAFe and familiarity with agile development practices such as continuous integration and continuous delivery
  • You are an empathetic communicator and relationship builder – you take a service-oriented approach to supporting the program team and our clients
  • Adaptable problem solving and ability to deal with multi-dimensional challenges involving many organizations, processes, cultures, and technologies
  • You are highly organized and care deeply about building and growing a sustainable, culture-conscious business
  • A strategic approach to delivery planning and contract management over the medium-term and long-term
  • An iterative approach to execution that emphasizes rapid team progress.
  • Ability to maintain broader situational awareness beyond the immediate team
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Experience launching new production systems with high public visibility
  • Experience with long term, complex, and ambiguous IT modernization efforts.

jobs.description_html:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

The Position

We're assembling a small founding team to build something genuinely hard: high-throughput services that inspect live traffic, terminate and analyze TLS in the data path, and hold near-zero latency while doing it. This is real systems engineering — streaming, distributed, latency-obsessed — not another CRUD app behind a form. 

You won't be starting cold. You inherit real infrastructure and real users, which means what you build reaches production in weeks, not years. The work is high-leverage from day one, and there's nowhere to hide — in the best way. 

AI-native. Non-negotiable.  You leverage AI to operate as a 10x engineer — demonstrable AI proficiency is a hard requirement, not a nice-to-have. 

What You'll Own

You take a capability from a rough idea all the way to production, and then you keep it alive and healthy there — meeting its latency and reliability targets, instrumented well enough to prove it, and hardened to survive real load and real failure. You own the outcome, not the ticket. You'll lead a functional area end to end: set its technical direction, make the calls that matter, and pull other engineers along with you. 

Who You Are 

  • You see what needs to exist and you go build it — you spot the gap, scope it yourself, and start, instead of waiting for someone to hand you a task or a spec. 
  • You lead by taking the hardest, least-defined part of the problem and making it work, and others follow because your judgment and output earn it — not because of a title. 
  • You own the entire arc — design, build, ship, operate — and you treat what happens in production as your responsibility, making sure the system behaves exactly within the parameters it's supposed to, not just that it passed in staging. 
  • When you hit the edge of what you know — a protocol you've never touched, a failure mode you've never seen — curiosity and sheer grit carry you across it faster than most people expect. 
  • "Good enough" makes you uncomfortable; you hold a high bar for yourself and ship work you're genuinely proud to put your name on. 

What You Bring

  • Proven, demonstrable proficiency using AI as a force multiplier — you already operate as a 10x engineer, orchestrating AI tools and agents to design, build, and ship far beyond what you could alone, while keeping the judgment to know what "correct" actually looks like. 
  • 5–7+ years building and operating production services and front ends, with real experience owning something end to end and carrying the weight of it once it's in front of real users. 
  • Hands-on experience with TLS / MITM inspection and the security-sensitive edge cases that come with sitting in the middle of live traffic. 
  • A real track record of taming latency in streaming and distributed systems — you've chased down p99 tail latency and know that "fast on my machine" means nothing until it's fast in production, under load, with observability to back it up. 
  • Strong command of a modern backend language (Go, Rust, or TypeScript/Node) and React/TypeScript on the front end, with a deep working grasp of HTTP, TLS, gRPC/REST, and async/streaming I/O.

Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

The Position

OPSWAT is on the lookout for a talented and experienced Director of Product to enhance our Storage Security offerings and bolster our market position. As the head of this division, you will assume full responsibility for managing our Storage Security product line, overseeing both technical and business dimensions. This pivotal role involves shaping product roadmaps, developing solutions, establishing pricing strategies, and managing overall cost structures. You will collaborate closely with engineering teams to ensure that product requirements are met and that deliverables align with expectations. We seek an engaged leader who is actively involved in the execution of daily operations, with a strong background in managing a business line, including budget oversight, and ensuring that strategic initiatives are converted into actionable tasks. Your responsibilities will encompass both on-premises solutions and cloud-native SaaS products. Additionally, you will coordinate product launches in partnership with global sales, corporate marketing, and creative teams.

Join OPSWAT and spearhead the evolution of our Storage Security business, ensuring our products not only fulfill but surpass customer expectations while driving strategic initiatives and achieving overall business success.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Shape the strategic direction for OPSWAT’s Storage Security products by assessing emerging security challenges, understanding the competitive landscape, and aligning OPSWAT’s strengths with innovative product goals.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to clearly define product requirements, develop roadmaps, and establish exit criteria for core offerings, ensuring a match between technical capabilities and business objectives.
  • Guide product development by incorporating both functional and non-functional customer requirements into practical plans.
  • Improve pre- and post-sales processes by providing technical insights and solutions that enhance customer engagement and support business development activities.
  • Manage the comprehensive go-to-market strategy for this business line, including sales enablement for direct sales and channel partners, website content, blogs, presentations, and business proposals.
  • Cultivate and maintain relationships with key stakeholders across various go-to-market functions, including sales teams, channel partners, and technology alliances to enhance product adoption and visibility.
  • Participate in sales calls to assist with proof-of-concept demonstrations and manage customer escalations effectively.
  • Enjoy flexible working hours as OPSWAT serves critical infrastructure clients globally.
  • Be prepared for occasional international travel to engage with internal teams and customers.

What We Need From You

  • At least 5 years of experience in a B2B Product Management role, with a minimum of 3 years focused on the Storage Security domain.
  • Deep hands on experience building with AI.
  • Deep understanding of cloud-native infrastructure and architectures, with experience in a leadership capacity within a cloud development team; capability to effectively navigate and drive engineering processes.
  • Strong storytelling skills with excellent written and verbal communication abilities, capable of transforming complex technical concepts for diverse audiences.
  • A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of IT technology systems, including data protection solutions, encryption technologies, and frameworks for storage security.
  • Excellent interpersonal and customer-facing skills, showcasing effective people management abilities.
  • Proven project management skills, thriving in fast-paced, dynamic environments.
  • Experience in developing and implementing cybersecurity solutions for critical infrastructure or enterprise clients.
  • A demonstrated history of meeting and exceeding business goals.
  • A strategic, innovative, and proactive mindset, willing to take calculated risks to foster advancement.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Product Management- MFT
jobs.description_html:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

 

Why This Role Matters

At OPSWAT, protecting the world’s critical infrastructure is real, urgent, and growing. MetaDefender Managed File Transfer (MFT) is a security-first MFT platform trusted by customers in finance, life sciences, government, and critical infrastructure to move sensitive files safely across IT and OT environments. We are now ready to take MFT to the next level and win against established MFT vendors. As a member of OPSWAT’s product leadership team, you will help set company-level product strategy, influence investment decisions across the portfolio, and be accountable for
the business performance of MFT. This Senior Director role is a rare opportunity to shape the future of MFT, including a next-generation MFT Gateway and a lightweight automation offering, while scaling commercial impact and deepening customer value. You will operate at the intersection of product strategy, engineering execution, and go-to-market success, with clear ownership and visible impact. It is also a chance to redefine what product management looks like in the AI era. We are not looking for someone who talks about AI. We want a leader who already uses it every day to work faster and smarter, and who can build a team of PMs that does the same. If you are energized by building, innovating, and owning outcomes, this role was designed for you.

What You Will Be Doing

As Senior Director of Product Management, MFT, you will be the executive owner of MFT’s product strategy,
business performance, and growth trajectory. You will:

  • Set and own the MFT product vision and roadmap, including the MFT Gateway, automation, and AI-driven capabilities.
  • Translate market signals, customer needs, and competitive insights into clear product direction and prioritized investments.
  • Drive MFT’s position in regulated and high-assurance markets (e.g., GxP, financial services, federal, OT), including compliance, audit, and integrity requirements.
  • Partner deeply with Engineering, ensuring fast, high-quality execution and scalable architecture.
  • Work closely with Sales, Sales Engineering, and Marketing to drive bookings, pipeline, competitive displacements, and customer adoption.
  • Serve as a strong, visible product leader across regions, with close partnership with our engineering team in Hungary and Romania.
  • Balance innovation with operational excellence, ensuring MFT delivers reliability, performance, and trust at scale.
  • Own MFT business results, including revenue, pricing, packaging, and investment priorities.
  • Shape company-level product strategy as part of the product leadership team, presenting to the CEO and executive team.
  • Represent MFT as its executive voice with strategic customers, partners, analysts, and at industry events.

Build an AI-Native Product Function

You will set the standard for how product management works at OPSWAT, using AI as a core part of how the
team operates:

  • Use AI to compress the path from customer signal to shipped feature: synthesizing customer calls, support tickets, win/loss data, and competitive intel into clear insights in hours, not weeks.
  • Use AI tools to draft PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release notes, freeing PMs to spend
    more time with customers and engineers.
  • Prototype workflows and UI concepts with AI to validate ideas with customers before engineering commits.
  • Build AI-assisted competitive and market analysis so the team always knows where MFT wins and why.
  • Identify where AI belongs inside the product itself, from intelligent automation and anomaly detection to policy recommendations and natural-language administration.
  • Define practical guardrails for using AI safely in a security company, protecting customer data and IP.

Grow and Lead a Team of PMs

You will build and develop a high-performing product team as MFT grows:

  • Hire, coach, and grow product managers across regions, raising the bar on product judgment, customer empathy, and execution.
  • Create a clear career path and a culture of ownership, where PMs own outcomes, not just backlogs.
  • Establish lightweight, repeatable product processes for discovery, prioritization, and launch that scale with
    the business.
  • Make every PM on the team AI-fluent through hands-on enablement, shared playbooks, and leading by
    example.Develop future product leaders who can take on new product lines as OPSWAT grows.

What Success Looks Like


In your first 12–18 months, success will look like:

  • A clear, compelling MFT roadmap aligned to market demand and customer value.
  • Measurable growth in bookings and pipeline tied directly to product strategy.
  • Competitive wins displacing legacy MFT solutions in strategic accounts.
  • Strong, trust-based partnerships with Engineering and GTM teams.
  • Delivery of the MFT Gateway and automation offerings that position MFT for long-term growth.
  • An AI-native product team with measurably faster discovery, documentation, and release cycles.
  • A growing, engaged team of PMs with clear ownership and visible development.
  • AI-powered capabilities in the MFT roadmap that customers value and competitors lack.
  • A product organization that moves with urgency, clarity, and accountability.
  • Recognition as a trusted executive voice for MFT inside OPSWAT and across the market.

Who You Are

You are a product leader who blends strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You bring:

  • Proven experience owning enterprise or security products at scale, including business outcomes such as revenue, pricing, and packaging.
  • Deep, hands-on experience using AI in your daily product work, and a clear point of view on how AI changes the PM role. Be ready to show us how you use it.
  • Experience building AI-powered features into enterprise products.
  • A track record of hiring, coaching, and growing product managers into strong leaders.
  • Strong understanding of MFT, secure file transfer protocols (SFTP, FTPS, HTTPS), identity and access (SSO, OAuth, mTLS), or adjacent security domains.
  • Familiarity with the competitive MFT landscape and the compliance needs of regulated industries.
  • A track record of partnering effectively with Engineering to deliver complex products.
  • Commercial acumen and experience supporting bookings, pipeline, and customer conversations.
  • Comfort operating in a global, distributed environment, including close collaboration with teams in Europe.
  •  Executive presence, with clear, confident communication and the ability to influence peers, executives, and customers at the C-level.
  • Experience operating as part of an executive or senior leadership team, making portfolio-level tradeoffs.
  • A mindset rooted in ownership, urgency, and continuous improvement.
  • 10+ years in product management, including 5+ years leading teams of PMs. Senior Director or Director-level experience is preferred, but we value demonstrated leadership altitude, judgment, and impact above title alone.

Why OPSWAT?


OPSWAT is a fast-growing cybersecurity company with a strong culture of ownership and innovation. We build products that matter, support leaders who take initiative, and invest in those who want to grow. In this role, you will:

  • Own a revenue-generating product with a large market and meaningful runway.
  • Shape the future of security-first MFT and MFT Gateway innovation.
  • Build and lead your own team, and define what an AI-native product organization looks like.
  • Work with smart, committed teams across the globe, at a company that rewards using AI to move faster.
  • Join the executive product leadership team, with a direct influence on company strategy.
  • If you are looking for a role where your decisions matter, your leadership is visible, and your work protects what matters most, we would love to meet you.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Secure File Gateway and ICAP
jobs.description_html:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

The Opportunity

OPSWAT is seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead the development and growth of the Secure File Gateway, a strategic product designed to complement our established ICAP Server solution, which today is deployed by organizations operating in critical infrastructure and high-security environments. 

ICAP Server sits directly in the path of sensitive file flows, enforcing security policy, inspecting content in real time, and enabling safe access to web and internal systems. The Secure File Gateway will build on these core inspection and policy enforcement capabilities while addressing new customer needs, architectures, and deployment models. 

In this role, you will own the Secure File Gateway from inception through scale, while working closely with the ICAP Server product to ensure strong alignment, interoperability, and a cohesive platform strategy. This is a rare opportunity to help define a new product category at OPSWAT while partnering with a mature, revenue-generating product used in the most demanding environments. 

You’ll collaborate deeply with engineering, sales, and marketing to translate customer pain points and market signals into a differentiated, high-impact security offering. 

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for Secure File Gateway and ICAP Server, aligning customer needs, market trends, and business priorities. 
  • Drive product adoption and growth by improving usability, performance, scalability, and integration within enterprise security stacks. 
  • Lead market and competitive analysis across ICAP, proxy, secure web gateway, and inline inspection technologies to identify differentiation opportunities. 
  • Translate customer feedback, field insights, and usage data into clear requirements and prioritize initiatives. 
  • Partner deeply with engineering to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable capabilities—balancing innovation with operational excellence. 
  • Collaborate with sales, sales engineering, marketing, and customer success on go-to-market strategy, launches, and enablement. 
  • Support strategic opportunities by participating in customer conversations, technical positioning, and complex deal cycles. 
  • Define and track success metrics tied to adoption, customer value, and platform performance. 
  • Act as the voice of the customer, ensuring ICAP continues to meet the expectations of regulated and mission-critical environments. 

What We Need From You

Cybersecurity & Technical Depth 
Strong understanding of ICAP, proxy technologies, secure web gateways, networking fundamentals, and content inspection workflows. You can translate deep technical capabilities into clear customer value and product direction. 

Product Leadership & Execution 
Proven experience owning roadmaps, writing high-quality requirements, and working closely with engineering teams to ship enterprise-grade software. 

Customer & Market Orientation 
Experience engaging directly with enterprise customers, gathering structured feedback, and incorporating real-world security use cases into product decisions. 

Go-To-Market Partnership 
Comfort collaborating with sales and marketing on positioning, launches, and adoption. Experience supporting complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles is a strong plus. 

Communication & Influence 
Clear, confident communicator who can align stakeholders across product, engineering, and GTM teams—and represent the product externally when needed. 

Experience 
3–5 years of product management experience in B2B software, ideally within cybersecurity, networking, or infrastructure platforms. Experience with platform or integrated product portfolios is highly valued. 

What Sets You Apart

  • Customer-First Mindset – You instinctively start with customer pain and translate it into pragmatic, high-impact product decisions. 
  • Strategic Curiosity – You’re eager to explore adjacent technologies and help evolve ICAP into its next phase as a modern, proxy-focused security platform. 
  • Execution Bias – You balance long-term vision with consistent delivery, creating momentum through meaningful, incremental improvements. 
  • Global Collaboration – Comfortable working with distributed teams and contributing to a globally aligned product organization. 

Why OPSWAT?

At OPSWAT, we protect the systems the world depends on. ICAP plays a critical role in securing web traffic and sensitive content flows for organizations operating in the most demanding environments. 

You’ll join a fast-growing cybersecurity company where product managers have real ownership, visibility, and impact. This role offers the opportunity to influence a critical product line, work alongside deeply technical teams, and help shape the future of secure web gateway and proxy technology. 

If you want to build products that matter—and see your work directly protect critical infrastructure—we’d love to meet you.

Oddball believes that the best products are built when companies understand and value the things they are working on. We value learning and growth and the ability to make a big impact at a small company. We’re looking for an Applied AI / Machine Learning Engineer to design, build, and deploy practical AI-powered solutions that solve real-world problems. This role focuses on applying modern ML and GenAI techniques in production systems — from experimentation and prototyping through deployment, evaluation, and iteration. You’ll work closely with engineers, designers, and product stakeholders to turn ambiguous problems into scalable, reliable AI-driven capabilities.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys shipping, learning quickly, and balancing technical rigor with real-world constraints.

What you'll be doing:

  • Design, develop, and deploy machine learning and AI-powered features into production systems
  • Apply supervised, unsupervised, and deep learning techniques to structured and unstructured data
  • Build and evaluate models for tasks such as classification, ranking, prediction, NLP, or anomaly detection
  • Develop and integrate GenAI solutions (e.g., LLM-based workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, agents)
  • Translate business and user needs into ML problem statements, metrics, and experiments
  • Implement data pipelines and feature engineering workflows to support model training and inference
  • Evaluate model performance, bias, drift, and reliability; iterate based on results
  • Collaborate with software engineers to integrate models into APIs, services, and user-facing applications
  • Contribute to architecture decisions around model serving, scalability, and cost optimization
  • Document approaches, assumptions, and tradeoffs to support maintainability and knowledge sharing

What you’ll bring:

  • Strong foundation in machine learning concepts, including model selection, training, validation, and evaluation
  • Experience building and deploying ML models in real-world applications
  • Proficiency in Python and common ML libraries (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn)
  • Experience working with large language models, embeddings, and prompt-driven systems
  • Familiarity with data processing tools and workflows (e.g., Pandas, SQL, Spark, or similar)
  • Understanding of software engineering best practices (version control, testing, code reviews)
  • Ability to reason about tradeoffs between accuracy, latency, cost, and maintainability
  • Strong communication skills and comfort working in cross-functional teams
  • Performs other related duties as assigned

Bonus if you have:

  • Experience working in innovation, R&D, labs, or exploratory engineering teams
  • Experience deploying models to cloud platforms and managing inference at scale

And behind the tech? People like you — curious, motivated, collaborative learners who want to do meaningful work alongside great teammates.

 

The Opportunity: Where High Potential Meets High Impact

We get it: There are a lot of BDR roles out there. But at Okta, we do things differently.

This isn’t just a cold-call grind or a pit stop on your way to something else — it’s the start of a high-growth, high-visibility career path in one of the most exciting spaces in tech: cybersecurity and identity.

We’re looking for self-starters who are hungry to learn, open to coaching, energized by challenge, and excited to be part of a team that wins together. As a BDR at Okta, you'll help tell our story, spark valuable conversations, and play a key role in building pipeline for one of the top sales orgs in tech.

This role is pivotal in ensuring that security is seamlessly integrated into every facet of our products.

Success in this role demands a deep understanding of customer security requirements, a strong empathy for both end-user and administrator experiences, and the ability to strategically prioritize amidst competing demands from various Okta teams.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Roadmap and Vision

  • Define the product strategy and roadmap for Okta Identity Security functionality to ensure Okta's continued leadership in the security space.
  • Evangelize your vision to engineering teams, the broader product organization, and customers.
  • Develop and execute a comprehensive roadmap, prioritizing features that enhance both customer security posture and administrative ease of use.
  • Analyze and leverage data to inform product and roadmap decisions, ensuring data-driven strategic choices.

Product Delivery and Execution

  • Ensure the timely and within-budget delivery of the Okta Identity Security product roadmap.
  • Collaborate closely with architecture, engineering, and design to specify experiences that are platform-first and delight customers at scale.
  • Work with scrum teams and Technical Program Managers (TPMs) to deliver features on time that address key security use cases.
  • Rigorously prioritize across multiple product investment areas within the security domain.
  • Partner with the data team to track product usage metrics, specifically tying them to improved security outcomes and business success.

Customer Engagement and Requirements Gathering

  • Work with engineering, other product managers, and customers to capture detailed security requirements and document user stories and use cases.
  • Engage with customers to deeply understand their challenges related to identity-centric threats, access control, and network security.
  • Ensure that beta customer feedback is incorporated into product iterations. Maintain close relationships with customers during beta programs to integrate their insights effectively.
  • Collaborate with technical marketing and sales to understand the competitive landscape for identity security and Okta’s position within it.
  • Partner with product marketing to support the creation of compelling messaging and content, and define the go-to-market strategy for existing and new security offerings.
  • Inform current and future pricing and packaging changes for Okta Identity Security products based on your subject matter expertise.

Own the Product

  • Maintain a customer-success-focused mindset, actively working to unblock sales and assist customers with security-related issues.
  • Responsible for supporting the field on critical requests and customer security needs.
  • Drive the development of world-class identity security products and platform capabilities.
  • Lead Okta Identity Security quarterly business reviews and collaborate with the go-to-market team to expand the customer pipeline from roadmap to packaging.
  • Leverage your domain expertise to identify new product opportunities for Okta Identity Security to expand our portfolio.

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field.
  • Proven track record of demonstrating strategic vision and product design for security-focused products.
  • Experience creating new product offerings, including Go-to-Market (GTM) strategy, pricing, product naming, legal contracts, and New Product Introduction (NPI).
  • Experience with defining and driving Threat Protection, Threat Intelligence, SaaS Security and Network Security as a product suite.
  • Experience across the product management lifecycle for enterprise security products or services.
  • Thirst for learning: able to go broad and deep across business and technical security contexts.
  • Track record of owning and delivering on large strategic projects – you can see the big picture, but deliver on the details.
  • Strong technical background that allows you to influence technical design and investment decisions, particularly in security architectures.
  • Ability to produce solid action plans from often incomplete, conflicting, or ambiguous security inputs.
  • Strong track record of influencing teams and operating effectively as a player-coach.
  • Excellent communication skills across technical and business audiences, especially when discussing complex security concepts.
  • Strong leadership skills and executive presence.
  • Passion for Okta’s immense opportunity and growth potential in the identity security market.
  • 8+ years product management experience.
  • Experience interviewing and selecting candidates.
  • Mentoring early-in-career product managers.

Preferred:

  • Advanced degree in a technical or business field.
  • Deep knowledge of enterprise security products and services, including cybersecurity frameworks and best practices.
  • Extensive knowledge of identity and access management (IAM) and its intersection with security.
  • Understanding of authentication, authorization, and threat detection standards.
  • Experience with developing user flows and enabling customizable security experiences.
  • Experience creating and managing multi-tenant SaaS security software products.

As part of the TDI Team, this individual will serve as the technical authority for the design, development, and evolution of our development platform for US Classified environments. This position’s mandate is to define the architectural vision for our air-gapped infrastructure, select and validate hardened tooling (e.g., Big Bang, Iron Bank, etc), and bridge the gap between strict DoD compliance requirements and modern DevOps velocity.

Strong preference will be given to those with a bias for action and the ability to solve complex "air gap" challenges outside the box.

What you’ll be doing

  • Act as the central point for defining and evolving the architecture of Okta Federal’s SIPR/JWICS environments, ensuring alignment with DoD reference designs while tailoring them to Okta’s specific product needs.
  • Design resilient, scalable infrastructure-as-code (IaC) and blueprints for air-gapped environments, solving unique challenges related to disconnected operations, cross-domain solutions (CDS), and "sneaker-net" patch management.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Engineering (ORD), Site Reliability Engineers (SREs), Business Application teams, Collaboration Engineering teams, and Security teams to translate complex compliance controls (DISA STIGs, RMF) into automated technical implementations that minimize friction for developers.
  • Guide the selection and integration of "High Side" tools and technologies, prioritizing compliant, maintainable, and low-vulnerability solutions (e.g., utilizing Iron Bank hardened containers) that deliver a superior user experience for internal engineering teams.
  • Review and approve architectural changes and major system upgrades across the classified boundary, ensuring that operational drift does not introduce security risks or break compliance postures.
  • Measure success through a combination of quantitative metrics (platform uptime, ATO velocity, patch latency, vulnerability resolution time) and qualitative feedback (developer satisfaction, ease of deployment).
  • Establish the technical strategy for "High Side" observability and continuous monitoring, designing architectures that satisfy strict auditing requirements without sacrificing operational visibility.

What you’ll bring to the role

  • 12+ years of experience in systems architecture, DevSecOps engineering, or a similar role, with at least 5 years focused on DoD Classified environments (IL6/Secret or higher).
  • Deep expertise in the DoD software ecosystem, specifically with Platform One/Cloud One, Big Bang, and Iron Bank. You should understand how to deploy, configure, and maintain these platforms in disconnected environments.
  • Strong understanding of Kubernetes (EKS/RKE2) and container orchestration in air-gapped setups, including the nuances of managing container registries, Helm charts, and sidecars without internet access.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience architecting solutions that meet strict federal compliance frameworks, specifically DoD CC SRG IL6, NIST 800-53, and FIPS 140-3 cryptography standards.
  • Proven experience working with Cross Domain Solutions (CDS) and architecting secure data transfer workflows between Low Side (IL5) and High Side (SIPR/JWICS) networks.
  • Experience implementing Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) principles in legacy or restrictive network environments.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to summarize and explain complex "High Side" constraints to uncleared Commercial stakeholders and influence decision-making across various business units.

This includes Application Sign-On Policy, Global Session Policy, Okta Account Management Policy (OAMP), and Device Signal Collection Policy as well as the underlying Policy Framework, Policy API, and Auth Pipeline that power them.

Policies is foundational to the entire Okta product portfolio as it's the decision layer that sits between every authentication event and the security experience a customer wants for their end users. You'll work closely with engineering, design, other product teams, and cross-functional stakeholders across Okta's platform to ensure policy capabilities evolve strategically, including how policy changes are rolled out and managed at scale (change management / identity operations).

What You'll Do

  • Own roadmap and prioritization for your product area, balancing customer requests, platform needs, and market/strategic differentiation
  • Collaborate with design and engineering to define, scope, and ship policies that have best-in-class user experience while meeting the security needs of Okta customers  
  • Drive product direction for the Policy Framework, Policy API, and Auth Pipeline that underpin every policy evaluation across Okta
  • Define how policy changes are managed operationally — versioning, staged rollout, auditability, and rollback — as part of a broader change management and identity operations strategy
  • Work directly with customers, Solutions Engineering, Support, and other product teams to understand policy needs and translate them into product requirements
  • Use AI tools to accelerate spec writing, competitive analysis, and rapid prototyping to drive roadmap alignment and execution
  • Collaborate with global cross-functional teams, including engineering, field teams, tech partnerships, and marketing, to ensure successful launch and adoption of policy-related experiences
  • Serve as the subject matter expert, representing Policies in customer escalations, executive briefings, and enterprise prospect evaluations, as well as partnerships with Marketing and GTM counterparts
  • Track industry trends in adaptive authentication, risk-based access, and session security to develop solutions differentiated from the competition

What You Bring to Okta

  • 6+ years experience in product management
  • Experience in identity, security, enterprise-scale, platform, or developer products
  • Ability to have in-depth technical discussions with engineering teams
  • Ability to connect platform-level decisions to Okta's broader business outcomes and market position as a technology leader
  • Ability to empathize and dig deeper into customer problems and needs before designing solutions
  • Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable flexing between spec-level detail and executive narrative
  • Entrepreneurial and ownership mindset - given an ambiguous problem, you decide what matters, decide what to do about it, and drive it forward
  • Collaborative by default - you strive to earn trust with customers, cross-functional partners, and stakeholders. Your default is to bring people in early and often to inform a blended, stronger direction

Nice to Have

  • Experience with policy engines, rules-based decisioning systems, or risk-scoring products
  • Experience with change management tooling, feature flagging, or safe-rollout systems at scale
  • Experience with non-human identity or agentic identity use cases as they relate to authentication policy
