Auth0, an Okta company, is the leading customer identity platform for developers. Our mission is to secure the world’s identities so innovators can innovate. As AI reshapes how applications are built and used, identity and security are becoming critical to enabling safe and trusted agentic experiences.

Our team builds Auth0 products for Agentic AI with a focus on agent identity, access management, and protocols that extend trust to our customers’ AI products. This includes enabling secure experiences for enterprise agents and the emerging class of personal agents that act on behalf of individuals.

The role is for a highly technical product manager who is adept at developing strong, customer-focused product strategies.

Responsibilities

 

  • Define and Execute the AI Product Strategy: Drive the roadmap and execution for Auth0’s AI portfolio, with a specific focus on Auth0 for AI Agents. Identify tactical integration opportunities and ecosystem partnerships that secure agentic workflows and deliver immediate value to developers.
  • Be an Owner and Builder (0-to-1): Bring a hands-on, entrepreneurial mindset to define, prototype, and launch new capabilities for AI applications. Balance rapid experimentation with the engineering discipline required to scale features into secure, production-grade products.
  • Collaborate and Influence Without Authority: Serve as the core product owner and direct collaborator for engineering, design, and security teams. Translate the broader AI product vision into concrete, technical requirements, managing the backlog to ensure the timely delivery of developer-friendly features.
  • Engage Directly with Developers and Customers: Gather direct feedback from the developer community and early adopters. Actively uncover pain points in AI implementation, including the needs of organizations building personal agents, and validate that Auth0’s AI capabilities solve real-world problems.
  • Be an AI Standards Expert: Strategize and implement emerging standards in AI and identity, with a focus on Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent interoperability, and the protocols that enable trusted agentic experiences.
  • Drive Cross-Functional Go-To-Market (GTM) Support: Partner closely with GTM teams (Product Marketing, Developer Relations, and Sales) to support successful product launches. Create technical enablement assets, documentation, and messaging to drive adoption of secure AI products.

 

Requirements

  • Senior Product Management Experience: 5–7+ years of product management experience, with a proven track record of building world-class agentic products. Experience with B2C and B2B SaaS, as well as developer-facing products, is strongly preferred.
  • Agentic AI Developer Credibility: Deep understanding of the emerging agent ecosystem, including personal agents. Ability to write code, work directly with APIs and SDKs, and build prototypes that validate customer and developer needs. Has defined and shipped successful API or SDK products for developer usage.
  • Deep Technical Acumen and Hands-On Developer Credibility: Strong understanding of identity protocols such as OAuth, OIDC, and SAML, as well as AI protocols and technologies including MCP and mTLS.
  • Proven “0-to-1” and Feature Launch Experience: Demonstrated success in building and launching new products, features, or programs from scratch, and executing the technical roadmap to scale them. Strong bias for execution and rapid prototyping. Startup founder or early-stage employee experience is a significant plus.
  • Exceptional Product Instincts: Ability to deeply understand developer pain points, security requirements, and friction in AI experiences, translating them into compelling, secure, and integrated product experiences.
  • Growth Mindset with Technical Depth: An individual contributor who is highly comfortable diving into technical API specifications, data schemas, and AI standards while collaborating on a Go-to-Market (GTM) strategy.
  • Collaboration and Influence Without Authority: The ability to drive alignment and lead through influence in a highly cross-functional organization, working daily with engineering, design, product marketing, developer relations, and sales teams.
  • Excellent Communication Skills: Consistently demonstrates an understanding of their audience when communicating by appropriately simplifying the message. The ability to concisely articulate complex technical architectures, developer workflows, and product value propositions clearly to both internal engineering teams and external developers.
  • Passion for AI and Identity: A genuine enthusiasm for the potential of AI and a deep, demonstrable interest in the future of secure identity for users and agents.

jobs.title: Growth Manager
jobs.description_html:
Who we are

Picogrid is a leading venture-backed defense technology company founded to bridge the decades-long gap between modern technology and the critical demands of national security. Today, we're building the essential infrastructure to unify sensors, autonomy, and operators with our technology deployed in active operations around the world. Our mission is to deliver an operational advantage to secure the United States and its allies.

About the role

As Growth Manager, you will develop and execute go-to-market strategies that establish Picogrid in priority markets and expand adoption across programs and customers. You will identify unmet needs, build relationships and shape strategic opportunities with Government Solutions and Mission Operations. You will own the capture strategy, solution narrative and value proposition for major pursuits, working with Engineering to develop credible technical approaches. You will also guide leadership decisions on market priorities, partnerships and investment while coaching Growth Strategists and leading substantive customer engagements.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for priority markets, mission areas and programs. Use customer insight, modernization priorities, defense budgets and competitive analysis to guide market entry, expansion, partnerships and investment.

  • Identify customer needs, build relationships and shape opportunities with Government Solutions and Mission Operations. Lead qualification and strategic capture, establishing sponsorship, funding and acquisition paths from initial adoption through sustained procurement.

  • Develop stakeholder engagement plans, teaming arrangements, pricing approaches and win themes. Direct the pursuit effort and make clear recommendations on resource commitments and bid decisions.

  • Lead development of proposed solutions with Engineering, Mission Operations and business leaders, combining Picogrid products and partner capabilities to meet customer needs. Align software licensing, integration scope and delivery assumptions with the commercial approach.

  • Own the solution narrative and value proposition across proposals, white papers and solution briefs. Write substantive content, direct contributors and lead reviews for persuasive differentiation, technical accuracy and compliance with solicitation requirements.

  • Lead customer pitches and partner discussions, and develop strategic presentations, executive briefings and leadership decision briefs. Explain the recommended approach, address objections and advance customer, teaming and investment decisions.

  • Coach Growth Strategists and develop the team’s analytical, writing and capture capabilities. Assign ownership, review work and resolve competing priorities across initiatives and pursuits.

  • Ability to travel (30-50%) to El Segundo and customer locations, such as Washington, DC; Ft Bragg, NC; Huntsville, AL; Colorado Springs, CO; and Tampa, FL.

Required qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in defense growth, capture, business development, management consulting, corporate or technology strategy, government acquisition or related national security work.

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical, analytical, policy or business-related field.

  • Demonstrated experience independently leading complex strategic initiatives or growth efforts, including developing a strategy, directing contributors and delivering measurable outcomes.

  • Practical knowledge of defense budgeting and procurement, including experience evaluating funding availability, contract pathways and acquisition timelines.

  • Exceptional written, verbal and visual communication skills, demonstrated through proposals, strategic presentations, executive briefings or other materials that explain complex technical and business concepts clearly.

  • Experience developing teaming or pricing approaches and working with technical colleagues to resolve scope, delivery and commercial tradeoffs.

  • Experience directing contributors across functions, reviewing their work and coaching colleagues while managing complex initiatives, competing priorities and fixed deadlines.

  • Eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance, including the applicable U.S. citizenship requirement.

Preferred qualifications

  • A record of government technology contract wins, funded capability adoption or prototype transition into sustained programs. Relevant pathways include Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR), Small Business Technology Transfer (STTR) and other transaction agreements.

  • Familiarity with commercial software licensing and government procurement of software, hardware and integration services.

  • Experience building partnerships with prime contractors, systems integrators or defense technology companies.

  • Domain knowledge in C2, tactical communications, intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance, or distributed systems.

  • Active U.S. Secret or Top Secret security clearance.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Base salary range: $140,000–$189,000 +15-30% performance incentives. Base salary is just one part of your total compensation package.

  • Significant stock options with a high potential upside as an early-stage company

  • 401(k) with employer matching

jobs.title: Cleared Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.location: Denver, CO; Seattle, WA; Washington, DC
jobs.description_html:
What You’ll Be Doing

Our customers run satellite missions on our software. Failure isn't an option. As a Forward Deployed Product Engineer, you make sure our software holds up at the edge, where it matters most.

You'll also spot what's missing, what could be simpler, and what should exist but doesn't yet, then turn those observations into product direction.

This is a product role as much as an engineering one. You'll work in the field, in ops centers, and alongside customers. You're a generalist who moves across the full stack, from infrastructure to frontend, and you use AI as leverage to ship faster. At Quindar, we believe the future belongs to engineers who use AI to move faster, build better, and shape the next generation of our products

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Configure and deploy our software in customer environments, ensuring reliability and performance across complex workflows.

  • Troubleshoot issues across backend APIs, cloud infrastructure, databases, and the frontend.

  • Travel to customer sites and embed with operations teams, building trusted technical relationships.

  • Prototype products and iterate quickly with live customer data and direct feedback.

  • Act as the voice of the customer in product discussions, translating field insights into roadmap priorities, solutions, and integrations.

  • Partner with Product & Engineering to turn successful prototypes into production code.

  • Develop playbooks for repeatable integrations and maintain clear documentation and training resources.

Qualifications

  • Education:

    • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Aerospace, Engineering, or a related field.

  • Experience:

    • 3+ years of experience in software engineering, with a focus on customer-facing roles.

    • Proven track record of building, deploying, or supporting production software in mission-critical environments.

  • Technical Skills:

    • Proficiency in Python; experience with TypeScript, Java, or similar is a plus.

    • Experience building software with AI tools such as Cursor, Amp, ChatGPT

    • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), databases, and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Soft Skills:

    • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

    • Strong product sense: ability to question requirements, spot patterns, solve problems for the users.

    • Bias toward action: comfortable shipping prototypes quickly and iterating.

    • Adaptability and curiosity, thriving in ambiguous, fast-changing environments.

  • Certifications:

    • Relevant certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Certified Kubernetes Administrator) are a plus.

  • Clearance:

    • Active US Security Clearance (TS/SCI) required

ITAR REQUIREMENTS

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Mission Planning
jobs.location: Denver, CO; Seattle, WA; Washington, DC; San Francisco, CA; Los Angeles, CA
jobs.description_html:
Product Manager, Mission Planning

We’re looking for a technically minded Product Manager to join our growing team and lead the evolution of Quindar’s Mission Planning capabilities across our Plan and Portal products.

Quindar provides a unified platform to automate and accelerate mission operations. Our customers operate constellations with different missions, architectures, operational constraints, and levels of autonomy. Mission Planning sits at the intersection of those needs: helping operators understand what needs to happen, when it can happen, what constraints apply, and how plans ultimately become operational activities.

In this role, you’ll own how missions translate operational objectives into executable plans, from scheduling spacecraft activities and ground contacts to coordinating requests between mission teams, payload operators, and other stakeholders. You’ll help make increasingly complex mission operations easier to plan, coordinate, and automate as our customers scale from individual spacecraft to large, diverse fleets.

You’ll own key parts of the product lifecycle — from discovery and prioritization to launch and iteration — working closely with engineering, design, customer-facing teams, and other Product Managers. You should be comfortable diving into scheduling logic, operational constraints, mission workflows, and system architecture while keeping user empathy and product clarity at the center of your decisions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategy & Vision: Own the roadmap and long-term vision for Mission Planning across Quindar’s Plan and Portal products. Define product requirements, user stories, success metrics, and priorities that align customer needs with Quindar’s broader mission operations strategy.

  • Execution: Collaborate closely with engineering and design to turn operational problems into intuitive, scalable product capabilities. Participate in technical and architecture discussions and make thoughtful tradeoffs between immediate customer needs, usability, and long-term product health.

  • User Understanding: Develop deep empathy for mission operators, payload operators, mission planners, and other users by conducting research, shadowing workflows, analyzing operational data, and synthesizing feedback from customer-facing teams.

  • Automation & Scale: Identify opportunities to move customers from manual planning and coordination toward increasingly automated and constraint-aware workflows. Ensure planning capabilities can scale from individual spacecraft to large fleets and increasingly complex mission architectures.

  • Planning & Scheduling: Evolve how operators plan spacecraft activities, ground contacts, payload operations, and other mission activities. Develop capabilities that account for operational constraints, resource availability, dependencies, priorities, and changing mission conditions.

  • Multi-Party Mission Operations: Define workflows that enable mission operators, payload operators, customers, and other stakeholders to coordinate effectively while maintaining appropriate operational boundaries and permissions. Make it easy for users to request activities, understand their status, and maintain situational awareness without requiring direct control of the spacecraft.

  • Metrics & Iteration: Define and track measures of planning effectiveness, including planning time, scheduling success, operator intervention, request turnaround, utilization, and adoption of automated workflows. Use data and customer feedback to continuously improve the product.

  • Leadership: Serve as the go-to expert on mission planning workflows, scheduling, payload operations, and the relevant competitive landscape. Develop a strong point of view on how mission planning should evolve as satellite operations become more distributed and autonomous.

  • Collaboration: Drive alignment across engineering, product management, design, customer success, program teams, and leadership. Clearly communicate priorities, dependencies, and tradeoffs across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What Makes This Role Unique

  • You’ll shape how complex spacecraft operations move from mission objectives to executable plans.

  • You’ll design workflows for an increasingly diverse set of operators — from teams directly commanding spacecraft to payload customers who need awareness and access without owning the spacecraft bus.

  • You’ll tackle planning problems involving real operational constraints, limited resources, competing priorities, and dynamic mission conditions.

  • You’ll help customers transition from manual scheduling and coordination toward increasingly automated mission planning.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of product management experience, preferably in aerospace, schedule optimization, autonomous vehicle operations, or complex technical SaaS products.

  • Proven ability to own product roadmaps and deliver complex features end-to-end.

  • Ability to obtain a U.S. Security Clearance required.

  • Demonstrated ability to understand complex user workflows and translate them into intuitive product experiences.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, cross-functional leadership, and prioritization skills.

  • Bachelor’s degree in geospatial, computer science, aerospace, business, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced, evolving environment with high ownership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with satellite mission planning, spacecraft operations, ground segment systems, or aerospace scheduling.

  • Experience designing products for multiple user personas with different roles, permissions, and levels of operational authority.

  • Active U.S. Security Clearance (Secret or higher) preferred


ITAR REQUIREMENTS

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. jobs.title: Account Executive, NAS Product Specialist
jobs.description_html:
About the Team & Role

Rubrik's Product Line Sales organization drives focused growth across Rubrik's specialized workloads, including our Unstructured data protection and security portfolio. This team partners closely with core Account Executives, Sales Engineers, and Customer Success to bring deep product and technical expertise into every Unstructured opportunity — from first conversation through technical validation to close.

We're hiring an NCD Product Line Sales Specialist to own and accelerate Rubrik's Unstructured data protection business within a defined territory. This is a highly technical, quota-carrying overlay role: you'll be the subject-matter expert who can go deep on NAS storage architectures, file-generating applications, backup and recovery mechanics, and the security behind protecting these growing assets — and use that fluency to win deals against competitive point solutions. The ideal candidate has sold in this exact space before, at a company like NetApp, Dell, Qumulo, Vast, EverPure, Komprise, Superna, etc.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the NCD product line number: partner with core Account Executives to identify, qualify, and close NCD data protection and security opportunities across net-new and existing accounts.
  • Lead with technical credibility: articulate Rubrik’s NCD architecture, security posture, and the gaps in storage native shared snapshot protection in a way that resonates with both technical and business buyers.
  • Drive technical discovery and validation: run or co-lead discovery calls, demos, and proof-of-concept engagements for NCD.
  • Win competitive deals: build and defend positioning against competition or "do-nothing", translating technical differentiation into business value.
  • Build territory and account plans: develop a coverage strategy in partnership with core sales, SE, and channel teams to maximize NCD attach and expansion within the install base.
  • Engage multiple stakeholders: present to IT administrators, security and compliance teams, and executive economic buyers, tailoring the message to each audience.
  • Forecast with discipline: maintain accurate pipeline and forecast data in Salesforce and participate in regular business reviews.
  • Stay current: maintain deep knowledge of Rubrik’s NCD roadmap, storage ecosystems, and the competitive landscape.

Experience You’ll Need

  • Storage sales experience: 3+ years of quota-carrying sales experience selling storage infrastructure (file preferred) with a deep understanding of these technologies.
  • Directly relevant background: experience at a NAS or file storage vendor such as NetApp, Dell, Qumulo, or VAST (or a comparable company like Komprise, Superna, or EverPure) is strongly preferred.
  • Genuine technical depth: comfortable discussing NAS architectures (NetApp ONTAP, Dell PowerScale/Isilon, Qumulo, VAST), SMB/NFS protocols, snapshots and replication, file-generating applications, and ransomware and compliance requirements for unstructured data without relying solely on a Sales Engineer.
  • Proven technical selling motion: a track record of running or co-leading technical discovery, sizing, and proof-of-concept engagements for storage or data protection solutions, not just handing off to a technical resource.
  • Consultative approach: comfortable navigating complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles across storage and infrastructure teams, security, and executive buyers in mid-market and enterprise accounts.
  • Overlay/specialist experience: prior success working in a platform-selling model alongside core Account Executives, Sales Engineers, and Customer Success.
  • Track record: consistent history of quota attainment and strong pipeline generation.
  • Education: bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on familiarity with enterprise NAS platforms, data management or tiering tools, and backup and recovery workflows for large unstructured data sets.
  • Experience selling a data security or resiliency platform that spans on-premises, cloud, and SaaS workloads.
  • Existing relationships with storage, infrastructure, security, or compliance buyers in target accounts.

#LI-DNI

jobs.title: Account Executive, NAS Product Specialist
jobs.description_html:
About the Team & Role

Rubrik's Product Line Sales organization drives focused growth across Rubrik's specialized workloads, including our Unstructured data protection and security portfolio. This team partners closely with core Account Executives, Sales Engineers, and Customer Success to bring deep product and technical expertise into every Unstructured opportunity — from first conversation through technical validation to close.

We're hiring an NCD Product Line Sales Specialist to own and accelerate Rubrik's Unstructured data protection business within a defined territory. This is a highly technical, quota-carrying overlay role: you'll be the subject-matter expert who can go deep on NAS storage architectures, file-generating applications, backup and recovery mechanics, and the security behind protecting these growing assets — and use that fluency to win deals against competitive point solutions. The ideal candidate has sold in this exact space before, at a company like NetApp, Dell, Qumulo, Vast, EverPure, Komprise, Superna, etc.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the NCD product line number: partner with core Account Executives to identify, qualify, and close NCD data protection and security opportunities across net-new and existing accounts.
  • Lead with technical credibility: articulate Rubrik’s NCD architecture, security posture, and the gaps in storage native shared snapshot protection in a way that resonates with both technical and business buyers.
  • Drive technical discovery and validation: run or co-lead discovery calls, demos, and proof-of-concept engagements for NCD.
  • Win competitive deals: build and defend positioning against competition or "do-nothing", translating technical differentiation into business value.
  • Build territory and account plans: develop a coverage strategy in partnership with core sales, SE, and channel teams to maximize NCD attach and expansion within the install base.
  • Engage multiple stakeholders: present to IT administrators, security and compliance teams, and executive economic buyers, tailoring the message to each audience.
  • Forecast with discipline: maintain accurate pipeline and forecast data in Salesforce and participate in regular business reviews.
  • Stay current: maintain deep knowledge of Rubrik’s NCD roadmap, storage ecosystems, and the competitive landscape.

Experience You’ll Need

  • Storage sales experience: 3+ years of quota-carrying sales experience selling storage infrastructure (file preferred) with a deep understanding of these technologies.
  • Directly relevant background: experience at a NAS or file storage vendor such as NetApp, Dell, Qumulo, or VAST (or a comparable company like Komprise, Superna, or EverPure) is strongly preferred.
  • Genuine technical depth: comfortable discussing NAS architectures (NetApp ONTAP, Dell PowerScale/Isilon, Qumulo, VAST), SMB/NFS protocols, snapshots and replication, file-generating applications, and ransomware and compliance requirements for unstructured data without relying solely on a Sales Engineer.
  • Proven technical selling motion: a track record of running or co-leading technical discovery, sizing, and proof-of-concept engagements for storage or data protection solutions, not just handing off to a technical resource.
  • Consultative approach: comfortable navigating complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles across storage and infrastructure teams, security, and executive buyers in mid-market and enterprise accounts.
  • Overlay/specialist experience: prior success working in a platform-selling model alongside core Account Executives, Sales Engineers, and Customer Success.
  • Track record: consistent history of quota attainment and strong pipeline generation.
  • Education: bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on familiarity with enterprise NAS platforms, data management or tiering tools, and backup and recovery workflows for large unstructured data sets.
  • Experience selling a data security or resiliency platform that spans on-premises, cloud, and SaaS workloads.
  • Existing relationships with storage, infrastructure, security, or compliance buyers in target accounts.

jobs.title: Advisory Solutions Architect, MSP (New Product Intro)
jobs.description_html:
Help shape how Rubrik partners with leading service providers to deliver cyber resilience at scale. The New Product Introduction (NPI) & Service Creation Solution Architect is a new function in the MSP Solution Architecture Team. You will design, package and enable new managed service offerings built on Rubrik's data protection, cyber resilience and recovery portfolio, and turn them into repeatable programs that MSPs, MSSPs and cloud providers can adopt at scale. 

You own the technical service blueprint from concept through launch. You also support strategic presales into large global MSPs and work hand in hand with Sales, Product and Engineering, Marketing and Competitive Intelligence teams. The role reports to the Global Director, MSP Solution Architects, is highly partner-facing, and requires significant travel.

Why You'll Love This Role:

  • Build something new: This is a founding role in a new function. You will create the offerings, programs and playbooks from the ground up, then see them launched, adopted and sold by real partners.
  • Make a visible difference: The services you design help service providers protect and recover their customers' data when ransomware and cyber attacks strike.
  • Influence and autonomy: You will work directly with senior leaders across Sales, Product, Engineering and Marketing and with executives at leading service providers, with the freedom to take your own ideas from concept to launch.
  • Build with AI every day: Work in an environment where building with Claude and Claude Code is encouraged and expected, and shape how the team uses AI to move faster.

Key Responsibilities:

Service Creation & Partner Workshops

  • Define and prioritize new service offerings (managed backup, DRaaS, cyber recovery, SaaS backup, ransomware readiness) with Product Management and translate roadmaps into service blueprints and scalable reference architectures covering SLAs, tiers, security, compliance and sovereignty.
  • Own and run a repeatable partner service co-creation workshop program, from joint scoping through launch, owning post-workshop outcomes so each partner moves to a defined, launched and sold service, and tracking partner satisfaction and conversion to launched services.
  • Build and maintain a service adoption tracker with analytics on partner adoption, workshop-to-launch conversion and service results, and use it to continuously improve the program with new templates, feedback surveys and facilitation tooling, in partnership with Sales and Product leadership.
  • Enhance existing partner planning tools with standard sizing guidelines, configuration patterns and partner business-case templates (financial, ROI/TCO, pricing) that turn a design into a priced service.

Presales & Partner Engagement

  • Support strategic opportunities that depend on new services: discovery, requirements capture (RPO/RTO, sovereignty, compliance) and high-level solution design.
  • Lead hands-on workshops and demos to validate architectures against partner and customer environments.
  • Maintain a trusted cadence with strategic MSP partners, track commitments to closure, and keep engagement activity visible to leadership.

Enablement, Content & Product-to-Field Bridge

  • Create delivery playbooks, runbooks, service descriptions, onboarding methodologies, training assets and webinars so partner delivery is high-quality and repeatable.
  • Represent MSP readiness in NPI launches and own roadmap visibility for partners and the SA team, ensuring partners and the field are ready to sell and operate new capabilities at launch, and continuously improve the Claude skill that turns the product roadmap into tailored feature adoption recommendations for MSP partner account teams, refining it every release cycle based on partner feedback and adoption results.
  • Own the MSP content strategy and thought leadership (blogs, webinars, newsletter, partner portal, video) and run recurring programs on a dependable cadence with clear KPIs.

AI-Enabled Building

  • AI is central to this role. You must be a builder with excellent hands-on Claude, Claude Code and Cowork experience, and a track record of turning your work into repeatable assets: skills, automations and tools that others on the team use.
  • Build and maintain a library of Claude skills and rapid prototypes for MSP work, such as partner prep, partner collateral, roadmap summaries, and sizing and pricing calculators, connected to enterprise systems and run on a schedule.
  • Make AI output trustworthy and scalable: use grounding and review gates so content is safe for partners, follow AI governance and data-handling rules, and teach the team through live builds.

Required Qualifications:

  • 10+ years as a Solutions Architect, Services Architect or Senior Consultant in data protection, storage or cloud infrastructure vendors, MSPs or integrators.
  • Deep experience designing complex backup, recovery and cyber resilience solutions, with strong virtualization and hyperscaler (AWS, Azure, GCP) background. Rubrik platform depth is expected, or achievable through certification within 90 days.
  • Proven track record creating standardized managed services (SLAs, catalogs, runbooks), with at least one taken from design through launch and adoption, and a solid grasp of backup security and compliance principles.
  • Excellent communication from C-suite to individual contributors, with strong workshop facilitation, whiteboarding and writing skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Background as a solutions architect at an MSP or MSSP, or at a data protection and cyber resilience vendor that serves them, with deep knowledge of cyber resilience service offerings.
  • Has been on the other side of the table: a technical architecture role at a service provider, with end-to-end experience of how services are defined, built, operated and managed. Candidates with this full experience are strongly preferred.
  • Hands-on infrastructure operations (storage, networking, identity), ITSM and SIEM/SOAR familiarity, and ransomware recovery and cyber-resilient architecture experience.
  • Relevant certifications: data protection vendor, cloud architect, security (CISSP, CISM, CCSK).

Key Competencies:

  • Service and architecture mindset: Designs repeatable, catalog-ready offerings with clear SLAs, and measures success by whether partners launch and sell them.
  • Cross-functional influence and partner trust: Works hand in hand with Sales, Product and Engineering, Marketing and Competitive teams, and earns partners' trust as an extension of their team.
  • Self-starter and builder: Brings fresh perspectives and new ideas and drives them from conception to execution without waiting for direction. Builds tools, skills and automations that make work repeatable, and shares them with the team.
  • Organized, relentless execution: Plans the work, juggles multiple workstreams, and drives each one to completion with disciplined follow-through and a dependable cadence. Closes every loop.
  • Communication at every level: Communicates clearly and credibly from the C-suite to individual contributors, with a bias for action and the hustle to get things done.

Travel Expectations:

  • Travel is expected to be high, including regular partner workshops, customer meetings and company events.

 

#LI-MR2

jobs.title: Cloud Architect, Product Management
jobs.description_html:
Cloud Architect, Product Management 

Location: Seattle, WA (Remote) or Palo Alto, CA (Hybrid)

About the Role

We are seeking a hands-on, technically deep Cloud Architect to serve as the critical technical bridge between our Engineering, Product Management, and Field teams. In this role, you will act as the primary subject matter expert on the cloud services we support, ensuring our product vision translates into technically sound, commercially viable solutions.

You thrive at the intersection of technical execution and product strategy. You’ll guide Product Managers during the product development process to ensure first releases of our features meet rigorous enterprise standards, while simultaneously partnering with field teams to ensure post-sale implementations land successfully in complex customer cloud environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Product Strategy & Design: Serve as the technical SME to help PMs translate complex cloud requirements into actionable product requirements and PRDs.
  • Architecture Validation: Work closely with PM and Engineering to design and validate architectures and workflows that meet enterprise-grade performance and security standards.
  • Implementation Excellence: Lead the "last mile" of product success by ensuring field teams have the right documentation, technical enablement, and architectural guides to make post-sale implementations successful.
  • Hands-on Validation: Conduct hands-on validation of new features in lab and customer environments to ensure they solve real-world challenges before full-scale rollout.
  • Field Readiness: Support the Sales Engineering and Professional Services organizations by validating field-facing content, including solution briefs, demos, and technical enablement materials.
  • Trusted Advisor: Act as a technical consultant to key customers and partners, helping them navigate cloud architecture and integration questions.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Experience: 10+ years of experience in Cloud Architecture, Sales Engineering, or Technical Product roles within a cybersecurity or enterprise software company.
  • Technical Depth: Strong expertise in major cloud service providers (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and a deep understanding of cloud infrastructure, APIs, and identity services.
  • Execution: Proven ability to go "hands-on"—you can perform deep-dive demos, validate complex integrations, and troubleshoot implementation hurdles in real-time.
  • Communication: Excellent skills in translating technical nuances into business value for both executive stakeholders and technical practitioners.
  • Collaboration: Comfortable working cross-functionally with engineering, product, and go-to-market teams in a fast-paced environment

Preferred:

  • Specialization: Prior experience in cloud security, data resilience, or hybrid cloud infrastructure.
  • Persona Knowledge: Experience working directly with Cloud Architects, or Security Engineering teams to solve architectural bottlenecks.

jobs.title: Global Head of GSI Solutions Architecture
jobs.description_html:
Global Partner Engineering is the technical engine behind Rubrik's partner business. We work with global systems integrators, channel partners, managed service providers and technology alliances to help them build, sell and support Rubrik at scale.

Our GSI team works with the largest integrators in the world. We co-create joint solutions with their practices, enable their practitioners through certification, and partner with our field teams to win large, complex deals. Partners are a core part of how Rubrik grows, and this team makes that real.

What this role will do:

You will lead Rubrik's global GSI technical organization, with two integrated charters that work as one system.

  • Global Solutions - Architects build the play for named global GSIs: joint offers, reference architectures, blueprints and certification strategy with partner COEs. They work with Product on what is coming next and feed roadmap gaps back.
  • Global Go-to-market - Architects run the play in the region. They pair with partner sellers and Rubrik account teams to build joint pipelines, shape deals, lead demos and POCs through close, and activate Black Belts.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the global GSI technical strategy. Define the KPIs, targets and investment priorities that connect team effort to partner-sourced and influenced pipeline and revenue.
  • Shape the joint solution portfolio. Decide which GSIs get which offers, and run a repeatable pipeline that takes each offer from idea to adoption across our four product lines: enterprise and cloud data, identity, SaaS and AI agents.
  • Build the operating system for the business. Run on cadence, clear ownership and one source of truth, so leaders spend their time on strategy and outcomes, not status.
  • Drive deal excellence across every GSI motion, whether GSI-led, co-led or field-led. Bring the visibility and discipline to prioritize the right opportunities and win the technical decision.
  • Be the senior technical voice with GSI executives and COE leaders. Partner with Rubrik Product, Marketing, Sales and Alliances to turn what GSIs need to sell into what we build next.
  • Scale the partner field. Enable and certify GSI practitioners so partners can position and deliver Rubrik on their own.
  • Attract, develop and retain high-agency leaders across the Americas, EMEA and APJ, and build a deep bench.
  • Lead the team's AI transformation, with a clear productivity baseline, targets and new ways of working.

Why you will love this job:

  • Growth at scale. Rubrik has passed $1.6B in subscription ARR and is growing over 30% year over year.
  • A category we created. Cyber resilience started here, and the market now follows our lead.
  • Partners are a strategic priority, with executive sponsorship from the top and a seat at the table.
  • A real build. A strong foundation and a clear mandate to scale and shape a global organization.
  • The most exciting product shift in the industry. Identity resilience, SaaS data protection and Rubrik Agent Cloud give GSIs new services to build around.
  • Direct impact. Your offers and relationships will show up in pipeline and closed deals you can point to.
  • A team that moves fast, tries AI first, and rewards people who own outcomes.

Requirements:

  • 12+ years in solution architecture, pre-sales engineering, partner engineering or a related technical go-to-market role.
  • 5+ years leading teams, including managing managers, with a global footprint across regions.
  • Proven track record of building repeatable solutions, blueprints or offers that the field and partners adopt at scale.
  • Experience designing KPIs, scorecards and operating cadences that drive behavior and outcomes.
  • Executive presence. You can earn credibility with senior leaders at GSIs and inside Rubrik.
  • Strong grasp of enterprise data, cloud or security. You will ramp quickly on Rubrik's platform.
  • Comfort with Salesforce and data-driven management of pipeline and deals.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Nice to have:

  • Experience working directly with GSIs or in alliance and partner organizations.
  • Background in cyber resilience, backup and recovery, identity, SaaS or AI and agentic systems.
  • Experience in both direct field and partner-led selling.

jobs.title: Global Solutions Architect
jobs.description_html:
About the role

Rubrik Professional Services is hiring a Global Solutions Architect to serve as our most senior technical authority for public cloud. This is a global, individual-contributor role at Technical Director level. You will set the architectural direction for how Rubrik is designed, deployed, and operated in the world’s most demanding cloud environments — and you will carry that direction personally into our most strategic customer engagements.

You will be deployed where technical risk is highest: flagship accounts, first-of-a-kind architectures, and the engagements whose outcome sets the pattern everyone else follows. Between those engagements, you will convert what you learned into the reference architectures, service offerings, and enablement that raise the capability of every architect and consultant in the field. Your impact is measured by the quality of the practice you leave behind, not the hours you personally bill.

We are looking for depth in public cloud architecture first. Deep Rubrik product expertise is expected to be built on the job. If you have architected large-scale data, storage, or security platforms across AWS, Azure, and GCP, and you can learn a new platform quickly and completely, we want to talk.

What you will do

Set technical direction

  • Own the global cloud architecture standard for Rubrik Professional Services — reference architectures, design patterns, guardrails, and documented anti-patterns
  • Act as the final technical escalation point for cloud architecture decisions on strategic engagements worldwide
  • Define the technical shape of our cloud service offerings: what we sell, how it is scoped, and what good delivery looks like
  • Establish Rubrik PS’s position on emerging cloud capabilities and translate them into deployment guidance before customers ask

Lead the hardest engagements

  • Own architecture and design on the most complex, highest-visibility customer engagements globally — multi-region, multi-cloud, and multi-regulator estates

Serve as trusted advisor to customer CIO, CTO, Chief Architect, and CISO stakeholders, and defend design decisions in front of customer architecture review boards

  • Partner with Sales and Pre-Sales on strategic pursuits: technical validation, level of effort, and honest risk assessment on the deals we cannot afford to get wrong
  • Lead briefings and multi-day design workshops on site and remotely

Scale yourself through the practice

  • Build the intellectual property that multiplies your reach — reference architectures, deployment automation, design templates, decision trees, and delivery accelerators
  • Mentor and technically develop Solutions Architects and senior consultants across all theatres; raise the ceiling of the practice, not just your own output
  • Define technical competency standards and enablement for cloud within Professional Services, and help set the hiring bar through technical interviews
  • Represent Rubrik Professional Services externally at conferences, customer advisory boards, and in published technical material

Influence the product

  • Act as the field’s most credible voice into Product Management and Engineering, backed by evidence from our largest deployments
  • Shape roadmap priorities, supportability, and cloud-native feature direction
  • Partner with Support and Customer Success on systemic technical issues before they become patterns
  • Work with PS Operations and leadership to turn field learning into better scoping models, estimates, and delivery methodology

What you bring

  • 15+ years overall experience, including 8+ years as a hands-on cloud architect at enterprise scale
  • Demonstrated ownership of architecture for multi-region, multi-account or multi-subscription cloud estates, in a large enterprise or a consulting / professional services organization
  • Expert-level AWS and Azure; GCP strongly preferred. Genuine depth across compute, storage, networking, identity, and encryption / key management
  • Deep understanding of enterprise data protection and cyber resilience — RTO and RPO modelling, immutability, backup and recovery design, isolated and air-gapped recovery
  • Working fluency in cloud security and compliance frameworks and how they constrain design in regulated industries
  • Strong automation background — infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep), scripting (Python, PowerShell), API-first integration, and CI/CD (Strong Automation Background)
  • A track record of influence without authority across a global, matrixed organization and multiple time zones
  • Executive-grade communication — credible with a customer’s CIO and their principal engineer on the same day
  • Evidence of building reusable technical IP, not only delivering successful projects
  • The ability to learn a complex new platform to expert depth, quickly. Prior Rubrik experience is not required
  • Occasional travel

Nice to have

  • Kubernetes and containerized workload architecture; cloud-native and managed database platforms
  • SaaS data protection experience (Microsoft 365, Salesforce, and similar)
  • Prior Principal, Distinguished, or Technical Director title within a vendor professional services organization or a major systems integrator
  • Professional or expert-level certifications (AWS Solutions Architect – Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or equivalent)
  • An established public technical presence — talks, writing, open source, or community leadership

What success looks like

  • First 90 days: Rubrik platform depth established, current cloud reference architectures assessed, and the top three gaps in our cloud delivery capability identified and evidenced
  • First 6 months: Leading architecture on at least two strategic global engagements; first published reference architecture or accelerator in field use
  • First 12 months: Recognized as the escalation point for cloud architecture across all theatres; measurable improvement in scoping accuracy and delivery consistency on cloud engagements; a named group of architects visibly stronger for your mentorship

jobs.title: Staff Platform Product Manager, Platform & Cloud Security
jobs.description_html:
Staff Platform Product Manager,  Cloud Security Architecture

Location: Remote, USA

The Staff Product Manager for Cloud Security Architecture is a strategic role responsible for ensuring that Rubrik's cloud product offerings meet enterprise expectations for security and are secured from cyber-attacks. This technical role combines deep security expertise with strong product instincts and competitor awareness to translate customers' security challenges and concerns into actionable product requirements for Rubrik’s cloud product and cloud platform security roadmap. 

Our product stands on a foundation of "Zero Trust" security and this role is critical in driving the long-term security vision and roadmap with a  focus on identifying product gaps, market opportunities, developing long-term strategic plans, and implementing enhancements that drive industry-leading security standards and best practices into Rubrik products.

Specific Responsibilities:

  • Works closely with cloud product and engineering teams to develop a deep understanding of the Rubrik cloud product architecture
    1. Ability to articulate and defend our architectural decisions cross functionally and to customers.  
    2. Contribute to cloud product and cloud platform  security roadmap and execute for multiple, related security domains within the Rubrik offering, ensuring alignment and coherence across the portfolio.
    3. Scan and keep abreast ofcustomer expectations and evolving hyperscaler best practices.
  • Act as a primary evangelist for the cloud product security and work with customers and account teams to define and evolve the roadmap across multiple dimensions (UX, technology, business) and deliver commercially viable security features and integrations across the Rubrik cloud portfolio
  • Lead cross-functional strategic initiatives and manage the execution across all cloud products, ensuring they meet platform security standards.
  • Lead and develop product risk identification, assessment, and resolution prioritization for high-impact platform vulnerabilities.
  • Partner with and influence senior cross-functional stakeholders—including InfoSec, Engineering, User Experience, Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Support—to align vision across business units and secure project approval and resources.
  • Communicate concisely and clearly to diverse audiences, including presenting compelling business cases to executive leadership and representing Rubrik as a security expert to external audiences, customers, and ecosystem partners.
  • Drive significant business impact by identifying market opportunities and leading new product developments that contribute measurable increases to quarterly revenue, profitability, and customer trust.
  • Act as a mentor and role model for other Product Managers, sharing best practices, driving clarity in the face of ambiguity cross-functionally, and fostering strong partnerships with engineering teams.

Required Skills:

  • Experience or desire to be in Product Management, with at least 3 years focused on enterprise cloud product development with hyperscalers, ideally in a hands-on technical or architecture role.
  • Prior experience as a Security Architect, Solutions Architect, or Senior/Staff Engineer is highly desirable
  • Expertise in cloud security and threat modeling and working knowledge of big 3 hyperscalers with specific experience in cloud security posture management or secure cloud integration and defining secure architectures for solutions built on hyperscaler infrastructure.
  • Practical experience with API security, microservices architecture, and container security (e.g., Kubernetes).
  • Demonstrated success in owning and managing the strategy and execution of multiple, high-impact products simultaneously, leveraging a deep understanding of the underlying technology stack.
  • Proven ability to define, scope, and deliver large, complex features, leveraging deep technical acumen to define architecture, requirements, and measurable KPIs/goals while engaging effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience in the following security domains:
    • Zero Trust architecture and security principles, including experience translating those principles into product requirements
    • Authentication and authorization (SSO, SAML, OpenID, RBAC), for both human and non-human (API) actions
    • Data protection, immutable storage, and encryption technologies, including understanding of cryptographic primitives and key management architectures.
  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering) or equivalent work experience; advanced degree and/or relevant cybersecurity certifications (e.g., CCSP, CISSP, CCSK) highly desired.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Databases
jobs.description_html:
Staff Product Manager, Databases

Location: US - Remote

About Us

Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls.

About the Product Management Team

At Rubrik, our Product Management team is at the forefront of defining the strategy and driving execution to strengthen our leading platform for cyber-resilience. We are dedicated to meeting the ever-changing data management and security needs of our customers and wear multiple hats throughout the different stages in the product lifecycle and set the vision for our growing family of products. As advocates for both our users and our business, Product Managers balance varied perspectives and empower their teams to do great work.

About the Role

When a bank or a hospital loses a critical database to ransomware or a bad change, nobody asks about backup schedules. They ask how fast it's back and whether they can trust what came back. Your job is to make Rubrik the answer to both questions for Oracle.

You'll join the Databases product team with Oracle as your first focus, and own it end to end, from strategy to the outcomes customers see. Oracle is one of the hardest workloads we protect. Our customers run their most important systems on it. You'll also lead work that spans several databases, with the PMs who own them as partners.

This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director of Product Management, Databases. You'll work with engineering teams in the US and India.

What You'll Do

  • Own the Oracle roadmap. Set how Rubrik protects and recovers Oracle across RAC, Exadata, Data Guard, on-premises and cloud. Weigh recovery speed against data loss and effort, and make the call.
  • Be the product voice with customers. Run deep dives with DBAs, present to executives when the stakes are high, and explain where Rubrik fits next to Oracle's own tools and other vendors.
  • Turn escalations into product. When a restore matters, you're on the call for product, alongside support, engineering and the customer's DBAs and executives. Bring a plan, then fix the cause in the product.
  • Drive work across databases. Lead initiatives that span several databases, such as recovering whole applications in the right order and proving that backups restore, and help decide which databases we protect next.
  • Choose with evidence. Use customer conversations, usage and support data to make the business case for what to build and what to defer. Write requirements engineers trust, with your reasoning shown.
  • Launch and land. Give sales engineers the positioning and training they need, and join the field on large enterprise deals. Work with partners such as Oracle and Everpure, and track adoption after launch.

What Success Looks Like

  • In 3 months, you've met customers, sales engineers and support. You know where Oracle protection works well and where customers need more, and you've written your view of the roadmap.
  • In 6 months, you're the go-to person for Oracle at Rubrik, and your roadmap shapes what engineering builds.
  • In 12 months, you've shipped improvements Oracle customers notice. You're leading a cross-database initiative with engineering, and you've fixed the root cause of a problem customers kept raising.

What You'll Bring

  • Hands-on experience with Oracle backup and recovery. You can explain how RMAN backups, archived redo logs and point-in-time recovery work, and what Data Guard and RAC change. You've run Oracle in production, supported it or built products for it, and you can go deep on architecture with engineers.
  • Typically 8+ years of product management for technical enterprise products, or equivalent years as a DBA, solutions architect or sales engineer whose calls changed what a team built or bought. You don't need a PM title, but tell us what you changed.
  • Comfort in front of customers at every level, from a room of DBAs to a CIO.
  • Clear, precise writing and speaking. You can turn a messy situation into a short doc that gets a decision.
  • A zero-to-one mindset. You'll write the plan for work that doesn't have one yet, and do what needs doing whatever your title says.
  • Fluency with AI tools in how you research and write.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Exadata, Oracle Database Appliance, or Oracle Database on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), AWS or Azure.
  • Experience with other enterprise databases, such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL or Db2.
  • Background in data protection, disaster recovery or cyber resilience.
  • Experience working with customers in banking, insurance, healthcare or government.

You may not match every line. If you've owned recovery for another enterprise database or for storage, and you've worked with Oracle, apply and tell us how you'd learn the rest.

jobs.title: Customer Success Advisor
jobs.description_html:
Most boards and executives are currently flying blind when it comes to cyber risk. They are guessing. At Safe, we’ve built an AI-driven engine that finally gives the C-Suite a clear, quantified, and real-time view of their security posture. We don’t just provide data; we provide certainty.

We are a $170M Series C-funded category leader. We don’t play in the mid-market; we operate at the highest levels of global enterprise. Today, we are proud to serve 10% of the Fortune 500, protecting global icons such as Apple, Netflix, AT&T, Verizon, and Victoria’s Secret.

As we scale toward our next chapter, we are looking for high-performers who want to do the best work of their careers at the intersection of AI and Cybersecurity.

The Culture Memo: Our Operating System

Safe is not a typical corporate environment. We are a high-intensity, mission-driven team. We value builders who want to define a category and work alongside people who are equally committed to excellence.

  • Extreme Ownership: We don’t do "not my job." We hire people who see a gap and own the solution from start to finish.

  • The Elite Standard: We serve the most sophisticated companies on the planet. Our work must be bulletproof. Whether it’s a line of code or a sales deck, we aim for Tier-1 quality every time.

  • Methodology & Rigor: We don’t wing it. From Force Management and MEDDICC in sales to data-driven sprints in engineering, we rely on proven frameworks to stay disciplined and predictable.

  • Radical Candor: We move too fast for politics or sugar-coating. We value direct, honest feedback that helps us find the right answer quickly.

  • The Series C Hustle: We have the stability of a well-funded leader but the heart of a startup.

The Perks & Ownership:

We want our team to feel like owners because they are owners. We trust our people to manage their results and their time.

jobs.description_html:
About SecurityScorecard:

SecurityScorecard is the global leader in cybersecurity ratings, with over 12 million companies continuously rated, operating in 64 countries. Most recently, SecurityScorecard was named to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies for 2023 and to the Achievers 50 Most Engaged Workplaces in 2023 award recognizing “forward-thinking employers for their unwavering commitment to employee engagement.”  SecurityScorecard is proud to be funded by world-class investors including Silver Lake Waterman, Moody’s, Sequoia Capital, GV and Riverwood Capital.

About the Role:

We’re reorganizing engineering into 16 to 18 small squads grouped under five technical domains. Each domain has a lead who stays hands-on in the code, and squad leads keep their engineering titles and spend at least half their time building. There’s no director layer between them and the VP of Engineering, which keeps decisions close to the work. The tradeoff is that nobody is currently coordinating across squads. You’ll be that person.

This is the first and only TPM inside engineering, reporting to the VP of Engineering. You’ll own whether cross-domain programs are visible and on track: which squad blocks which, what has to land before what, and where the technical dependencies sit. Then you’ll automate as much of that as you can, so coordination scales with the number of teams instead of growing with them.

You won’t have direct reports, and you won’t own product or technical decisions. Domain and squad leads own delivery, and product owns what gets built. Your leverage is clarity: the right information in front of the right people before something slips. If you need a team under you or a title to get things done, this role won’t be a good fit.

We already have a PMO that tracks programs at the portfolio level. You won’t duplicate it. You’ll work inside engineering, at the level of squads and technical dependencies, and the PMO will get better inputs because of it.

What You’ll Do

  • Own tracking for every program that crosses squad or domain lines, from kickoff until it lands.
  • Map dependencies between squads before work starts, keep the map current, and flag risk early enough for leads to act on it.
  • Build the status and visibility system for engineering: what gets tracked, where, and how leadership sees it without asking.
  • Automate the coordination work. Use Jira, dashboards, scripts, and AI agents so status, dependency alerts, and reporting happen without anyone chasing them.
  • Run the cross-team communication squads depend on: planning syncs, sequencing reviews, and readable written updates.
  • Chase things down. When a dependency stalls, find out why, get the right leads talking, and escalate to the VP when they can’t resolve it.
  • Feed the PMO clean, accurate engineering inputs for portfolio-level reporting.
  • Support managers running quarter-long champion initiatives outside their squads with lightweight tracking and goal reviews.
  • Measure whether coordination is getting cheaper as the team count grows, and change the system when it isn’t.
  • Write down how cross-team work runs here so new squads can plug in without a walkthrough.

Who You’ll Work With

You’re accountable for programs being visible and on track, not for the work landing.

  • VP of Engineering: Owns escalations, org structure, and people decisions. You own the full cross-domain picture and surfacing what needs their call.
  • Domain leads: Own sequencing of which squads build what and the interfaces between domains. You own the dependency map and early warning when sequencing breaks.
  • Squad leads: Own specs, implementation, and delivery. You own status that updates itself, so they spend their time building.
  • Architecture: Owns cross-domain design and standards. You own tracking cross-domain technical work to completion.
  • Product managers: Own what gets built and why. You own turning those priorities into a sequenced, visible plan across squads.
  • PMO: Owns portfolio-level tracking and reporting. You own the accuracy of the engineering inputs they receive.

Required Qualifications:

  • 8+ years in program or project management in engineering or technology organizations
  • 3+ years at a B2B SaaS company.
  • Evidence you built the coordination system, not just ran one. Tell us about tools and processes you put in place that outlasted your tenure.
  • Experience in fast-growing or changing organizations where structure was still being defined.
  • Enough technical depth to understand dependencies, architecture tradeoffs, and the SDLC, and to be taken seriously by engineers. No CS degree or coding requirement.
  • Expert in Jira and comfortable administering it, plus dashboards and reporting tools.
  • Hands-on use of AI tools to automate tracking, summarize status, or surface risk, with clear opinions about what works and what doesn’t.
  • A track record of influence without authority: moving senior engineers, managers, and product leads with no reporting line.
  • Flexibility on methodology. You may have strong views, but you work with how each team operates rather than imposing a framework.
  • Persistent follow-through with a light touch. You get people to act by building trust and clarity, not by pressure.
  • Clear, direct writing. Your status updates get read, and people act on them.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. You’ll help define the job as the org changes shape.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in cybersecurity, defense, or other security-focused products
  • Programs that crossed hardware, software, and operations boundaries
  • Prior director-level or business operations scope
  • Experience adapting Scrum, Kanban, or other agile practices to how teams actually work
  • Experience building agentic workflows or scripts for delivery reporting

You will design and lead our move to AI-first operations, where agents triage alerts, investigate incidents, propose and apply fixes under human control, and remove repetitive work from the SRE team. You own the technical strategy for agentic operations, the MCP and agent platform it runs on, and the security and governance model that lets AI act safely in production. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role within SRE. You also remain the senior technical authority for our Kubernetes on AWS (EKS) infrastructure and reliability practices.

What You Will Do:

Lead AI-first operations

  • Own the strategy for AI in SRE, updated quarterly and measured by toil removed, MTTR, change failure rate and deploy lead time.
  • Build agentic workflows for alert triage, incident investigation, remediation and infrastructure changes, starting with the highest-volume work.
  • Architect the agent platform: MCP servers for our observability, cloud, Kubernetes and incident tooling, plus a shared library of SRE skills and workflows.
  • Set the autonomy model: what agents do on their own, what needs approval, and how that expands as they prove reliable.
  • Build evaluation for agents: test them against replayed incidents before granting new permissions, and track accuracy, cost and impact.

Own AI security and governance

  • Partner with Security on the governance framework for AI in production: scoped credentials, approval gates, audit trails, prompt-injection defenses and kill switches.
  • Build governance into the platform through policy-as-code and guarded tools, so SRE automation is safe by default.

Advance how SRE uses AI

  • Push an already AI-fluent SRE team further: take on harder agentic problems together and share new techniques as tools change.
  • Run reviews and demos of agentic work, and publish patterns and anti-patterns.
  • Recommend AI tooling for SRE, including build-versus-buy decisions.

Set the reliability and platform direction

  • Own the technical direction for Kubernetes on AWS (EKS), IaC and GitOps, and CI/CD with progressive delivery.
  • Define the SLO and observability strategy, with telemetry built for people and agents.
  • Lead major incidents and postmortems, and turn lessons into fixes and new agent workflows.

Required Qualifications:

  • 10+ years in SRE, DevOps or infrastructure.
  • Shipped AI automation in operations that measurably cut toil or improved incident response.
  • Built AI tooling for infrastructure: MCP servers, agents and tool design.
  • Sound judgment on AI risk in production: permissions, approvals, auditability and prompt injection.
  • AI-first daily: you write and review most of your code through AI agents. 
  • Deep platform expertise: Kubernetes, AWS EKS, Terraform, GitOps, observability, Python or Go, and at least one of Kafka, Flink or ClickHouse.
  • Influence without authority through clear technical strategy and mentoring

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Built evaluation harnesses that score agents against replayed incidents.
  • Production experience across Kafka, Flink and ClickHouse.
  • Chaos engineering or resilience testing.
  • Public work on AI for operations: open-source tools, talks or writing.

jobs.title: Staff UX Designer
jobs.description_html:
About SecurityScorecard:

SecurityScorecard is the global leader in cybersecurity ratings, with over 12 million companies continuously rated, operating in 64 countries. Founded in 2013 by security and risk experts Dr. Alex Yampolskiy and Sam Kassoumeh and funded by world-class investors, SecurityScorecard’s patented rating technology is used by over 25,000 organizations for self-monitoring, third-party risk management, board reporting, and cyber insurance underwriting; making all organizations more resilient by allowing them to easily find and fix cybersecurity risks across their digital footprint. 

Headquartered in New York City, our culture has been recognized by Inc Magazine as a "Best Workplace,” by Crain’s NY as a "Best Places to Work in NYC," and as one of the 10 hottest SaaS startups in New York for two years in a row. Most recently, SecurityScorecard was named to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies for 2023 and to the Achievers 50 Most Engaged Workplaces in 2023 award recognizing “forward-thinking employers for their unwavering commitment to employee engagement.”  SecurityScorecard is proud to be funded by world-class investors including Silver Lake Waterman, Moody’s, Sequoia Capital, GV and Riverwood Capital.

About the Role:

We're looking for a Staff UX Designer who will be the person on our product team closest to the customer. You'll own end-to-end workflows in our third-party risk products: the full path from a security risk surfacing in SecurityScorecard to the moment it's fixed and closed, including what happens on the vendor's side. We judge your work by the outcome for the customer, not the output. A report is an output; a risk leader who walks into their board meeting with every answer ready is an outcome.

We don't have a separate research team. Every designer here is a researcher: you'll be on customer calls, sit with customers while they work, and use AI (we use Claude) to mine call recordings and product data for gaps. You'll also work directly in our codebase, prototyping and building with Claude and opening your own pull requests alongside engineers.

This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role for someone who would rather do the customer's job for a day than read another dashboard about them.

What You'll Do

  • Walk in the customer's shoes. Do the work our customers do, such as taking a vendor risk finding from discovery through remediation, and design from what you learn.
  • Own workflows end to end. Define where each workflow begins and ends, and design it so customers reach the outcome they need. Follow every action through to the people on the receiving end, including vendors asked to fix an issue, until the work is done.
  • Design systems of action, not just dashboards. Build experiences that move a risk from discovered to fixed and closed, and make it easy for everyone involved to take the next step.
  • Research continuously, with AI. Join customer calls, run working sessions, and use Claude to analyze call recordings, feedback and product usage, then map what you find to the roadmap.
  • Build directly in the codebase. Prototype and build with Claude against our code and design system, and open pull requests yourself.
  • Raise the team's AI practice. Write and share Claude skills in our team repositories so design output stays consistent, and help engineers tokenize our design system so people and agents can build on it.
  • Work across the company. Partner with product, engineering, sales, customer success and marketing, and go find the context you need, whether that's a call recording or a quick question to a customer success manager.
  • Build trusted customer relationships. Spend time with enterprise customers, including senior stakeholders, on site and in live working sessions.
  • Think critically under pressure. When an urgent request lands, clarify the intent behind it, weigh the options, recommend the best path, and still deliver fast.

Required Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of product or UX design experience, including 3+ years designing B2B or enterprise SaaS products with dense data, permissions and multi-step workflows.
  • Regular, direct customer contact: research, site visits or live working sessions, ideally with senior enterprise stakeholders.
  • A portfolio with at least one workflow you designed and shipped from beginning to end, and evidence of what it changed for the customer.
  • Hands-on AI practice in code. You use Claude or a similar tool to build prototypes or components in a real codebase or design system repository, and you've opened pull requests yourself. Be ready to show what you built, how you prompted it, and what you had to fix by hand. General familiarity with AI tools isn't enough.
  • Experience using AI for research: turning customer calls, feedback or usage data into design decisions.
  • Strong product judgment. You ask why, frame the real problem, and recommend a path among options.
  • A record of delivering on tight timelines and adapting when priorities shift.
  • Strong Figma skills and modern interaction design craft. 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience on both enterprise and consumer products, bringing modern consumer-grade interaction patterns into complex B2B software.
  • Experience in cybersecurity, third-party risk management (TPRM), governance, risk and compliance (GRC), or another regulated domain.
  • Contributions to a design system in code, especially a tokenized one.
  • Experience designing AI-powered features that keep users in control when the model is wrong.
  • Front-end code you've shipped (HTML, CSS, components).
  • Accessibility built into your process (WCAG 2.2). 

Who You Are

  • Customer-obsessed. You understand a problem by living it, not by reading about it.
  • A critical thinker. When a request lands, you slow down long enough to understand the intent before you build, and you come back with a recommendation, not just a deliverable.
  • Relentlessly curious. You go find the answer: you listen to the call, ask the person closest to the customer, and keep learning outside your day job.
  • Built for pace. You deliver on tight timelines and roll with shifting priorities, and you ask why when it matters.
  • A teammate who makes others better. You hold a high craft bar, give and seek direct feedback, and stay open and curious when you're challenged.

Benefits:

Specific to each country, we offer a competitive salary, stock options, Health benefits, and unlimited PTO, parental leave, tuition reimbursements, and much more!

Actual compensation for the position is based on a variety of factors, including, but not limited to affordability, skills, qualifications and experience, and may vary from the range.
