jobs.title: Regional Partner Manager, APAC
jobs.description_html:
About Semgrep

Semgrep, the leader in code security for builders, empowers invention without friction. Teams catch, flag, and fix real issues before they ship, powered by security that learns as they build. Semgrep secures code as it’s written and provides guardrails that pave the road for developers to move fast and stay secure. Built for builders and trusted by security, Semgrep lives where developers work, delivering fixes without breaking flow, and giving security teams visibility, control, and confidence. Semgrep gets smarter as you build, with AI that learns your context to cut false positives and prioritize reachable vulnerabilities, validated by 95% of security reviewers across 6M+ findings. Semgrep makes zero false positives a reality with AppSec teams triaging 80% fewer false positives across Code and Supply Chain, dramatically shrinking the backlog.


Founded in San Francisco and backed by Menlo Ventures, Felicis Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, and Sequoia Capital, Semgrep is recognized by Gartner in Application Security Testing and is trusted by leading organizations, including Vanta, Lyft, and Dropbox. Learn more at semgrep.dev.

About the Role

Semgrep is looking for a builder! We are looking for a Regional Partner Manager (APAC) to grow the ecosystem of partners who help builders and agents ship secure software, faster. Success in this role means enabling and activating partners who share our developer-first mindset to bring Semgrep into their customer base, generate new opportunities, and accelerate adoption across engineering and security teams in the region.

You’ll identify, enable, and grow strategic partner relationships across APAC, with a strong focus on VARs, resellers, and distributors, while also engaging cloud and technology alliances as part of the broader ecosystem. Working closely with Semgrep’s sales, product, and partner teams, you’ll make sure partners are aligned with our go-to-market strategy and actively drive new opportunities across ANZ and Southeast Asia, with the opportunity to extend into the wider region as the program matures.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and execute a partner-led growth plan for APAC that ties Semgrep’s AI-centric approach to AppSec to partner pipeline and revenue targets.

  • Recruit and activate VARs, resellers, distributors, and regional SIs who can bring Semgrep Code, Semgrep Supply Chain, and Semgrep Secrets to engineering and security buyers.

  • Drive regional AWS Marketplace motion with partners and customers, including private offers, channel partner private offers (CPPOs), and AWS co-sell.

  • Enable partners technically and commercially through the SCALE Partner Program and in partnership with Partner Solutions Engineers, so they can confidently position Semgrep against legacy SAST and SCA tools and the evolving AI-assisted development landscape.

  • Drive partner-sourced and partner-attached opportunities by aligning with Semgrep’s APAC field sellers on joint account planning, deal registration, and pursuit of target accounts.

  • Engage partner leadership and sales teams so Semgrep’s value resonates at every level, from account reps to executives.

  • Partner with Partner Marketing and field marketing on regional programs, events, and campaigns that show how Semgrep helps developers ship secure code faster.

  • Navigate regional requirements that shape security buying, including data residency and local frameworks such as the Australian Essential Eight and IRAP, APRA CPS 234, and Singapore MAS TRM, and help partners position Semgrep accordingly.

  • Stay current on Semgrep’s roadmap, the competitive landscape, and the AppSec and developer tooling market.

  • Travel as needed across the region (up to ~50%).

You’re ideal for this role if you have:

  • 5+ years of partner/channel sales experience in AppSec, cybersecurity, or developer tools in APAC, with a track record of exceeding quota.

  • Demonstrated success building and scaling partner relationships that generate measurable pipeline and revenue.

  • A network of trusted relationships with decision makers across APAC VARs, resellers, distributors, SIs, and cloud marketplaces.

  • Working knowledge of AWS Marketplace and co-sell mechanics (private offers, CPPOs, deal registration).

  • Ability to translate technical value into business outcomes and explain why developer-first security matters to partners and customers alike.

  • Strong communication skills for engaging engineers, partner sales reps, and executives across diverse markets and time zones.

  • An entrepreneurial mindset and comfort operating in a fast-moving, growth-stage environment.

  • Self-starter with excellent organizational, presentation, and collaboration skills.

Compensation

  • Singapore (SGD) - The estimated starting annual salary range for this position is SGD $148,800 to $186,000, with estimated uncapped on-target earnings of SGD $248,000 to $310,000.

  • Australia (AUD) - The estimated starting annual salary range for this position is AUD $151,200 to $189,000, with estimated uncapped on-target earnings of AUD $252,000 to $315,000.

  • Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including job-related skills, experience, qualifications, location, internal equity, and market data. Total compensation may also include equity and benefits. We view equity as a meaningful part of our compensation philosophy and an opportunity for employees to share in the long-term value they help create.

Location

  • This is a remote position based in Singapore or Australia, with occasional travel to Semgrep hubs. We’d rather you be out in the field!

What we offer (FTE only)

Our goal is to competitively and fairly compensate every Semgrep employee with a system that equally rewards those who are vocal and those who are less comfortable making demands during the final steps of the hiring process. To that end, we generate internal compensation bands that are used when discussing and negotiating salaries. We update these based on market data to make sure they’re above the average for comparable roles.

We invest in our employees’ well-being and long-term success through a competitive, market-aligned benefits program that meets or exceeds local market standards across all of the regions in which we hire. Benefits offerings vary by location to reflect local requirements and norms. For more detailed, location-specific information, please visit Semgrep Benefits.

Who we are

We bring together people from a wide range of backgrounds and disciplines—from physics and philosophy to formal methods research and full-fledged corporations. We’re new parents and new grads, dog lovers and dogfooders. We get together often to bike, bake, and meet up in parks. In our interactions, we believe respect and honesty go hand in hand, and prioritize both.

Semgrep is an equal-opportunity employer seeking a diverse range of backgrounds. We value who you are — including your cultural heritage, your socioeconomic status, your age, your race, your gender, your sexual orientation, your disabilities. We value what’s vitally important to you — your family, your religion, your politics. We value what you love in this world — your music, your weekend pursuits. We believe in welcoming varied professional backgrounds, educations, and interests. If you’re exceptional in your role, believe in Semgrep’s mission, and treat Semgrep’s values as your own, you belong here.

Please Note: For US-based roles open to remote work, we are currently able to hire employees in the following states only: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Missouri, Nebraska, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, Washington, and Wisconsin.

This customer-facing role also partners with many teams across Semgrep - including Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Marketing, and Support.

Location: The ideal candidate will work remotely in Australia.

Prior experience in a fast-paced tech environment is helpful, but we are more interested in your problem solving skills than your pedigree. So if this opportunity excites you but you don’t meet the exact requirements, apply anyway!

What you’ll do

  • Host monthly check-in’s with customers to understand their successes and challenges

  • Speak with technical stakeholders within our customer base and internally within Semgrep

  • Create personalized success plans for customers to ensure they grow the value of using our platform

  • Partner with Sales to host executive business reviews with practitioners and the executive buyers

  • Collaborate with Tech Support to resolve bug tickets, and with Product to submit and follow up on feature requests

  • Advocate on behalf of your customers for product roadmap items to evolve our product suite and features

  • De-escalate urgent issues that may introduce churn risk

  • Evolve our best practices to deliver exceptional service to our customers

  • Contribute to documentation to widen the available information for how to use our products

You are ideal for this role if you have

  • 5+ years of experience working in a customer facing role - prior experience as a Technical Account Manager, Account Manager, or Product Manager for a highly technical product is preferred

  • A deep understanding of developer workflows and build systems, including CI / CD environments such as GitHub Actions, GitLab, Circle CI, Jenkins, and Buildkite and SCM environments such as Git, SVN, Perforce etc.

  • Strategic thinker with deep customer empathy; ability to create and execute plans to grow accounts

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence with an executive presence

  • Familiarity with Web Application Security concepts including OWASP Top 10.

  • A background or genuine interest in DevSecOps or AppSec

  • Engineering or technical degree from a four year college or university

Compensation

  • The estimated starting annual salary range for this position is $195,000-$245,500 (AUD$)

  • Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including job-related skills, experience, qualifications, location, internal equity, and market data. Total compensation may also include equity and benefits. We view equity as a meaningful part of our compensation philosophy and an opportunity for employees to share in the long-term value they help create.

What we offer (FTE only)

Our goal is to competitively and fairly compensate every Semgrep employee with a system that equally rewards those who are vocal and those who are less comfortable making demands during the final steps of the hiring process. To that end, we generate internal compensation bands that are used when discussing and negotiating salaries. We update these based on market data to make sure they’re above the average for comparable roles.

We invest in our employees’ well-being and long-term success through a competitive, market-aligned benefits program that meets or exceeds local market standards across all of the regions in which we hire. Benefits offerings vary by location to reflect local requirements and norms. For more detailed, location-specific information, please visit Semgrep Benefits.

Who we are

We bring together people from a wide range of backgrounds and disciplines—from physics and philosophy to formal methods research and full-fledged corporations. We’re new parents and new grads, dog lovers and dogfooders. We get together often to bike, bake, and meet up in parks. In our interactions, we believe respect and honesty go hand in hand, and prioritize both.

Semgrep is an equal-opportunity employer seeking a diverse range of backgrounds. We value who you are — including your cultural heritage, your socioeconomic status, your age, your race, your gender, your sexual orientation, your disabilities. We value what’s vitally important to you — your family, your religion, your politics. We value what you love in this world — your music, your weekend pursuits. We believe in welcoming varied professional backgrounds, educations, and interests. If you’re exceptional in your role, believe in Semgrep’s mission, and treat Semgrep’s values as your own, you belong here.

Please Note: For US-based roles open to remote work, we are currently able to hire employees in the following states only: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Missouri, Nebraska, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, Washington, and Wisconsin.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As an AVP, Strategic Partner Delivery, you will be tasked with leading SentinelOne’s relationship with a strategic global services partner, helping the two organizations deliver a consistent, high-quality experience for customers from the earliest proof of value through implementation, ongoing service, and renewal. Together, SentinelOne and its partner bring expert-led managed security services to more organizations in more regions. This is a hands-on executive player-coach role: you will lead a dedicated team, aligning Product, Engineering, Sales, Renewals, Legal, and Finance around a single operating model.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Serve as SentinelOne’s executive lead for the partnership, owning the joint operating plan, roadmap, and regular partnership reviews, and communicating progress, decisions, and risks to executives.
  • Lead a team spanning customer experience, service quality, and technical validation; establish clear operating rhythms, shared decision-making, and issue resolution across both organizations; hire and coach leaders, and build a culture of ownership, transparency, and measurable results.
  • Ensure customers have a named SentinelOne owner from proof of value through onboarding, deployment, ongoing service, and renewal, with smooth handoffs and fast time to value.
  • Define customer experience standards and service-level expectations, and use clear metrics and scorecards to track service quality and drive continuous improvement.
  • Own senior customer escalations and drive timely resolution and lasting corrective action, partnering with Product, Engineering, and technical teams to improve platform and service readiness.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 15 or more years of leadership across enterprise Customer Experience, cybersecurity services, managed services, technical operations, or strategic technology partnerships; leadership experience in cybersecurity, MDR/MSSP, managed SIEM, incident response, or enterprise professional services.
  • Proven ownership of a complex global delivery, service-provider, or strategic partner relationship; experience launching or scaling partner-led delivery models while protecting customer trust.
  • Experience building and developing senior cross-functional teams and influencing organizations beyond direct reporting lines; strong executive judgment in critical customer escalations and ambiguous delivery challenges.
  • Expertise in partner management, service delivery, SLA/SLO management, and continuous-improvement programs; commercial fluency spanning renewals, delivery capacity, and customer outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate strategy into operating plans, use metrics to drive decisions, and communicate effectively with C-level stakeholders; success in this role means faster resolution of customer issues, on-time delivery of the joint roadmap, strong partner relationship health, and improved time to value, service experience, and renewal outcomes.
  • Knowledge of enterprise cybersecurity and the journey from technical validation and implementation to managed services and renewals.
  • Familiarity with SentinelOne Singularity, endpoint security, AI SIEM, threat hunting, and regulated or large-enterprise customer environments.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. As an Account Manager, Client Development & Renewals, you will be tasked with owning a book of existing customer accounts and driving both renewal retention and expansion revenue within them. This is not a transactional renewals seat; it is a growth-first role where renewal is the floor, not the goal, and you will protect the base by keeping renewals healthy and on time and grow it by uncovering and closing whitespace, running consultative upsell and cross-sell conversations, and turning satisfied customers into expanding ones. You will sit within the Client Development / Renewals organization and partner closely with Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, and Sales Engineering, in a role built for a rep who is driven to outgrow a base they know well, own their numbers, and earn a path to strategic accounts or AE-track roles through expansion results.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Own a portfolio of existing accounts, carrying a dual quota of renewal retention and expansion bookings (upsell/cross-sell); identify whitespace across the SentinelOne product portfolio and run consultative expansion conversations, leading with customer use cases and outcomes, not just quotes; spot expansion triggers early, including new use cases, org growth, underutilized licenses ready to convert, and competitive displacement openings; build repeatable account plans with your CSM and SE partners that map multi-year growth, not just the next renewal.
  • Manage renewals end to end, from early quoting and multi-threading through negotiation and on-time close; keep renewal timelines definitive and forecasts predictable across your book, so the primary focus remains on whitespace and expansion with your accounts; handle commercial negotiation on your accounts, including multi-year commitments, with support on the most complex deals.
  • Identify churn and downgrade risk early by watching deployment health, usage, support signals, and sentiment across your accounts; run save motions on at-risk accounts, pulling in CSM, Support, and leadership when needed; flag overdeployment/downgrade exposure and get ahead of it before it hits the renewal.
  • Own an accurate, transparent forecast across both renewal and expansion pipeline for your book; keep Salesforce and CPQ/quoting tools current, with accurate stages and a renewal/expansion pipeline you can defend; structure and close deals cleanly, using approved pricing and quote automation.
  • Partner with CSMs on account coverage so there is no gap or overlap, and with AEs and SEs on expansion opportunities; partner with our Channel/MSSP partners on renewal continuity and baseline growth for partner-managed accounts; bring the customer's voice back to Product and the broader team, including what is working, what is stuck, and where the next opportunity is.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 3 to 5 years in renewals, account management, or a customer-facing sales role, with upsell/cross-sell closing experience on your record, ideally in SaaS or cybersecurity.
  • A track record of hitting or beating quota, including driving net revenue retention above 100 percent on your own book (expansion outpacing churn), not just renewal completion.
  • Proven experience running consultative upsell/cross-sell motions and identifying and closing whitespace within an existing customer base.
  • Comfort managing multi-stakeholder conversations and negotiations, with direct experience negotiating with senior/economic buyers.
  • A risk-aware instinct: you notice the early signals of churn or downgrade and act before renewal time.
  • Strong forecasting discipline and CRM hygiene; hands-on with Salesforce and CPQ/quote tools.
  • Strong communication and organization, curiosity about customer use-cases and the product, and a habit of opening expansion conversations without being prompted.
  • Exposure to Channel/MSSP or 2-tier GTM models is a plus, not a requirement.

As a Staff AI Platform Engineer, Infrastructure Services, you will be tasked with taking ownership of our AI Gateway infrastructure (built on Kong AI Gateway), the system that authenticates, routes, rate-limits, and monitors AI coding assistant traffic org-wide, while also being fluent enough across our broader platform stack to design solutions that span the two. This is a high-autonomy, high-scope role: you will set technical direction for AI infrastructure, drive incident response and reliability work, and partner closely with the engineers who own our CI/CD, GitOps, and artifact systems rather than working in isolation from them.

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Work on the AI Gateway platform: architect, harden, and scale our Kong AI Gateway deployment (Konnect Hybrid on KCP/EKS), including auth (Okta/OIDC), consumer tiers and budgets, rate limiting, semantic caching, and observability.
  • Lead reliability and incident response: drive root-cause analysis and remediation for gateway issues (timeouts, latency, capacity, failover) and build the monitoring/alerting needed to catch them before users do.
  • Design across the platform, not just the gateway: work fluently with our CI/CD (Jenkins, JPAAS), GitOps and Kubernetes deployment tooling (ArgoCD across dev/gov/prod), artifact management (Artifactory/Xray), GitHub Enterprise administration, and GitHub Actions runner fleet, so that AI infrastructure decisions account for how the rest of the platform actually works.

  • Partner cross-functionally: work directly with security, DevEx, and product engineering teams consuming the gateway to translate their needs into platform capabilities.
  • Host and serve local models: stand up and operate self-hosted/open-weight model serving infrastructure (e.g. vLLM, NVIDIA Triton/NIM, TGI, Ollama) for workloads where routing to an external provider isn't the right fit, including GPU capacity planning, autoscaling, and cost/performance tuning.
  • Support the broader model lifecycle: help build LLMOps practices such as model versioning, evaluation, and safe rollout, plus supporting infrastructure for retrieval-augmented generation (vector stores, embedding pipelines) as use cases mature.
  • Track usage and cost: build observability into token usage, latency, and spend across both API-based and self-hosted models so the business can see what AI infrastructure actually costs.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 8 or more years of experience in platform, infrastructure, or DevOps engineering, with a track record of owning systems end-to-end in production.
  • Hands-on experience with API gateway technologies (Kong, Envoy, Apigee, or similar); direct experience with AI/LLM gateway patterns (rate limiting, semantic caching, prompt/response observability) is a strong plus.
  • Strong Kubernetes and GitOps experience (ArgoCD or comparable), and comfort operating across multiple environments (dev, gov, prod).
  • Solid CI/CD background: Jenkins pipeline design and administration, build infrastructure, and runner/agent fleet management (GitHub Actions runners or equivalent).
  • Experience with artifact and package management systems (Artifactory, Xray, or similar) and source control platform administration (GitHub Enterprise).
  • Working knowledge of infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and cloud platforms (AWS/EKS).
  • Experience deploying and operating self-hosted LLM inference stacks (vLLM, NVIDIA Triton/NIM, TGI, Ollama, or similar) and GPU-backed infrastructure, including Kubernetes GPU scheduling and autoscaling.
  • Familiarity with LLMOps practices: model versioning, evaluation harnesses, and usage/cost observability across API-based and self-hosted models.
  • Track record of setting technical direction, driving cross-team initiatives, and mentoring other engineers; this role has significant scope and minimal day-to-day oversight.
  • Clear, proactive communicator who can explain infrastructure trade-offs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience operating LLM/AI-assisted developer tooling at scale (Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) inside an enterprise is preferred.
  • Familiarity with Okta/OIDC and enterprise auth patterns for internal platforms is preferred.
  • Experience with engineering productivity metrics tooling (LinearB or similar) and AI-based code review tooling (Qodo or similar) is preferred.
  • Experience with vector databases and RAG pipelines (e.g. Milvus, Pinecone, pgvector, or similar) in a production setting is preferred.
  • Exposure to model fine-tuning or lightweight training pipelines (LoRA/QLoRA or similar) for domain-specific model adaptation is preferred.

As a Staff AI Platform Engineer, you will be a hands-on builder of SentinelOne’s enterprise AI platform, responsible for integrating, deploying, and operating the foundational services that enable secure, scalable, and reliable AI adoption across the company.

This role sits at the intersection of AI infrastructure & Platform Engineering, DevOps, and software development. You will work with AI Gateways, Model Context Protocol (MCP) services, model providers, evaluation frameworks, and enterprise integrations to deliver production-grade AI platform capabilities.

We are looking for an experienced engineer who combines strong cloud-native infrastructure knowledge with hands-on DevOps expertise, proficiency in Python, and demonstrated experience integrating AI technologies into working systems.

You should be comfortable independently deploying, configuring, troubleshooting, and operating AI platform components on existing cloud infrastructure, while collaborating with infrastructure engineers on the underlying environment.

Working closely with the Sr. Director of Enterprise AI Platform Engineering and cross-functional teams, you will translate platform architecture into working solutions and take ownership of technical deliverables from design through production operations.
 
What Will You Do?
Primary responsibilities include:
  • Build and operate AI Gateway capabilities: Deploy, configure, integrate, and maintain enterprise AI Gateway services using technologies such as Kong AI Gateway, LiteLLM, or comparable platforms. Implement model connectivity, multi-model routing, failover, authentication, authorization, rate limiting, token consumption controls, and request-level observability.
  • Build and manage MCP integrations: Integrate first-party and third-party MCP servers with enterprise applications, AI agents, and platform services. Implement secure tool access, authentication, authorization, and governance controls for agent-to-tool interactions.
  • Develop and operate AI platform infrastructure: Configure, deploy, and maintain AI platform services running on cloud-native infrastructure, with a focus on service connectivity, security, scalability, resilience, and operational reliability.
  • Own deployment and DevOps practices: Independently deploy and operate production platform services using containerization, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment automation. Diagnose and resolve application, deployment, configuration, and infrastructure-related issues.
  • Develop Python-based platform services: Build production-grade Python services, APIs, and reusable integration components using frameworks such as FastAPI and other modern development tools.
  • Integrate AI models and enterprise systems: Connect hosted AI model providers, internal applications, enterprise APIs, identity systems, and data services through secure and maintainable integration patterns.
  • Implement AI evaluation and observability capabilities: Integrate evaluation frameworks, tracing, logging, and monitoring into AI workflows to assess model behavior, tool execution, reliability, and platform performance.
  • Implement enterprise AI security and governance: Support centralized access controls, identity integration, policy enforcement, content guardrails, audit logging, and AI consumption governance across shared platform capabilities.
  • Engineer for production reliability: Troubleshoot complex issues across AI services, gateways, integrations, and deployment environments. Implement appropriate testing, diagnostics, performance monitoring, and operational controls.
  • Collaborate on platform architecture and execution: Partner with infrastructure, enterprise applications, data engineering, and security teams to translate architectural requirements into scalable, secure, maintainable production services.
What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?
Ideal candidates will have:
  • AI Gateway and API Gateway knowledge: Practical experience with API gateways, AI gateways, or comparable centralized service access platforms. Understanding of model routing, authentication, authorization, traffic management, rate limiting, policy enforcement, observability, and gateway operations. Hands-on experience with Kong AI Gateway, LiteLLM, or similar technologies is a strong plus.
  • Strong cloud-native platform engineering experience: Hands-on experience configuring, deploying, integrating, and operating distributed services on cloud infrastructure, with practical knowledge of Kubernetes, containerization, networking, service connectivity, scalability, and reliability. Experience with GCP and GKE or comparable cloud environments is a plus.
  • Strong DevOps and production operations experience: Demonstrated ability to independently deploy, monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain production services. Experience with CI/CD, deployment automation, infrastructure-as-code practices, and application observability.
  • Proficiency in Python: Hands-on experience developing production-grade Python services and APIs. Experience with FastAPI or equivalent frameworks is desirable.
  • AI evaluation and observability knowledge: Working understanding of AI evaluation approaches, model and agent behavior assessment, tracing, monitoring, and operational diagnostics. Experience with tools such as Logfire, LangSmith, or comparable platforms is a plus.
  • Demonstrated AI integration experience: Hands-on experience integrating LLMs, model providers, AI services, agent tools, or AI-enabled applications into working systems. Experience with Anthropic, OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI is valuable.
  • MCP and agent integration knowledge: Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI tool calling, agent-to-tool connectivity, and securely integrating AI agents with enterprise services. Experience with Pydantic AI, LangGraph, or comparable agent frameworks is desirable.
  • Enterprise integration, security, and identity: Experience integrating enterprise applications, APIs, cloud services, and identity systems using secure, maintainable integration patterns. Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, service-to-service communication, and API security. Familiarity with enterprise identity providers such as Okta is valuable.
  • Independent engineering execution: Ability to translate requirements and high-level architectural direction into working solutions, make sound technical decisions, and independently own services through development, deployment, and production support.
  • Professional engineering experience: 5 or more years of software, infrastructure, or platform engineering experience, including hands-on experience building or operating production systems.

As a Staff Forward Deploy Engineer at SentinelOne, you will sit at the intersection of our customers and our product. Your time splits between customer engineering teams and our own codebases– shipping the integrations, fixes, and platform improvements customer deployments require. Your work will touch many products and services across the company including our data pipeline and the Singularity Data Lake and EventDB (our highly scalable columnar database that ingests Petabytes of data per day).

You'll work closely with customers to understand their environments, translate ambiguous requirements into shipped solutions, and build integrations, customizations, and upstream product contributions that unlock real business value. We're seeking a seasoned colleague, able to own customer engagements end-to-end, inspire others as a Staff Forward Deploy Engineer, and lead technically across unfamiliar codebases and messy problem spaces. You will interact with engineers in and across the org, tech leads, architects, product management, sales, and customer executive stakeholders.

What Will You Do?

  • Software Development (fullstack; primarily React/Java)
    Dive deep into coding, turning customer requirements and product gaps into shipped solutions. Write robust tests, tackle bugs with finesse, and ensure top-notch security in your code. Expect to move between codebases regularly, including on escalated issues that span multiple products.
  • Customer Engagement and Requirements Gathering
    Partner with customers and our field teams to understand customer environments, goals, and constraints. Turn loose, ambiguous (possibly contradictory!) asks into a clear technical strategy. Carry field learnings back into product and engineering planning while advocating for what customers need. Occasionally support pre-sales scoping where early engineering input shapes a good outcome.
  • Customer Integrations, Deployments, and Enablement
    Own the design and delivery of integrations that connect SentinelOne products into customer environments. Often this is work you will do alongside the customer's engineers, shaping both the solution and the knowledge transfer that goes with it. Produce the runbooks, integration docs, and executive-level technical communication that let customers operate independently.
  • Upstream Contributions to the Core Product
    When something needs fixing or improving in the core platform to make a customer whole, you go do it. Partner with platform teams to get contributions reviewed and supported long-term, and know when to invest in the long-term fix versus the near-term unblock. Along the way, build the tooling that codifies repeatable patterns and scales the whole Forward Deploy function.
  • Technical Leadership and Mentorship
    Raise the bar for the Forward Deploy Engineering team. Mentor Senior Forward Deploy Engineers, set standards for how engagements are scoped and delivered, and shape how the team operates as it grows.
  • Build and Review Technical Specifications
    Architect end-to-end solutions for complex problems with loose definition, sometimes spanning multiple codebases and owning teams. Document trade-offs and critical implementation details; review and provide meaningful feedback on other specs, understanding broader patterns and downstream/upstream dependencies.
  • Code Review
    Champion code quality, security, and efficiency. Your keen eye for detail will guide you in reviewing and elevating our codebase– including the codebases you're visiting.
  • Support and Team Collaboration
    Respond to ad-hoc customer and internal escalations promptly (no regular on-call rotation). Assist your colleagues, share constructive feedback, and contribute to weekly syncs and daily Slack standups.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

We do not require a perfect match with everything below; however, the more this describes you, the better of a fit you will be for this role.

  • Experience
    • Solid computer science background with 6+ years engineering experience including both backend and frontend.
    • Proven expertise designing and operating distributed systems or data-intensive services.
    • Track record of leading substantial pieces of work end-to-end, under ambiguity, with multiple stakeholders.
    • Experience working directly with customers or senior stakeholders to shape technical solutions.
  • Technical Mastery
    • Deep proficiency in at least one production language (Java strongly preferred; 5+ years) and working comfort in at least one additional language.
    • You value elegant code that is concise and readable.
    • You'll pick up new tools and codebases as the work demands, and will likely end up working with modern Java, React, TypeScript, Kafka, Redis, GraphQL, Node.js, SentinelOne's own platform, and more.
    • You enjoy writing modern Java (we love lambdas) and prefer composition to inheritance.
    • You're comfortable weighing in on CAP theorem considerations, and are energized by selecting the data structure with the perfect trade-offs for a problem at hand.
  • Domain Familiarity
    • Experience in the cybersecurity domain is strongly preferred. (think SIEM, EDR/XDR, log pipelines, detection engineering, threat hunting, etc.).
  • A Collaborative, Curious, and Practical Mindset
    • You're energized by walking into an unfamiliar codebase and being genuinely useful in a week, and by leading others through the same kind of work.
    • You believe a vague customer request is an interesting technical problem waiting to be reframed, and that "a problem well-stated is half-solved."
    • You can translate between engineers and non-engineers (customers, executives, sales, product, etc.) without losing precision in either direction.
    • You'd rather ship a well-thought-out 80% that solves the real problem than a perfect 100% six weeks late. And you can teach others when to customize for one customer versus producing a general solution.
    • You take mentorship seriously and enjoy seeing other engineers grow in their ability to solve harder problems.
    • You take pride in clear written communication — tickets, design docs, customer runbooks, and executive briefings alike.

jobs.description_html:
About Shift5

Shift5 delivers operational intelligence for onboard OT across defense, aerospace, and commercial transportation fleets. We capture and analyze databus data to detect anomalies, predict failures, and secure critical infrastructure against cyber threats.

The Role & Team

The Platform Engineering team owns four core capabilities: Operating Systems (BaseOS, Manifold, Yocto), Cloud & Infrastructure (AWS/GovCloud to edge), Developer Experience (CI/CD guardrails, internal tooling), and AI Enablement (secure AI orchestration and tooling).

As Principal Platform Engineer, you are the senior-most individual contributor on the team, serving as the primary technical anchor for architecture and a key multiplier for the engineering org. You will drive overall technical strategy, mentor senior engineers, and step into direct team leadership or people management as needed.

What You'll Do

  • Release Engineering: Architect, develop, and operate end-to-end release infrastructure and GitOps delivery pipelines using tools like Atlantis, ArgoCD, Earthly Lunar, GitHub, and internally developed tools.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Architect and manage a complicated AWS estate spanning commercial and govcloud using services like EKS, RDS, S3, VPC, Transit Gateway, etc.
  • Supply Chain Security & Compliance: Lead artifact security (Harbor, Cosign, Vault Transit Engine) and build automated, compliance-by-default pipelines (NIST controls, SBOM generation) to eliminate program friction.
  • OS Lifecycle & AI Enablement: Support hardware OS image builds (Yocto, Manifold) and productionize internal AI gateways, RAG tooling, and developer AI workflows (Cursor).
  • Technical & Team Leadership: Author RFCs/design docs, run architecture reviews, plan roadmaps, and mentor mid/staff-level engineers. Provide direct management (1:1s, hiring, performance reviews) during transitions or scale.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with security, embedded, and field teams to ensure seamless delivery across airgapped and edge environments.

What Success Looks Like

  • Predictable Delivery: Release engineering is seamless, observable, and fully trusted across teams.
  • Automated Security: Compliance evidence and SBOMs are generated natively in CI/CD without manual overhead.
  • Governed AI: AI tooling is securely integrated, well-documented, and actively adopted by developers.
  • Team Growth & Resilience: Engineering standards elevate across the org, priorities remain clear, and team leadership operates without single points of failure.

What We’re Looking For

Required:

  • 10+ years in software/platform engineering, with 5+ years managing production infrastructure at scale.
  • Technical & People Leadership: Proven track record leading projects, designing architecture, mentoring engineers, and readiness (or prior experience) for direct people management.
  • Cloud & Modern Delivery: Hands-on mastery of Kubernetes, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions/Earthly, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/OpenTofu, AWS/GovCloud).
  • Supply Chain Security: Strong background in artifact registries, container signing (Cosign/Sigstore), Vault, and SBOM generation.
  • Clearance: Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Security Clearance (U.S. Citizenship required).

Preferred:

  • Background in defense, aerospace, or regulated environments (NIST 800-53, IL4/IL5, CMMC).
  • Embedded Linux/OS experience (Yocto, SLE Micro) and airgapped/edge deployment models.
  • Experience deploying internal AI/LLM infrastructure (RAG, model gateways, governance).
  • Scripting proficiency in Go, Python, and Bash.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: $255,000 - $280,000

  • Bonus program and equity in a fast-growing startup

  • Competitive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their families

  • Health Savings Account with annual employer contributions

  • Employer-paid Life and Disability Insurance 

  • Uncapped paid time off policy 

  • Flexible work & remote work policy 

  • Tax-deferred public transit benefits with Metro SmartBenefits (DC/MD/VA)

We strive to attract and retain talent from all backgrounds and create workplaces where everyone feels empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work.

We are seeking a world-class Aviation Regulatory Program Manager to join our Global Aviation Regulatory team. You will execute regulatory strategy to secure and sustain operational approvals that enable advanced, autonomous drone operations in the U.S. and globally.

This is the opportunity of a lifetime. Skydio is the largest American drone company whose products are used by thousands of organizations across critical infrastructure, public safety, energy utilities and many sectors. We believe our regulatory team is the best in the world, led by pioneers who have secured groundbreaking approvals in the U.S. and other countries.

If you want to break regulatory barriers, enable life-saving missions, and join a rocket-ship company that is transforming drone technology, this is the job for you.

About the Team

The team is measured on technical win rate, trial and proof of concept outcomes, program expansion, site assessment quality, and the requirements we push back into the product organization.

Solutions Engineers are critical members of the Skydio organization and work closely with Key Account Leaders, Engineering, and Product to support deal progression, customer confidence, successful deployments, and the long-term success of Public Safety sUAS programs. jobs.title: Key Account Director, Campus
jobs.description_html:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the Team: Public safety is where drone technology faces the highest stakes. Agencies across the country are standing up Drone as First Responder (DFR) programs that put an aircraft over an emergency within seconds of a call. As drone programs move from the age of tools to the age of infrastructure, we are expanding our public safety sales team to meet that demand.

A major university is a city in miniature: a residential population, often its own dispatch, large events, and a sworn police department responsible for all of it. Campus public safety leaders are under pressure to respond faster to welfare checks and active threats, to manage game days, commencements, and protests safely, and to show students, parents, and trustees that the institution is serious about safety. DFR is becoming a serious answer to that, and this segment is where we prove it.

About the role: As a Key Account Director, Campus at Skydio, you will lead a national team of Key Account Leaders selling into large universities and colleges with dedicated police departments. This is a first-line leadership role, and the job comes down to three things: recruiting the right people, coaching them into great sellers, and keeping them here.

You will not carry your own accounts. Your number is your team's number, and you will hit it by making each person on the team better: sharpening deal strategy, getting into the field on their most competitive pursuits, and building the territory, pipeline, and forecast discipline that makes a segment predictable. You will work alongside peer Directors leading other segments and geographies, and across Channel, Sales Engineering, Business Development, Marketing, Strategic Relationships, Government Relations, and Mission Success.

You will run Skydio's public safety playbook, with real autonomy to adapt it where campus is different: a wider buying committee, an academic calendar that dictates when budget moves, and a community that scrutinizes surveillance more closely than most. Knowing which differences warrant a different play is a meaningful part of the job.

You will also set the standard for how the team works, not only what it sells. We sell autonomous flying robots and the artificial intelligence that powers them. Every seller here uses AI tools as a normal part of running a territory, and you will model that, coach to it, and hire for it.

This is a highly competitive market, and much of the work happens alongside our channel. Your team will sell against incumbent platforms and well-funded challengers, and you will set the standard for how they win.

Location: Remote, open to candidates anywhere in the United States

How we work

These are the standards we hire to, and as a leader you own them for your segment. You set the bar in who you hire, what you coach to, and what you tolerate.

  • High integrity. Public safety is a tight-knit community. Campus public safety leaders, who benchmark against peer institutions constantly, talk to each other, and a reputation for straight answers travels fast. We sell what the ecosystem is actually capable of, we are clear about where the product is today and where it's headed, and we win on our own merits. There's no compromise here.

  • Sales is a team sport. One team. No lone wolves. Deals are won by account leaders, sales engineering, business development, channel, marketing, strategic relationships, government relations, and mission success pulling in the same direction, and our partners are part of that team, not a channel to be managed around. The best people here care more about the collective number than their own slice of it.

  • Great conversationalists. This is the craft of the job: asking better questions than anyone else in the room, listening for what a chief or a vice president isn't saying, real curiosity about how an institution operates. Not polish, not a rehearsed pitch. Trust in this market is built one honest conversation at a time, and it is the thing competitors cannot copy.

  • Curious, and fluent with the tools. Everyone on this team uses AI as a normal part of their work: researching agencies, preparing for meetings, analyzing pipeline, drafting and then editing. That takes taste more than technical skill: knowing what a quality result looks like, describing a problem precisely enough to get it, and catching the tool when it is confidently wrong. The same muscle makes a great seller. Discovery is specifying the problem; qualification is checking the output. We hire people who are curious about how things work, whether that's an agency's budget, a council's politics, or the aircraft's autonomy, and who have spent the last two years embracing AI rather than waiting to be told to use it.

How you'll make an impact

Recruit

  • Own hiring for your segment: build a continuous talent pipeline, run a fast and rigorous process, and personally close the candidates you want

  • Hire to the bar above: integrity, team instinct, conversational craft, and fluency with the tools matter as much as a closed-won history

  • Screen for evidence, not adjectives: attainment stated year by year with the misses included, deal stories with the mechanics of how the customer bought, and something the candidate has built or changed in how they work in the last two years

  • Run a structured process: the same core questions for every candidate, a live working session, independent scoring, and a debrief that decides on evidence

  • Onboard and ramp new Key Account Leaders with a clear path from first day to first award, and hold the ramp accountable

Coach

  • Run 1:1s and deal reviews that build judgment rather than just inspect pipeline

  • Get in the field: join demos, customer meetings, and executive conversations, then debrief with specific, usable feedback

  • Coach the competitive game: POV strategy, shaping requirements early, framing Skydio's unique differentiators, displacement plays, and defending accounts under attack

  • Build MEDDPICC rigor, channel fluency, and forecast honesty into how the team works, not just what they report

  • Raise the team's fluency with AI tools: build shared workflows for customer research, call prep, RFP response, and pipeline analysis, and hold the line that nothing AI-drafted reaches a customer unreviewed

  • Coach the institutional sale: getting past the chief to the vice president, general counsel, and risk, and building a case that survives a procurement office and a skeptical campus community

Retain

  • Build a team that people don't want to leave: clear expectations, real development paths, and recognition that lands

  • Own territory and quota design so assignments are achievable, equitable, and worth staying for

  • Have honest career conversations early, address disengagement before it becomes a resignation, and be the escalation path your team trusts to clear obstacles

Run the segment

  • Own the segment number: pipeline coverage, forecast accuracy, linearity across the quarter, and the analysis behind them

  • Partner with Channel on partner strategy, joint planning, and the deal structures that get customers to yes

  • Act as executive sponsor on your team's largest and most competitive pursuits: present in the room, without taking the deal over

  • Represent your segment's customer insight, competitive intelligence, and product gaps to Marketing and Product

  • Tailor the playbook where campus warrants and plan around an academic calendar that concentrates budget and urgency into specific windows

  • Partner with Channel on cooperative and system-wide contract vehicles

What makes you a good fit

Required

  • 2+ years leading quota-carrying sellers as a first-line manager, with team attainment you can state year by year, including the year you missed and what you changed

  • 4+ years total in enterprise software, hardware, or SaaS sales, including personal success closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals

  • Demonstrated success recruiting sellers: a real network, a clear point of view on what good looks like, a structured process you can describe, and the ability to close candidates

  • A coaching approach you can articulate, with specific examples of people who got measurably better working for you

  • Strong voluntary retention history, a record of developing people into larger roles, and the judgment to move quickly when someone isn't right for the seat

  • Experience selling or leading teams into SLED customers, with working knowledge of procurement vehicles and budget and grant cycles

  • Fluency selling with and through channel partners

  • Daily, systematic use of AI tools in your own work, and at least one workflow, analysis, or tool you built or changed in the last two years that made you or your team measurably better (we will ask you to show it, not describe it)

  • Executive presence with both customer leadership and your own team, and high personal integrity under quota pressure

  • Ability to travel at least 50% of the time, and based in United States

  • Experience with higher education or other institutional customers

  • Good judgment about when to run the standard play and when a segment nuance calls for something different

  • Obtaining FAA Part 107 certification within the first 60 days of employment is strongly encouraged for all Skydio employees and required for certain positions

Preferred

  • Experience in higher education, or in public safety, specifically law enforcement, fire, or emergency management

  • Experience building a team from a small base rather than inheriting a mature one

  • You have built something with AI that other people use, whether a research tool, an analysis, or a team workflow, and you can talk about what the first version got wrong

  • Curiosity that shows: you can explain how something outside sales works (an agency budget, an airspace waiver, the aircraft's autonomy) in plain language, and you learn fast

  • Familiarity with MEDDPICC, Salesforce, Clari, BGov, GovWin, Slack, and Google Workspace

  • UAV, robotics, or emerging technology background, and comfort in a fast-moving environment

What to expect from our process

We run a structured process and we tell you what it is. A 30-minute conversation with the hiring manager. A deep dive on your leadership record: hiring, coaching, retention, and the team number, year by year. A working session where you use your own AI tools on a realistic problem from this segment and walk us through your choices. A panel on the public safety market and how you would run the segment. A conversation about how you think. References with people who worked for you and with you. Every interviewer scores independently against the same rubric before we compare notes.

On AI in the process: draft your resume yourself and refine it with AI if you like; we want your real experience, well expressed. Use whatever tools you want to prepare. Expect to use them in the working session. Leave them off during the conversational interviews so we can see how you think in real time. We use AI to draft job descriptions like this one and to take notes, and a human makes every hiring decision.

jobs.title: Key Account Director, Corrections
jobs.description_html:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the Team: Public safety is where drone technology faces the highest stakes. Agencies across the country are standing up Drone as First Responder (DFR) programs that put an aircraft over an emergency within seconds of a call. As drone programs move from the age of tools to the age of infrastructure, we are expanding our public safety sales team to meet that demand.

About the role: As a Key Account Director, Corrections at Skydio, you will lead a national team of Key Account Leaders selling into State Departments of Corrections and state-funded Port Authorities. This is a first-line leadership role, and the job comes down to three things: recruiting the right people, coaching them into great sellers, and keeping them here.

You will not carry your own accounts. Your number is your team’s number, and you will hit it by making each person on the team better: sharpening deal strategy, getting into the field on their most competitive pursuits, and building the territory, pipeline, and forecast discipline that makes a segment predictable. You will work alongside peer Directors leading other segments and geographies, and across Channel, Sales Engineering, Business Development, Marketing, Strategic Relationships, Government Relations, and Mission Success.

Corrections is one of our least penetrated markets, so building the Skydio brand with DOC leadership is part of the job alongside building the team.

You will also set the standard for how the team works, not only what it sells. We sell autonomous flying robots and the artificial intelligence that powers them. Every seller here uses AI tools as a normal part of running a territory, and you will model that, coach to it, and hire for it.

This is a highly competitive market, and much of the work happens alongside our channel. Your team will sell against incumbent platforms and well-funded challengers, and you will set the standard for how they win.

Location: National (Remote, United States)

How we work

These are the standards we hire to, and as a leader you own them for your segment. You set the bar in who you hire, what you coach to, and what you tolerate.

  • High integrity. Public safety is a tight-knit community. Corrections leaders talk to each other, and a reputation for straight answers travels fast. We sell what the ecosystem is actually capable of, we are clear about where the product is today and where it’s headed, and we win on our own merits. There’s no compromise here.

  • Sales is a team sport. One team. No lone wolves. Deals are won by account leaders, sales engineering, business development, channel, marketing, strategic relationships, government relations, and mission success pulling in the same direction, and our partners are part of that team, not a channel to be managed around. The best people here care more about the collective number than their own slice of it.

  • Great conversationalists. This is the craft of the job: asking better questions than anyone else in the room, listening for what a corrections leader isn’t saying, real curiosity about how an agency operates. Not polish, not a rehearsed pitch. Trust in this market is built one honest conversation at a time, and it is the thing competitors cannot copy.

  • Curious, and fluent with the tools. Everyone on this team uses AI as a normal part of their work: researching agencies, preparing for meetings, analyzing pipeline, drafting and then editing. That takes taste more than technical skill: knowing what a quality result looks like, describing a problem precisely enough to get it, and catching the tool when it is confidently wrong. The same muscle makes a great seller. Discovery is specifying the problem; qualification is checking the output. We hire people who are curious about how things work, whether that’s an agency’s budget, a legislature’s appropriations cycle, or the aircraft’s autonomy, and who have spent the last two years embracing AI rather than waiting to be told to use it.

How you’ll make an impact

Recruit

  • Own hiring for your segment: build a continuous talent pipeline, run a fast and rigorous process, and personally close the candidates you want

  • Hire to the bar above: integrity, team instinct, conversational craft, and fluency with the tools matter as much as a closed-won history

  • Screen for evidence, not adjectives: attainment stated year by year with the misses included, deal stories with the mechanics of how the customer bought, and something the candidate has built or changed in how they work in the last two years

  • Run a structured process: the same core questions for every candidate, a live working session, independent scoring, and a debrief that decides on evidence

  • Onboard and ramp new Key Account Leaders with a clear path from first day to first award, and hold the ramp accountable

Coach

  • Run 1:1s and deal reviews that build judgment rather than just inspect pipeline

  • Get in the field: join demos, customer meetings, and executive conversations, then debrief with specific, usable feedback

  • Coach the competitive game: POV strategy, shaping requirements early, framing Skydio’s unique differentiators, displacement plays, and defending accounts under attack

  • Build MEDDPICC rigor, channel fluency, and forecast honesty into how the team works, not just what they report

  • Raise the team’s fluency with AI tools: build shared workflows for customer research, call prep, RFP response, and pipeline analysis, and hold the line that nothing AI-drafted reaches a customer unreviewed

Retain

  • Build a team that people don’t want to leave: clear expectations, real development paths, and recognition that lands

  • Own territory and quota design so assignments are achievable, equitable, and worth staying for

  • Have honest career conversations early, address disengagement before it becomes a resignation, and be the escalation path your team trusts to clear obstacles

Run the segment

  • Own the segment number: pipeline coverage, forecast accuracy, linearity across the quarter, and the analysis behind them

  • Partner with Channel on partner strategy, joint planning, and the deal structures that get customers to yes

  • Act as executive sponsor on your team’s largest and most competitive pursuits: present in the room, without taking the deal over

  • Represent your segment’s customer insight, competitive intelligence, and product gaps to Marketing and Product

  • Coordinate and attend the national events that drive growth in this market (CLA, ACA, and others)

What makes you a good fit

Required

  • 3+ years leading quota-carrying sellers as a first-line manager, with team attainment you can state year by year, including the year you missed and what you changed

  • 4+ years total in enterprise software, hardware, or SaaS sales, including personal success closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals

  • Demonstrated success recruiting sellers: a real network, a clear point of view on what good looks like, a structured process you can describe, and the ability to close candidates

  • A coaching approach you can articulate, with specific examples of people who got measurably better working for you

  • Strong voluntary retention history, a record of developing people into larger roles, and the judgment to move quickly when someone isn’t right for the seat

  • Experience selling or leading teams into SLED customers, with working knowledge of procurement vehicles and budget and grant cycles

  • Experience selling or leading teams into State Department of Corrections customers, with working knowledge of their procurement and budget cycles

  • Fluency selling with and through channel partners

  • Daily, systematic use of AI tools in your own work, and at least one workflow, analysis, or tool you built or changed in the last two years that made you or your team measurably better (we will ask you to show it, not describe it)

  • Executive presence with both customer leadership and your own team, and high personal integrity under quota pressure

  • Ability to travel at least 50% of the time; this role can be based anywhere in the United States

  • Obtaining FAA Part 107 certification within the first 60 days of employment is strongly encouraged for all Skydio employees and required for certain positions.

Preferred

  • Experience in public safety, specifically corrections, and relationships across the CLA and ACA communities

  • Experience building a team from a small base rather than inheriting a mature one

  • You have built something with AI that other people use, whether a research tool, an analysis, or a team workflow, and you can talk about what the first version got wrong

  • Curiosity that shows: you can explain how something outside sales works (an agency budget, an airspace waiver, the aircraft’s autonomy) in plain language, and you learn fast

  • Familiarity with MEDDPICC, Salesforce, Clari, BGov, GovWin, Slack, and Google Workspace

  • UAV, robotics, or emerging technology background, and comfort in a fast-moving environment

What to expect from our process

We run a structured process and we tell you what it is. A 30-minute conversation with the hiring manager. A deep dive on your leadership record: hiring, coaching, retention, and the team number, year by year. A working session where you use your own AI tools on a realistic problem from this segment and walk us through your choices. A panel on the public safety market and how you would run the segment. A conversation about how you think. References with people who worked for you and with you. Every interviewer scores independently against the same rubric before we compare notes.

On AI in the process: draft your resume yourself and refine it with AI if you like; we want your real experience, well expressed. Use whatever tools you want to prepare. Expect to use them in the working session. Leave them off during the conversational interviews so we can see how you think in real time. We use AI to draft job descriptions like this one and to take notes, and a human makes every hiring decision.

Compensation: At Skydio, our compensation packages for regular, full-time employees include competitive base salaries, equity in the form of stock options, and comprehensive benefits packages. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. Relocation assistance may also be provided for eligible roles. The annual base salary range for this position is $144,000-$180,000 + commission. Fundamentally, we believe that equity is the key to long-term financial growth, and we ensure all regular, full-time employees have the opportunity to significantly benefit from the company's success. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to enroll in the Company’s group health insurance plans. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to receive the following benefits: Paid vacation time, sick leave, holiday pay and 401K savings plan. This position and all associated benefits are subject to applicable federal, state, and local laws, as well as the Company’s policies and eligibility criteria.

*Compensation for certain positions may vary based on the position’s location.
