YOUR MISSION 

Creative engineers like you are essential to this mission, to inspire, build, and ship. This is some of the most meaningful work you’ll ever do, in an industry devoted to protecting the people you care about. 

We are seeking a senior 3D developer with expertise in real-time rendering to join a growing creative team at an early and pivotal moment for the company. You'll own the visual layer of how we render the common operating picture and 3D information (orbits, spacecraft, sensor volumes, live telemetry) in the browser. This is primarily a React and three.js role, but we will also consider transferable skills from other real-time 3D environments such as Unity, Unreal, and Babylon.js. 

You’ll work directly with our Creative Director who’s building this team for people who care as much about the craft as the mission. 

RESPONSIBILITIES

Nobody has defined what mission-critical space software should look and feel like. There's no decade-old design system handed down from a legacy defense contractor to follow. We're dedicated to building incredible real-time 3D content, directly in the browser, driven by live mission data, at a fidelity operators trust. This is a significant problem, and we need your help. 

You’ll have real ownership. From prototypes that shape our product strategy to the views operators depend on in no-fail environments, your work will be visible at the highest levels of government and military. If you’ve ever wanted your craft to carry real weight, then this is that job. 

  • Build and own our React and three.js rendering layer—the 3D viewport and the control measures that make up the common operating picture.
  • Turn design intent into production front end: components, interaction, motion, and the small details that make an interface feel polished.
  • Work with our data and platform engineers to render live telemetry and mission data at workable frame rates.
  • Own the 3D scene craft: renderers, materials and shaders, lighting, camera behavior, and level of detail.
  • Prototype visual and interaction concepts quickly, so we can test ideas and iterate. 

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Show us things you’ve built – shipped apps, demos, experiments. What runs interests us more than what’s on a CV.
  • Strong React and TypeScript, with deep three.js or react-three-fiber experience, solid WebGL fundamentals, comfort in GLSL, and a real instinct for performance.
  • A strong visual eye. You’re a creative who codes, judging your own work the way a designer would: not just whether it runs, but whether it looks and feels right.
  • Backgrounds in games, real-time data visualization, creative technology, and interactive agencies all fit here. Defense and space knowledge is welcome, but not expected.
  • You won’t be asked to model or texture assets, but fluency with a 3D pipeline (Blender, glTF, texture and geometry budgets) is a plus.
  • Leverage your experience to work quickly and efficiently, we’re a lean team, everyone needs to pitch in and move fast.
  • Own your work end to end, from prototype to production, including the polish, the performance, and the hard problems in between.
  • Turn your hand to what's needed. Real-time 3D is your focus, but you'll also take on data visualization and standard front-end work. 

 

COMPENSATION

  • Equity + Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, HRA/HSA options, PTO and paid holidays, 401K, Parental Leave

YOUR MISSION

True Anomaly is defining a domain. Space defense is becoming one of the defining strategic questions of this era, and the companies that shape how it is understood will be the ones that tell their story on their own terms. Partners are how that story travels further: the mission-aligned organizations that vouch for the work, and the brands that put it in front of people who never would have looked for it.  

Defense and space partnerships tend to be narrow: a logo on a sponsor page, a membership, a booth next to a booth. True Anomaly does not intend to work that way. We want partnerships with real cultural relevance, built to expand who knows us and why they should care, and designed to deliver lasting value for both sides. That spans the full range, from organizations like the Space Force Association to brands well outside of aerospace and defense that open the door to new audiences.  

This role owns partnership development and activation across that range, from finding the right partners to shaping the terms to making each partnership come alive in market. It works in close partnership with Integrated Marketing, Events, Brand and Design, Product Marketing, and Market and Audience Insights.  

This is a relationship seat and an execution seat in equal measure. The Senior Manager decides which partners are worth pursuing and why, what form each partnership should take, and what it must accomplish, and then follows through on the details at a level that matches the ambition.  

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

Partnership strategy and development 

  • Develop and maintain a partnership plan aligned with marketing and organizational objectives, with clear criteria for the partners and partnership types that fit. 
  • Identify, research, and prioritize prospective partners across categories, including: 
  • Organizational partners: associations and mission-aligned organizations, such as the Space Force Association. 
  • Brand and cultural partners: brands and organizations that bring cultural relevance and give us access to new audiences. 
  • Other partners: other partners that support awareness, engagement, or demand. 
  • Lead outreach and negotiation of partnership terms, deliverables, and timelines, working with legal and leadership on agreements. 

Partnership activation and management 

  • Manage the day-to-day relationship with partners and serve as the primary point of contact. 
  • Plan and coordinate partnership activations such as co-marketing, content, social, email, events, and sponsorships, in coordination with the teams that lead each channel. 
  • Track partner commitments and deliverables on both sides, and make sure agreements are honored. 
  • Maintain a partnership calendar and pipeline, and keep stakeholders informed on status and next steps. 

Cross-functional partnership 

  • Work with Integrated Marketing so partnerships support campaigns and the marketing calendar. 
  • Work with Events to identify and execute partner opportunities at and around events. 
  • Work with Product Marketing so partner messaging and positioning stay consistent. 
  • Work with Brand and Design so co-branded creative, partner assets, and logo and naming usage follow brand standards, and so partnerships are expressed consistently and well across channels. 
  • Work with Market and Audience Insights to assess partner audience fit and understand how partnerships affect audience reach and perception. 

Measurement and reporting 

  • Define success measures for each partnership up front, such as reach, engagement, audience growth, or leads. 
  • Report partnership performance and value delivered, and recommend whether to renew, expand, adjust, or end each partnership. 
  • Manage the partnership budget and track spend against plan [as applicable]. 

 

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5-7+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, brand marketing, sponsorships, or a related field. 
  • Demonstrated success building and managing partnerships with associations, nonprofits, or brands. 
  • Strong relationship-building, negotiation, and communication skills, with comfort engaging with senior stakeholders externally. 
  • Experience planning and activating co-marketing programs across channels. 
  • Strong organization and project management skills, with the ability to manage many relationships and deadlines at once. 
  • Comfort with measuring results and reporting on performance. 
  • Collaborative style, with experience influencing without direct authority across marketing, events, and program teams. 
  • Interest in or familiarity with [the space, defense, and national security community / our industry] is a plus. 
  • Bachelor’s degree required. 

 

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Quality and fit of partnerships: a healthy mix of partners that fit our priorities, including mission-aligned organizations and brands that expand our cultural relevance. 
  • Audience expansion: measurable growth in audience reach and engagement through partners, including new audiences. 
  • Partnership performance: partnerships deliver the value agreed for both sides and are reported clearly. 
  • Partner relationships: partners find us easy to work with, and strong relationships lead to renewals and new opportunities.

jobs.title: Client Growth & Success, Senior Manager- Enterprise Accounts (Direct)
jobs.description_html:
Twin Health 

At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health. 

We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.

Working here 

Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.

Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .

With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.

Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.

 

Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Client Growth & Success who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about building strategic partnerships with mid-sized enterprise organizations. This role is ideal for someone who is energized by partnering with clients, driving measurable outcomes, and creating value for clients and members.

This position will primarily support mid-sized enterprise clients, roughly 5,000 to 50,000 covered lives, requiring the ability to navigate complex benefits, HR, clinical, operational, and executive stakeholder groups while serving as a trusted strategic advisor. Success in this role requires strong relationship management, consultative problem-solving, and the ability to align cross-functional teams around client goals to maximize program adoption, outcomes, and long-term partnership success.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, resourceful, and customer-obsessed. You are a strategic thinker who is equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves to solve problems, navigating ambiguity, motivated by impact, and naturally collaborative.

Candidates may be considered for multiple open roles across Twin Health throughout the review and interview process as our teams identify matching opportunities.

Responsibilities 

Deliver Exceptional Client Value

  • Manage a portfolio of mid-sized enterprise clients, balancing time and attention across accounts of differing size and complexity.
  • Build and maintain trusted, strategic relationships with executive, HR, benefits, clinical, and operational stakeholders to ensure alignment with organizational priorities, KPIs, and long-term success.
  • Navigate complex enterprise organizations and align internally divergent stakeholder priorities within those organizations.
  • Develop deep expertise in Twin Health’s programs, clinical operations, implementation process, and growth marketing strategies to serve as a high-impact strategic consultant for each client.
  • Provide data-driven, consultative recommendations to improve program adoption, member engagement, clinical outcomes, and overall client satisfaction.
  • Prepare and deliver compelling executive business reviews, ROI analyses, and strategic recommendations tailored to each client's organizational goals.

Opportunity

Twin Health has built a powerful system of specialized intelligence around each member: a Digital Twin, specialist AI agents, clinical care teams, and human coaches. As we scale, our challenge is no longer building capable individual agents — it is making sure members experience one Twin: a single, coherent, trustworthy health companion, no matter which agent, coach, or clinician is behind a given moment.

We're hiring a Staff-level architect to own how Twin's AI agents understand members, speak, collaborate, personalize, and escalate — and to encode those standards not just as documentation, but as executable systems (Skills, agent templates, prompts, evaluation suites) that our product, clinical, and AI teams build on every day.

This is the "model behavior" and "conversation architecture" function that frontier AI labs have established for their assistants — applied to the highest-stakes, most personal domain there is: human health and metabolic disease reversal.

Responsibilities 

  • Define the North Star for Twin intelligence
    • Codify the principles governing every intelligent interaction across the Twin ecosystem: what Twin believes about health, motivation, personalization, autonomy, encouragement, intervention, and human care.

  • Architect multi-agent orchestration and handoffs
    • Map the specialist agent ecosystem: roles, responsibilities, boundaries, context requirements, and overlaps.
    • Define when an agent acts, listens, hands off to another specialist, or brings a human (coach or clinician) into the loop — and design the context-preservation protocols that make those transitions seamless.
  • Build personalization and trust frameworks
    • Define how interactions adapt to member goals, state, history, progress, and preferences.
    • Establish standards for safety, privacy, consent, clinical boundaries, transparency, and healthy AI interaction — including guarding against dependence, confusion, and over-engagement.
  • Make the architecture executable
    • Partner with AI engineering to encode standards as reusable Claude Skills, specialist agent templates, system prompts, and governed context/MCP integrations.
    • Build and own the evaluation and regression suite: representative scenarios and criteria that continuously test whether agents remain aligned with Twin's North Star as models, prompts, and experiences evolve.
    • Establish governance: how new agent behaviors and Skills are created, reviewed, versioned, and approved.
  • Lead across the organization
    • Operate as the connective tissue across product, design, content, clinical, engineering, and leadership — without direct authority, through clarity of vision and quality of artifacts.

  • Hands-on fluency with modern LLM tooling: prompt and system-prompt design, agent frameworks, tool use / MCP-style integrations, evaluation design (automated evals, human evals, rubric design). You don't need to be an ML engineer, but you must have real technical intuition for how prompts, context, and data change model behavior.
  • Systems thinking: experience designing multi-agent, multi-surface, or multi-channel experiences where context, state, and persona must persist across boundaries.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and philosophy-to-practice translation: you enjoy hard questions about autonomy, trust, and healthy human-AI interaction — and always drive them to concrete, testable standards.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership: proven ability to align research, engineering, product, design, and domain experts (in our case, clinicians) around a shared behavioral standard.
  • This remote opportunity based out of the U.S. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare, digital health, coaching, or another regulated / high-trust domain (HIPAA familiarity a plus).
  • Experience with safety-critical model behavior: escalation design, crisis pathways, clinical boundaries, refusal/deferral patterns.
  • Familiarity with Anthropic's Claude ecosystem (Skills, MCP, agent SDKs) or equivalent (OpenAI Assistants/Agents, Gemini).
  • Background in linguistics, HCI, behavioral science, service design, or content strategy.
  • Experience building or operating LLM evaluation infrastructure and data flywheels from production signals.

You will act as a strategic visionary in a fast-moving environment, mapping out complex enrollment flows and translating them into highly engaging experiences that inspire program adoption by clearly demonstrating the transformative benefits of our care.

Twin HQ is in Menlo Park, California, but this role is open to remote applicants in the US.

We are seeking a designer whose exceptional visual craft is matched only by their deep, rigorous service design thinking. You are a strategic systems-builder who brings order to ambiguity. You aren't just designing screens; you are designing holistic, deeply considered omnichannel experiences that balance premium, persuasive aesthetics with the logistical complexities of physical hardware and digital healthcare.

Candidates may be considered for multiple open roles across Twin Health throughout the review and interview process as our teams identify matching opportunities.

Responsibilities 

  • Define Personas & Value Propositions: Identify and construct distinct user personas based on direct research insights. Uncover the specific barriers and core value propositions that resonate most powerfully with each persona, ensuring we speak directly to their unique needs.
  • Architect Persona-Driven Journeys: Take the lead on multiple programs by mapping out tailored end-to-end enrollment flows. Design targeted experiences centered around the established value propositions of your personas to create a seamless, persuasive transition from initial program discovery to active participation.
  • Drive Comprehensive Service Design: Look beyond isolated digital features to own the entire physical and digital ecosystem. Design interconnected touchpoints that guide members through tracking their health kit shipment, the physical unboxing experience, pairing their hardware sensors, and scheduling their initial virtual appointment with the Twin Health care team.
  • Craft Compelling, Premium Visuals: Produce immaculate websites, landing pages, and enrollment assets that excite members and clearly communicate our value. High visual polish is critical to building trust, and you must balance this premium consumer-facing aesthetic with rapid execution.
  • Navigate Cross-Functional Complexity: Operate effectively in high-velocity, ambiguous environments. Collaborate closely with marketing, hardware/logistics, and clinical operations to ensure the physical realities of unboxing and hardware setup align perfectly with the digital UX.
  • Influence Without Authority: Drive a cohesive, user-first mindset across product, engineering, and client-facing teams. Clearly articulate your research-backed design rationale and align disparate groups around a shared vision for an unparalleled onboarding experience.
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications 

  • Service & Visual Design Mastery: 8+ years of UX/product design experience. Your portfolio must be a masterclass in both high-end visual polish (consumer-facing or marketing-led design) and complex, multi-touchpoint journey mapping, showcasing how you connect digital and physical interactions.
  • Research & Strategy Expertise: Proven experience conducting user research, defining actionable personas, and successfully translating those strategic insights into tailored, high-converting product flows.
  • Domain Expertise: Proven experience designing complex consumer enrollment flows, digital healthcare journeys, or premium e-commerce/unboxing experiences. You understand how to use design to drive adoption and build user habits from day one.
  • Omnichannel Agility: Deep expertise spanning responsive web and native mobile design patterns. You confidently navigate the constraints of different platforms and know how to bridge the gap between UI flows and real-world actions (like connecting Bluetooth sensors).
  • Systems & Logistics Literacy: Experience designing for hardware-software integrations or complex logistical workflows (e.g., shipping tracking, appointment routing) is a distinct advantage. You can communicate clearly with engineering regarding technical capabilities and data flows.
  • Communication: Strong verbal, written, and visual communication skills. You can pitch a concept, defend a complex product decision, and write the persuasive, engaging UI copy needed to speak to different personas, drive enrollment, and reduce drop-off.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in design, service design, HCI, or a related field.
  • This remote opportunity based out of the U.S. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. 

Compensation and Benefits

The compensation range for this position is $190,000 - $210,000 annually. 

Twin has an ambitious vision to empower people to live healthier and happier lives, and to achieve this purpose, we need the very best people to enhance our cutting-edge technology and medical science, deliver the best possible care, and turn our passion into value for our members, partners and investors. As the Senior Director of Design, Governance & Compliance at Vanta, you'll lead design for our largest product pillar. You'll set the direction for how compliance work moves from manual workflows to agents that do the work alongside our customers.

Governance & Compliance is the core of Vanta. It covers the frameworks, controls, policies, audits, and org structures that thousands of companies use to run their security programs. Those companies range from founders getting their first SOC2 to global enterprises managing hundreds of controls. As we move upmarket, the team's job is to make that complexity feel simple for every customer, at every size.

You’ll lead a team of senior, staff, and principal designers, with senior managers and directors reporting to you. You'll report to the Head of Design and partner as a peer with product and engineering leadership for the pillar. We're not starting from scratch. Vanta Agent works across the product, customers build and deploy their own custom agents, and our designers prototype and ship to production with our own AI design harness. Your job is to make that the way the whole pillar works.

What you’ll do as a Senior Director of Design at Vanta:

  • Lead the agentic direction for Governance & Compliance. Build on the agents we've already shipped, define what comes next, and shape how people and agents work together across the pillar

  • Own design quality across the pillar. Set the bar, drive consistency from concept to ship, and get into the details yourself when it matters

  • Design for platform and enterprise complexity. Lead the team through cross-cutting decisions on scoping, segmentation, org units, permissions, and multi-entity audits so the system holds together across surfaces

  • Bring AI into how the team works. Build on our design harness, help every designer prototype and ship faster, and keep craft high as speed goes up

  • Lead and grow leaders. Develop your design leaders and senior ICs, build a high-trust team, and hire well as the pillar grows

  • Partner as a peer with product and engineering. Co-own outcomes and quality with your counterparts, not just the design work

How to be successful in this role:

  • You've shipped agentic or AI-forward products and have a point of view on how design changes when outputs are non-deterministic

  • You use AI hands-on in your own process, from prototyping to building in a harness or in code, and you bring your team along

  • You have deep enterprise B2B SaaS experience. You understand custom configurations, multi-org workflows, and large deployments, and you've made complex products feel simple

  • You think in systems, designing object models and patterns that hold up across many surfaces, not just individual flows

  • You're comfortable going deep with engineers in a technical, domain-heavy space like GRC

  • You've led teams of 12 or more, including design directors, design managers, and staff ICs, and you move easily between strategy and the details

  • You have a portfolio showing how you've simplified complex products and shipped AI-forward experiences (required for interview)

  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship

  • Responsible for protecting Vanta and customer data in how your team operates and delivers results

  • Use AI in day-to-day work to amplify your skills and strengthen your outcomes, applying it across routine workflows, actively building fluency through experimentation, and exercising sound judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets a high quality bar

jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description_html:
About Wraithwatch

Wraithwatch was founded by alumni from SpaceX, Palantir, and Anduril to build the next generation of AI-powered cyber defense systems for the United States and its allies. We are deployed today to customers spanning the federal government, aerospace, defense, manufacturing, and emerging technology. Our core product is a continuously adaptive cyber defense platform utilizing generative artificial intelligence agents to autonomously model and construct a digital twin of an organization's entire IT and cybersecurity environment and analyze it for weaknesses, misconfigurations, and chains of possible attack.

We currently operate numerous live federal deployments with more coming online this year. Each one is a distinct environment with its own infrastructure, compliance requirements, and operational constraints. We need someone to make all of them run reliably at the same time.

The Role

You are responsible for the infrastructure that keeps Wraithwatch running in production across our federal and commercial deployments.

You will build and maintain the CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, monitoring, and operational tooling that let a small team ship software reliably across all of these environments without things falling apart. When something breaks at 2am in a production federal environment, you're the person who gets it back up. When we need to roll a release across 20 deployments in a week, you're the person who makes that possible without manual SSH sessions into each one.

This is not a role where you're managing infrastructure for a single product in a single cloud account. You're building the deployment and operations backbone for a company that is scaling fast across highly constrained federal and Fortune 500 environments, and every shortcut you skip today becomes a fire you fight next month.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain deployment automation and CI/CD pipelines that reliably ship software across 20+ federal environments in parallel.

  • Own the operational health of all production deployments — monitoring, alerting, incident response, and post-mortems.

  • Design infrastructure that accounts for the reality of federal environments: air-gapped networks, strict compliance requirements, variable network topologies, and limited access windows.

  • Build tooling that gives the engineering team visibility into the state of every deployment without requiring manual inspection.

  • Automate everything that can be automated. We cannot scale to hundreds of environments with manual processes.

  • Work with the product engineering team to ensure new features are deployable across all environments without environment-specific hacks.

  • Manage and improve cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP) and on-prem deployments depending on customer requirements.

  • Participate in on-call rotations for production environments.

Qualifications

Basic:

  • 4+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, SRE, DevOps, or platform engineering

  • Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar) and configuration management (Ansible, Salt, or similar)

  • Deep Linux systems knowledge — you should be comfortable debugging at the OS level, not just the application level

  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for complex multi-environment deployments

  • Proficiency with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)

  • Experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS preferred)

  • Comfortable working in highly constrained or regulated environments where you can't just spin up whatever you want

  • Willingness to work extended hours when production issues demand it — we are a seed-stage startup with federal customers who do not tolerate downtime

Preferred:

  • Experience deploying software into federal, DoD, or IC environments

  • Familiarity with FedRAMP, STIG compliance, or ATO processes

  • Experience with air-gapped or disconnected network deployments

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance

  • Experience operating infrastructure at scale across many isolated environments simultaneously

  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ELK, or similar)

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

 

Your Impact on our Mission

At Zocdoc, you’ll lead a portfolio of Platform Engineering teams that build backend platforms, AI development platforms, developer tooling, and shared services used across our engineering organization. You’ll own the portfolio’s multi-year strategy, priorities, sequencing, investment choices, organizational design, and outcomes; connecting platform work to engineering velocity, reliability, cost efficiency, and measurable business impact.

You’ll lead through managers and senior/staff engineers, building the organizational depth to scale beyond your direct involvement. You own Platform Engineering’s priorities, sequencing, operating standards, and outcomes. You’ll work directly with technical leadership to set the direction for major technical bets; you’ll translate that direction into an executable portfolio plan, define implementation guardrails, and create the mechanisms for teams to own delivery. You'll enjoy this role if you are...

  • Technically strong enough to partner with engineers on architecture and system design, and disciplined enough to lead through managers, senior engineers, and staff engineers.

  • Align engineering and cross-functional partners, unblock dependencies, hire exceptional leaders, and build an inclusive, high-performing, psychologically safe culture.

You'll be successful in this role if you have...

  • 10+ years building and shipping software, with a strong foundation in Platform, Infrastructure, or Software Engineering.
  • 4+ years leading multiple engineering teams, including through managers, with responsibility for portfolio-level strategy, investment trade-offs, and outcomes; experience leading senior and staff engineers.
  • Deep expertise in one or more platform domains, such as developer platforms, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, or shared services, plus the breadth and judgment to lead across the full portfolio.
  • Deep technical judgment in distributed systems, architecture, reliability, security, and modern software delivery practices, with the ability to evaluate options, shape implementation guardrails, and partner effectively with technical leadership on major architectural decisions.

Your Impact on Our Mission

Zocdoc is looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to keep our production systems reliable, observable, and recoverable. Patients and providers depend on our platform to find and book care. Reliability here means understanding a request's full path across the edge, cloud infrastructure, services, and integrations, not just whether one service is up.

You'll operate and improve production infrastructure and observability, serve as an incident commander, and automate away recurring operational work instead of absorbing it. You'll go deep in a few of the areas below and stay fluent in the rest, partnering with our developer platform, database reliability, and product engineering teams so production stays safe as teams ship quickly.

You'll enjoy this role if you...

  • Believe teams can't operate what they can't see, and enjoy building the telemetry and alerting that fixes that
  • Like hands-on problems that span the network edge, cloud infrastructure, application code, and third-party dependencies
  • Would rather automate a recurring task once than do it by hand every quarter
  • Stay calm leading incidents and use blameless retrospectives to drive real improvements
  • Care about clear ownership and closing the loop with the teams you support
  • Use AI tools to move faster while holding a high bar for validating what they produce

Your day-to-day is...

  • Operating and evolving our observability stack (Datadog, Sentry, Honeycomb, OpenTelemetry pipelines), including alerts, SLIs, and SLOs that page the right owner
  • Serving in the on-call and incident-command rotation, and driving follow-up work from retrospectives to completion
  • Provisioning and maintaining AWS accounts and ECS/EKS clusters with our cloud engineering partners, and right-sizing capacity so we meet reliability targets without over-provisioning
  • Running and hardening the network edge: CDN, bot protection, API gateway, and WAF
  • Designing and testing failover and recovery for compute, network, and edge, including game days and DR exercises
  • Applying infrastructure as code to production with guardrails, drift detection, and safe rollback paths
  • Applying and improving our rollout policy and safety gates, and partnering with product teams on readiness and failure modes
  • Keeping production infrastructure patched and certificates current, and automating that work so it doesn't come back every quarter
  • Maintaining security posture for production infrastructure (least-privilege IAM, org-level guardrails, edge protection, container image and dependency scanning) in partnership with Security
  • Mentoring engineers through incident reviews, code review, and pairing, and writing runbooks so routine requests don't need you

You'll be successful in this role if you have...

  • 5+ years in Site Reliability, Production, Platform, or DevOps Engineering supporting consumer-facing web applications or distributed production systems
  • 2+ years of on-call in a 24/7 cloud production environment, including leading incident response and delivering durable remediation
  • Hands-on experience building observability, including structured logging, distributed tracing, alerting, and SLOs
  • Experience designing for failure in distributed systems, such as timeouts, retries, load shedding, and graceful degradation
  • Production experience with AWS and container platforms such as ECS, EKS, or Kubernetes
  • Solid Linux fundamentals, including patching, performance troubleshooting, and container internals
  • Strong networking and performance fundamentals: TCP/IP, HTTP, TLS, DNS, load balancing, and VPC design, and tracking down latency and resource bottlenecks
  • Deep hands-on experience in at least one of: the network edge (CDN, API gateway, WAF), infrastructure as code and CI/CD (Terraform, CDK, or CloudFormation), or automating operational toil such as patching, certificates, or image pipelines
  • Proficiency in Python, Go, or a comparable language, and the ability to read, review, and debug application code
  • Sound judgment using AI tools in engineering and operations, including validating AI-generated changes before they reach production
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining operational risk to engineers and non-technical partners

Nice to have

  • Depth in more than one of the areas above
  • Experience with error budgets, failover design, DR exercises, or game days
  • Experience with a CI/CD system such as GitHub Actions, Harness.io, CircleCI, or TeamCity
  • Hands-on experience with tools we run, such as Datadog, Sentry, Honeycomb, Rootly, Fastly, or Kong
  • Windows Server experience, since our production includes a Windows fleet alongside containerized AWS services
  • Experience in regulated environments such as healthcare

  • If in the NYC area, flexible work environment
  • Unlimited Vacation

  • Corporate wellness program with Wellhub
  • Sabbatical leave (for employees with 5+ years of service)
  • Competitive paid parental leave and fertility/family planning reimbursement
  • Cell phone reimbursement
  • Employee Resource Groups and ZocClubs to promote shared community and belonging
